jobs.title: Environmental, Health & Safety Manager (EHS) - Manufacturing Plant
jobs.description:
The Environmental, Health and Safety Manager acts as a strategic partner and change agent, working with the NA Environmental and Health & Safety Departments to ensure consistent execution of regional EH&S policies and strategies. This role advises site leadership on EH&S objectives, challenges the status quo to drive improvement, and confidently pushes back when needed to maintain compliance and best practices. The position integrates EH&S into site culture and leads all phases of the plant’s environmental, health, and safety programs.

The Environmental, Health & Safety Manager will:

• Plan, promote, and follow-up on all phases of the plant safety program and drive the safety culture.
• Create and develop new methods and strategies to help engage employees in safety culture.
• Maintain accurate and complete records that meet regulatory requirements, including but not limited to:Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA)Department of Transportation (DOT)Clean Air Act (CAA)Clean Water Act (CWA)Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA)Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA)All applicable local and state regulatory requirements
• Anticipate, identify and evaluate hazardous conditions and practices through work site knowledge, employee interactions, and work site inspection, and control exposures to occupational health hazards.
• Conduct mandated employee health and safety training programs.
• Participate in state and federal OSHA inspections.
• Act as the site contact for Worker’s Compensation issues.
• Conduct applicable facility environmental training including: Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP), Spill Prevention, Control and Countermeasure Plan (SPCC).

The Environmental, Health & Safety Manager should have:

• High energy with the ability to motivate people and drive the safety culture.
• Experience leading, planning, and promoting all phases of the plant safety program.
• Experience developing and delivering training
• Experience with air permitting
• Be able to implement, administer and advise others on hazard controls and hazard control programs.
• The skills to coordinate the plant accident and investigation program, including the maintenance of required OSHA reports.
• The ability to assist Regional EH&S staff in the quantification, evaluation and control of employee exposure to potential occupational health hazards
• A collaborative approach to leadership and a willingness to actively participate on the floor

• Bachelor’s degree required
• 5-7 years of experience in a manufacturing plant performing Environmental, Health and Safety activities
• Proficient in MS Office
• CSP, CIH, or CHMM certification is preferred
• Able to certify OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 training is preferred

Salary Range:  The expected salary range for this position is between $100,000 - $125,000 and includes a possible 12% quarterly incentive bonus. Actual pay will be adjusted based upon candidate experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.

• Well-being program which includes opportunity to earn employer contributions
• Life and AD&D Insurance
• Disability Insurance
• 401(k) retirement saving plans with employer contributions
• Financial advisors to assist with retirement planning and financial wellness
• Employee Assistance Program

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Outside Parts Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Truck Centers, Inc. is looking for a motivated and customer-focused Outside Parts Sales Representative (OPS) to join our team in St. Louis! In this role, you'll be building strong relationships with customers, growing new business opportunities, and serving as a key partner for commercial vehicle and equipment parts needs. If you enjoy connecting with people, finding solutions, and driving results, this could be a great fit for you.

Schedule:

This is a Monday–Friday role, but some nights and weekend hours may be needed to support customer needs.

What You'll Do:

• Develop new business by identifying leads and building strong relationships with prospective customers.
• Maintain and grow existing accounts to hit or exceed sales goals.
• Use your knowledge of vehicle parts and inventory systems to provide timely and accurate solutions for key customers.
• Look up parts, access technical info, and track down inventory—whether it’s on-site or across the TCI network.
• Partner with vendors to organize product demos for customers.
• Handle warranty and return paperwork for your accounts.
• Tackle customer concerns with a positive, solution-focused mindset to keep satisfaction and repeat business high.
• Recommend new product lines or items that align with customers’ needs.
• Review account activity and pricing profiles regularly to find new ways TCI can serve your customers better.
• Stay in close contact with your accounts, including regular on-site visits, to ensure they’re getting the top-tier service we’re known for.

If you’re driven, dependable, and ready to be the face of TCI’s parts team in the field, we’d love to talk!

What We're Looking For:

• Valid Driver's License and ability to meet insurance requirements
• 5+ years of parts sales experience; heavy-duty truck parts experience is highly preferred
• Demonstrated customer service experience
• Thorough knowledge of basic computer operations and MS Office Suite proficiency
• Strong organizational and time management skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple projects seamlessly with excellent attention to detail and a solution-focused outlook
• Must participate in a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

What We Offer:

Pay Structure: This position is commission based. Typically we will offer a guaranteed salary for a set amount of time until customer base is established at which point, you will switch to a commission-based pay structure.

• 401(k) with company match
• Health insurance with 3 plan options to choose from, Vision Insurance, and Dental Insurance
• Paid time off including paid volunteer time
• Disability insurance
• FSA and HSA options
• Company paid Life and AD&D insurance
• Maternity leave
• Employee assistance program
• Wellness program

Truck Centers, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer (EOE).  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

We believe in the Hire to Retire philosophy and invest in individuals that we believe will be valuable assets to TCI and our customers for years to come. Thus, we want to help you live well through personal and professional growth plus a multitude of benefits.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with strong front-end expertise in React and practical back-end experience with Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will build responsive, intuitive web applications; integrate user interfaces with scalable services and databases; and collaborate with product, design, quality assurance, and engineering partners to deliver reliable software. The ideal candidate combines sound engineering practices with strong user-experience awareness, analytical problem-solving, and attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and deploy responsive, accessible, and visually consistent user interfaces using React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Translate wireframes, mockups, and product requirements into reusable, maintainable front-end components.
• Develop and maintain back-end APIs and services using Java and Spring Boot.
• Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
• Write and optimize SQL queries to support application functionality, performance, and data integrity.
• Improve application speed, scalability, reliability, and usability through performance analysis and sound engineering practices.
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, quality assurance professionals, and engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.
• Use Git, npm, and related development tools to maintain code quality, version control, and build automation.
• Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, and contribute to continuous product improvement.
• Participate in Agile planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives.
• Stay current with modern front-end, back-end, cloud, and user-experience practices.

• Three or more years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands-on front-end development experience.
• Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Experience with Node.js and npm-based development workflows.
• Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, including the ability to implement and maintain straightforward back-end APIs.
• Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write efficient, well-structured database queries.
• Experience integrating web applications with RESTful APIs; GraphQL experience is also welcome.
• Proficiency with Git or a comparable version-control platform.
• Strong understanding of responsive design, usability, browser compatibility, and front-end performance.
• Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• One or more years of experience working in an Agile software development environment.
• Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
• Familiarity with AWS or another cloud platform.
• Experience with browser debugging, profiling, and performance-testing tools.
• Knowledge of secure coding practices, API authentication, and scalable application design.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Anatomy & Physiology Faculty
jobs.description:
We are interested in developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily Industry Professionals to share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate and graduate students in a variety of fields.   Courses meet once or twice a week for eight weeks. The face-to-face interaction is blended with technology (such as online discussions and online assignments) for an enhanced learning environment. Commitment is on a course by course basis.

Anatomy & Physiology I-IV with Lab (BIOS-251 thru BIOS-256)

This is a four-course sequence in which human anatomy and physiology are studied using a body systems approach. Coursework emphasizes interrelationships between form and function at the gross and microscopic levels of organization.

Topics include:

• Basic anatomical and directional terminology, muscle tissues, fundamental concepts and principles of cell biology, history and the integumentary and skeletal systems
• Fundamental concepts and principles of the muscular and nervous systems, special senses and the endocrine system
• Cardiovascular, immune and respiratory systems
• Digestive, urinary and reproductive systems

Responsibilities

• Develops and provides students with an approved Covista syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives.

• Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and update all course materials.

• Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students.

• Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning.

• Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories.

• Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives.

• Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams, and provide timely feedback to students.

• Completes other duties as assigned.

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Complies with all policies and standards

• Master's Degree is required for all faculty positions (with 18 graduate hours in the subject being taught for undergraduate teaching). Required
• Faculty must have requisite subject matter expertise and outstanding communication skills.
• Faculty must also have excellent motivational and instructional skills in a diverse and non-traditional environment.
• Must be able to work in a collegial manner and facilitate the efforts of diverse groups.
• Additional requirements driven by state licensing or accreditation considerations may apply. Required

Chamberlain Visiting Professor Position - Campus:

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is between $1,120 per assignment to $7,245 per assignment, depending on the candidate’s education and experience.

Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. jobs.description:
Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring for a Maintenance Technician I to contribute to our Manufacturing team in Roseburg, OR.  Under limited supervision, this person will be responsible for performing complex diagnostics and repairs, relating to distribution center facilities and equipment. The Technician will ensure that all equipment in the distribution center facility is maintained properly, by performing highly diversified duties to install, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain facility equipment to OEM standards.  This individual will partner with leadership in daily support to internal customers and maintenance team.

Schedule:

• Starting schedule: Sunday: 9:00pm – 7:30am, Monday – Thursday: 11:30pm – 7:30am

*Note: Once a hire is up and running, must be flexible to a possible 12-hour shift

Pay: $30.25 and up DOE

Required Qualifications:

• HS Diploma or GED
• 1 years as a technician in a production or manufacturing environment or equivalent year for year directly related education

Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate equipment failures and provides complex emergency/unscheduled repairs of equipment.
• Ensure repairs and equipment downtime does not negatively impact the ability to meet service level agreements.
• Perform complex technical duties, but not limited to, mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, troubleshooting and repair of production/facility machines.

• Electrical troubleshooting ability, with understanding of AC/DC control wiring and relay logic.

• Ability to troubleshoot and repair manufacturing equipment.
• Proficiency in computer skills and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.).
• Knowledge of servo, hydraulic and pneumatically actuated equipment.

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer | $90-$120/hr + Remote | Inc. 5000 Award-Winning, High-Growth Coaching Company
jobs.description:
The Senior Full Stack Engineer will be working on a custom community platform built for personal development, coaching, courses, community forums, and daily engagement. The product is currently in private beta, with a near term goal of being launch ready by November 13.

This is an opportunity to join at an important stage. There is already a substantial product and codebase, but meaningful engineering work remains before it is taken public. You'll initially work closely with the engineer who designed and built the platform, while progressively taking greater responsibility for its architecture, production readiness, and technical operations. Over time, this person is expected to become the internal technical owner of the platform.

Responsibilities:

• Assess the existing production codebase for security vulnerabilities, scalability and performance bottlenecks, architecture risks, data protection concerns, and reliability issues, then prioritize and implement pragmatic improvements required for a safe, stable public launch.
• Take increasing ownership of the overall technical health and architecture of the platform, ultimately becoming the internal technical owner responsible for its stability, security, scalability, reliability, and continued evolution.
• Own features end to end, from data modeling and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
• Work across the full stack with a strong backend focus, while remaining hands on with Vue.js frontend development and contributing to a polished customer experience.
• Serve as the internal technical counterpart to outside engineering partners, reviewing architecture and code, challenging technical decisions when appropriate, validating deliverables, and ensuring work meets product, security, scalability, and production requirements.
• Partner with the existing platform engineer on technical knowledge transfer, including architecture, codebase knowledge, environments, infrastructure, accounts, deployment processes, documentation, and operational procedures.
• Own production readiness and technical operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, release readiness, technical QA, and escalation of production issues.
• Design, automate, and execute rigorous functional, regression, load, and smoke testing.
• Identify and communicate technical risks early while distinguishing genuine engineering concerns from personal preferences.
• Design and evolve relational data models, PostgreSQL schemas, queries, indexes, migrations, and Prisma models, with a strong understanding of relational database design and performance.
• Work across integrations such as Stripe Connect, LiveKit, Twilio, Zoom, Anthropic, and pgvector.
• Use AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, security, and maintainability.
• Ideally contribute to the platform's production AI architecture, including LLM integrations, RAG, agents, context management, retrieval, evaluation, and production reliability.

• 8 to 12+ years of software engineering experience, including strong production experience with Vue.js and deep hands on experience with relational database design. PostgreSQL experience is preferred, and experience with Nuxt and Prisma is a plus.
• Proven experience owning significant portions of a production platform across backend architecture, databases, APIs and integrations, infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
• Proven experience assessing production applications for security, scalability, reliability, and performance risks, with hands on experience identifying vulnerabilities, protecting sensitive customer data, diagnosing bottlenecks, and implementing pragmatic improvements.
• Strong backend engineering depth, with the technical judgment to understand an existing system holistically and eventually take responsibility for its architecture and technical health.
• Experience reviewing and validating other engineers' or external development partners' work, including architecture decisions, code quality, testing, security, scalability, and production readiness.
• Ability to quickly understand and contribute within an existing codebase and technical direction, identifying material risks and making pragmatic improvements rather than defaulting to unnecessary rewrites or redesigns.
• Experience owning production readiness, including monitoring, incident troubleshooting, release processes, technical QA, and resolving critical production issues.
• Background in regulated industries or high volume e-commerce is a bonus, particularly environments involving sensitive customer data, compliance requirements, high transaction volumes, and large numbers of concurrent users.
• Proven experience using AI coding agents on a production codebase to improve productivity, not replace thinking. Production experience with AI/LLM architecture, including RAG, agents, context management, model integrations, or similar systems, is a strong plus.
• Extremely organized and self sufficient, with the ability to operate independently and make sound technical decisions in a fast paced environment.
• Excited to work in a startup environment, with a track record of adapting to changing priorities and taking increasing technical ownership as the company scales.
• Proven experience owning entire features and systems from architecture and data modeling through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support.

jobs.title: Principal Design Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Principal Design Verification Engineer to provide technical leadership for verification of next-generation semiconductor memory interface products, including data buffer silicon.

This role will drive verification strategy and execution for complex digital designs, working closely with design teams to ensure functionality, performance, and product requirements are met. The ideal candidate brings deep semiconductor verification expertise with SystemVerilog and UVM. Previous DDR or memory experience is an advantage, but is not required.

This is an opportunity to take significant technical ownership while contributing to next-generation DDR6 technology.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead verification strategy and execution for complex semiconductor designs at the block and system level.
• Define verification methodologies, test plans, coverage strategies, and verification environments.
• Architect, develop, maintain, and optimize SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches and verification environments.
• Drive test development, functional coverage, checkers, constrained-random verification, and coverage closure.
• Take technical ownership of verification for assigned blocks, features, and environments from planning through signoff.
• Work closely with RTL and design engineers to ensure designs meet functional and performance requirements and are effectively verifiable.
• Analyze specifications, design implementation, and verification results to identify functional gaps and design issues.
• Drive debugging and resolution of complex verification failures.
• Develop scalable and reusable verification components, methodologies, and best practices.
• Identify and lead improvements in verification efficiency, quality, performance, and reuse.
• Participate in architecture, feasibility, design, and technical reviews.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to verification engineers.
• Serve as a technical expert for assigned verification methodologies and tools.
• Communicate verification progress, coverage, technical risks, and readiness to engineering leadership and project stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• Extensive experience in semiconductor design verification, with demonstrated technical ownership of complex verification efforts.
• Expert-level proficiency with SystemVerilog.
• Significant hands-on experience with UVM (Universal Verification Methodology), including development and optimization of UVM-based verification environments.
• Experience defining verification strategies and developing verification plans from design and product specifications.
• Strong experience with functional verification, constrained-random testing, functional coverage, checkers, debugging, and coverage closure.
• Experience partnering closely with RTL/design engineering teams throughout the verification lifecycle.
• Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex verification and design problems.
• Ability to provide technical leadership and mentoring within a verification team.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with DDR, memory interfaces, memory controllers, data buffers, or related semiconductor technologies.
• Experience with DDR4 and/or DDR5.
• Verification experience with complex high-speed interfaces, protocols, or mixed-signal semiconductor products.
• Experience leading verification efforts through coverage closure and signoff.

The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

AA/EOE

LI-AD1

Required:

jobs.title: Web Program Manager (PM)
jobs.description:
Location: [SF Bay Area, NYC, or Los Angeles] (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)

Impact

This role sits at the intersection of web, marketing, and execution. You’ll act as a hands-on partner to the client, supporting go-to-market launches by translating strategy into high-quality web experiences and deliverables.

Operating within defined scopes to move work forward, you will conduct research, shape web recommendations, and translate marketing and product needs into clear briefs and actionable web workstreams. You’ll ensure that web is effectively positioned within the broader marketing funnel, from acquisition through engagement. You play a critical role in helping the client make informed decisions about how web supports launches, from structure and content to performance and measurement, while keeping work organized, prioritized, and moving.

Key Responsibilities

Web Marketing & Execution

• Translate marketing initiatives into effective web experiences, including landing pages, campaign pages, and other digital experiences
• Develop clear briefs and requirements that translate marketing, product, audience, and brand needs into actionable web work
• Partner across design, content, development, and other stakeholders to move work from brief through execution
• Support decisions around site structure, content types, and user journeys, including landing page strategy, SEO considerations, and content formats
• Ensure web experiences align with broader campaign and product launch goals

Go-to-Market Support

• Support product and campaign launches through targeted tasks, including research, audits, recommendations, planning, and execution
• Conduct analysis on customer journeys, the competitive landscape, and SEO opportunities
• Understand how audience, product, brand, and campaign priorities come together across the web experience
• Contribute to shaping how web fits into the full marketing funnel

Project Management & Prioritization

• Manage day-to-day workflow, balancing multiple incoming requests with varying levels of urgency
• Triage and prioritize work effectively, making informed tradeoffs when needed
• Maintain organization across tasks, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
• Communicate progress clearly and proactively
• Translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements, next steps, and executable workstreams

Analytics & Optimization

• Use data to validate decisions and inform recommendations
• Analyze site performance metrics, including engagement, conversion, and traffic behavior
• Contribute to reporting and dashboards to track performance and impact

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Partner closely with the client, maintaining strong alignment and communication
• Check in proactively on direction and approach rather than working in isolation
• Translate between teams with different priorities, inputs, and areas of expertise
• Navigate different personalities and working styles with strong emotional intelligence
• Read the room and adapt communication and execution style accordingly
• Provide cross-functional partners with the context and direction needed to move work forward effectively

What Success Looks Like

• Web work is delivered accurately, efficiently, and with strong attention to detail
• You demonstrate a clear understanding of how web supports marketing and product launches
• You can take an ambiguous initiative and turn it into a clear brief, plan, and executable web workstream
• Cross-functional partners have the context and direction they need to move work forward
• Requests are properly prioritized, with urgency and impact balanced effectively
• You take initiative while staying aligned, proactively checking direction and avoiding missteps
• The client trusts your judgment and sees you as a reliable, thoughtful partner
• Web recommendations are grounded in both marketing strategy and performance data
• You operate independently within your scope without needing excessive direction
• Work is organized, timelines are managed, and nothing falls through the cracks
• You contribute to smarter decisions around site experience, structure, and measurement

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

Required

• Experience supporting marketing or product launches and contributing to web strategy and execution, without necessarily owning full programs end-to-end
• Strong understanding of how web fits into the full marketing funnel, including acquisition, engagement, and conversion, with knowledge of:Landing page strategySEO fundamentalsContent structure and user journeys
• Experience using data to inform decisions, including familiarity with web analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics such as traffic, engagement, and conversion behavior
• Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams, especially in environments with shifting or ambiguous priorities
• Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, creative, design, development, or related teams
• Ability to translate inputs from multiple stakeholders into clear, actionable web requirements and workstreams
• Ability to operate with autonomy within a defined scope while proactively aligning with stakeholders
• Bachelor's degree

Preferred

• Consumer hardware, e-commerce, or devices web marketing background
• Experience with project management tools
• Content strategy experience, including educational guides, product exploration, or editorial calendars
• Agency coordination experience

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

Benefits

Our Commitment

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Operations Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Assurance Engineer will directly manage external suppliers to resolve quality issues and to improve supplier quality.  The Supplier Quality Engineer will be responsible for maintaining and improving supplier performance, analyze non-conformances, conduct supplier audits, and issue and participate in supplier corrective actions

Quality Management System

•Create and manage an improvement strategy for the United States.

•Measures and drives supplier performance on quality and delivery.

•Drives communication with supplier to improve process capability of supplied products.

•Conducts supplier quality systems audits.

•Fully understands, interprets, and audits to ISO 9001:2008.

•Works with supplier on process evaluation and continuous improvement.

•Leads team with purchasing, Engineering, Plants, and Supplier on root cause analysis for quality issues.

•Assists supplier with first article submissions.

•Reviews FMEAs, Control Plans and other supplier documentation for adequacy.

•Support Supplier Qualification and problem resolution.

•Additional duties as assigned.

•Degree in Engineering or related technical field.

•Must have considerable experience in technical roles preferably in a large multi-location business.

•Knowledge and understanding of QMS Processes and ISO 9001.

•Demonstrated experience in quality management tools, such as: Control Plans, Kaizen, 5S, Statistical Analysis, Root Cause analysis tools, Corrective Action Systems, FMEA, IPPAP and Cause and Effect Diagrams preferred.

•Ability to make good judgments and recommendations by effectively sourcing and analyzing critical information

•Demonstrated experience in data visualization in Microsoft Excel and/or other data visualization tools such as Power BI.

•Effective written, verbal and presentation skills.

•Demonstrated ability to persistently pursue and achieve results. Uses data / analytics to proactively monitor and review plans to hit or exceed targets and drives continuous improvement..

•Knowledgeable and demonstrated experience in understanding of technically complex problems.

jobs.title: Laboratory Automation (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Eurofins Professional Scientific Services (PSS) is seeking an Automation Scientist to support high-throughput, automated liquid-handling operations on a dedicated second-shift schedule at our client site in San Diego. This role is designed to significantly expand laboratory capacity by running automated systems outside of standard first-shift hours, enabling faster turnaround and roughly doubling throughput for a growing volume of complex requests.

The person in this role will independently operate, load, monitor, and maintain automated liquid-handling platforms overnight, ensuring that overflow and time-sensitive requests are processed, quality-controlled, and staged for the next step in the workflow. This is a hands-on, detail-oriented position central to keeping a large, automation-driven laboratory running around the clock.

Responsibilities

• Operate automated liquid-handling platforms (e.g., Beckman Coulter Biomek i7) to run overnight “overflow” requests that cannot be accommodated during first shift, increasing capacity for these critical activities by at least 2x.
• Support the growing number and complexity of liquid-handling requests by executing scheduled overnight runs to deliver results faster and expand daily throughput.
• Load, set up, and start additional robotic system runs as needed, and perform system set-up and cleanup activities to reduce prep time and maximize productivity during first shift.
• Perform liquid-handler quality control overnight using Artel across a large fleet of instruments (25+ including offline and online systems) to avoid delaying first-shift processes, and carry out any necessary repairs or maintenance identified in the QC reports.
• Transport sample plates to their next destination — storage, another robotic system, or a downstream instrument process — and initiate those runs when needed.
• Monitor robotic systems running through the night and provide hands-on intervention as required to troubleshoot and resolve issues, minimizing downtime and protecting sample integrity.

Maintain meticulous records of runs, QC results, maintenance, and issue resolution in client-provided systems, following good documentation practices.

Minimum Qualifications

• BS in a life sciences, chemistry, engineering, or related scientific/technical field with 2–5 years of relevant laboratory experience.
• Hands-on experience operating automated liquid-handling systems (Beckman Coulter Biomek i7 or comparable platforms).
• Ability to work a dedicated second-shift schedule, independently and with limited on-site supervision.
• Strong troubleshooting skills and mechanical aptitude for resolving robotic system issues as they arise.
• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate record-keeping.
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience performing liquid-handler QC with Artel or similar volume-verification systems.
• Familiarity with routine maintenance and minor repair of automated laboratory instrumentation.
• Experience in a high-throughput, automation-driven laboratory environment.
• Working knowledge of laboratory information/scheduling systems used to manage automated workflows.

• This is a full-time, second-shift position; specific hours and days will be defined based on business needs.
• Weekend, overtime, and holiday work may be required based on business needs.
• Comprehensive full-time benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
• Life and disability insurance.
• 401(k) with company match.
• Paid vacation and company holidays.
• Compensation Range: $57,000-$67,000/yr

jobs.title: Social Worker Psychiatry LCSW, Psych ED Program Day Shift
jobs.description:
The Social Worker, Psych reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Social Worker, Psychiatry is a licensed, master’s prepared social worker who is responsible for developing, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating comprehensive psychiatric social work services in collaboration with the interdisciplinary care team.  Provides clinical social work services to patients of the programs of the Stone Institute of Psychiatry in accordance with department and NMH policies and procedures.  Integrates the assessment and treatment of patients into the social environment of their family, significant others, and community to maximize the benefits of treatment.

Responsibilities:

• Completes biopsychosocial assessment as appropriate to setting in order to guide treatment planning.
• Conducts individual, group and family services specific to the program scope of care, and as indicated by the assessed needs of the patients.
• Participates with members of the treatment team, the NMH network of programs, and community systems to plan and implement treatment, including discharge/linkage.
• Participates in managing funding issues related to patient care.
• Provides education to patients and families and significant others about relevant aspects of mental illness and/or chemical dependency to support maximum utilization of treatment.
• Participates in projects beneficial to the provision of clinical services within SIP and NMH.
• Supervises graduate social work student(s).
• Documents timely, accurate and appropriate clinical information in patient’s medical record per documentation standards.
• Collaborates with other departments/programs and external resources as needed.

Additional Functions:

Administration of Work:

• Performs a comprehensive assessment including social, emotional, cultural, mental status, environmental and financial circumstances for diverse populations of patients and recommends a plan of treatment based on mutually established goals.
• Provides psychosocial treatment to patients, families and groups, utilizing up-to-date knowledge of clinical, case management, and human service delivery system interventions.
• Utilizes expertise in assessment, diagnosis and treatment of mental illnesses to optimize psychosocial functioning of assigned patients.
• Participates in clinical treatment planning as a member of the interdisciplinary treatment team.
• Educates patients and families about mental illnesses and treatments and provides other information necessary for the patient to participate in treatment.
• Demonstrates knowledge of community resources and an ability to connect patients and families with these resources.
• Acts as an advocate on behalf of patients who require assistance to gain access to needed information, resources, or services.
• Performs the discharge planning function to obtain a timely discharge through early identification, assessment and intervention for post-hospital care needs (inpatient units).

Leadership/Problem Solving:

• Fosters a milieu conducive to communication and cooperation among patients, significant others, and staff.
• Uses established communication channels to resolve work related problems.
• Understands and models “Patient First” standards.
• Participates in unit/program meetings, Psychiatry Open Forums, and other Institute–wide or Hospital–wide programs and meetings.
• May represent the Social Work group and the program/unit in Institute-wide committees.

Staff Development:

• Participates in orienting new staff as appropriate.

Continuing Education:

• Assumes responsibility for meeting mandatory requirements.
• Assumes responsibility for professional development plan and education by participating in workshops, conferences, Psychiatry Grand Rounds, and/or in-services related to clinical specialty.
• Provides graduate level social work field supervision for students of accredited schools of social work.

AA/EOE

#LI-AD1

• State of Illinois Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)

jobs.title: Leave Manager
jobs.description:
The Leave Manager oversees the day-to-day management of employee leaves of absence, accommodations, workers' compensation claims, and related OSHA compliance activities. This role serves as a key resource for employees, managers, and HR partners by providing guidance, coordinating documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring leave-related processes are handled consistently and in accordance with applicable requirements.

What You Get To Do:

• Leave of Absence Management: Manage employee leave requests from initial intake through return to work, including reviewing documentation, supporting FMLA and other protected leave processes, explaining benefits and PTO usage, maintaining accurate records, and communicating timely updates to employees, managers, and HR partners.
• Employee Accommodations: Coordinate accommodation requests by reviewing documentation, tracking physical requirements and restrictions, participating in interactive discussions as needed, and ensuring accommodation agreements and supporting documentation are completed and communicated appropriately.
• Workers' Compensation Management: Manage workplace injury claims from initial reporting through resolution, ensuring timely communication with insurance carriers and internal stakeholders, accurate documentation, required reporting, claim tracking, and return-to-work/job modification strategies.
• OSHA Compliance & Employee Health Tracking: Support OSHA compliance related to workplace injuries, bloodborne pathogen exposures, and communicable diseases. Coordinate required medical screenings, maintain exposure and incident documentation, and ensure OSHA-recordable incidents are properly tracked and reported.

Why You'll Love This Job

jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

We are seeking an experienced pricing analyst to serve as the senior analytical resource for pricing across Intuitive's full portfolio, spanning capital systems, instruments and accessories, service, and digital offerings, working at the intersection of Sales, Sales Operations, and Finance.

Pricing analytics is where the team's strategic position is built: quantifying how price, portfolio mix, and acquisition structure move margin, adoption, and customer economics. This role produces forward-looking analysis that shapes pricing structure before it is requested, rather than responding to individual quote requests.

The Senior Analyst supports business units bringing pricing proposals to the price council and other governing bodies, supplying the proposal analytics and presentation materials those decisions rest on while the business units own the recommendations themselves. Working across Sales, Sales Operations, Contracts, Financial Planning, and Product Marketing, this role converts transaction, utilization, and contract data into insight that senior commercial and finance leaders act on.

This position reports to the Director of Pricing and Customer Finance and is based in Atlanta, GA or Sunnyvale, CA.

Roles and Responsibilities

Portfolio Pricing Analytics

• Lead proactive pricing analytics across the full portfolio, including capital systems, instruments and accessories, service, and digital offerings, surfacing margin and price-realization opportunities ahead of the annual pricing cycle rather than in response to individual deal requests.
• Perform deep portfolio analytics covering price/mix, attach rates, and product utilization by market and customer segment to inform portfolio-level pricing decisions.
• Identify and interpret trends in contract portfolios, capital pipeline, and procedure production datasets to uncover opportunities for accelerating da Vinci and Ion adoption.
• Develop and recommend pricing structures that respond to growing global competition.

Pricing Science

• Apply pricing science methods, including hypothesis design, elasticity testing, and willingness-to-pay analysis, across product lines, acquisition methods, and customer segments.
• Use the scientific method to test pricing hypotheses and translate results into structural pricing recommendations.
• Synthesize predictive analysis on customer lifetime margin.
• Model comparative economics across acquisition methods, including lease versus purchase, to equip commercial teams with defensible customer-facing analysis.

Price Council and Pricing Governance

• Provide the proposal analytics that support business units through the price council process, quantifying revenue, margin, and competitive impact for proposals those business units own.
• Build the supporting analysis and presentation materials that carry pricing proposals to price council and other governing bodies.
• Pressure-test analytical assumptions ahead of submission, surfacing sensitivities and trade-offs for the business unit's consideration.
• Maintain the analytical standards and templates used in council submissions, and track approved decisions through to realized impact.

Analytical Infrastructure

• Build and maintain the models, dashboards, and data foundation that make recurring analysis repeatable and self-service for stakeholders.
• Establish deep understanding of the company's products, services, and pricing philosophies.

Executive Support and Communication

• Translate analysis into recommended pricing structures and programs, and socialize results and rationale to commercial and finance stakeholders.
• Prepare executive-level materials and recommendations, and support senior leadership on a regular and ad hoc basis.

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in pricing, financial analysis, or commercial analytics.Candidates with a minimum of 3 years of experience may also be considered if they have demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a pricing analytics workstream.
• Proven ability to build financial models and analytical frameworks that inform pricing and commercial decisions.
• Advanced skill in Tableau, Excel, and SQL.
• Working knowledge of statistical methods applied to pricing, including elasticity and price testing.
• Proficient in financial analysis and financial modeling, including multi-year contract economics.
• Ability to build and present proposal analytics to governance forums and senior stakeholders, and to substantiate analyses diplomatically on a routine basis.
• Strong communication and business partnering skills across product, commercial, and finance teams.
• Comfortable working across several concurrent workstreams with limited direction in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrates analytical problem-solving ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to pick up new skill sets quickly.
• Willing and able to travel 10-15% to support of strategic pricing initiatives.
• This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

Required Education and Training

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field; Master's degree desired.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
• Experience supporting a pricing committee, price council, or comparable governance process.
• Knowledge of equipment lease structures, residual and buyout mechanics, and end-of-term outcomes.
• Experience with R, Python, or comparable statistical tooling.
• Familiarity with enterprise transaction data in SAP and quoting data in Salesforce or a comparable CPQ platform.

jobs.title: BNA/CNA Training Class - October 2026
jobs.description:
Nursing Assistant Training

Miller's is proud to provide training for those interested in a career as a Certified Nursing Assistant free of charge. Each student is required to complete class room training and clinical training. Upon completion, students must pass the state exam to become a Certified Nurse's Aide. See below for more details on training.

Classroom Instruction

Each student is required to complete 36-40 hours of classroom work. All students are required to pass (with 80%) all of the tests administered during the classroom portion. (Each student has 3 attempts to pass)

If a student does not pass the classroom phase of the course they will not be placed into the clinicals.

Clinical Practicum

Each student is required to complete 75 hours of supervised practicum in a long-term care facility. During the practicum, the student must perform all required skills successfully. The first 16 hours of practicum is with the class instructor. Absence during this time will result in being excused from the program.

During the practicum, the student may be assigned to work with a preceptor who will assist the student in organization and time management. At the completion of the program the preceptor as well as the instructor will be given an evaluation sheet to complete regarding the students progress during the clinical.

All skills checklists booklets (RCP’s) not signed during the classroom must be demonstrated and signed off during the clinicals by the clinical instructor, or other licensed nursing professional. Completed checklist (RCP) must be submitted at the completion of the clinicals with all required skills completed or will not be eligible for the required state exam.

A “clinical sign-in record” is supplied to each student. This form must be completed by the student and signed by a qualified licensed professional on a daily basis. The student must include the following information on the sheet: date and actual hours worked, signature of student, cosigned by licensed supervisor.

Additional Information

Students are required to pass a criminal background check along with a TB test and physical prior to starting the course. Attendance to all classroom sessions is mandatory in order to meet the program requirements as set by the Indiana State Department of Health. Unsatisfactory performance or attendance issues may result in dismissal from the course/program. Students should check with the facility for details on the dress code requirements.

When a student that successfully completes the course he/she will be awarded a certificate of completion, will get a scheduled test date, and will have the scheduled test paid for by Miller’s Merry Manor if hired and in good standing as an employee. If the student does not pass the 1st test it may be retaken and paid for by Miller’s a second time. If not an employee, your application and certificate of completion will be given to you to schedule your own test at your own expense.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Travel
jobs.description:
The opportunity

As Flywire continues to scale its Travel software and payments platform, Product Marketing plays a central role in how we turn product capability into market impact.

We serve more than 22,000 travel and hospitality businesses. This role covers both lines of our Travel vertical: Hospitality, including hotels and boutique accommodations, and Experiential, including travel operators and DMCs. With Sertifi by Flywire, we cover the full path from contract to settlement, including digital contracts, deposits, and group event payments.

This role sits at the intersection of Product and Go to Market. The focus is straightforward. Make our solutions easy to understand, easy to sell, and clearly differentiated. You will shape how we position our products, how we go to market, and how we enable teams to win. The output shows up in pipeline quality, conversion, and revenue. You will report to the VP, Product Marketing.

You will connect product strategy, customer insight, and commercial execution. That means sharpening our story, targeting the right customers, and ensuring consistency across every touchpoint. It also means bringing real feedback from the field back into how we evolve both messaging and product direction.

What you'll do:

Positioning, ICP, and Messaging

• Define clear, differentiated positioning and value propositions for our Travel solutions
• Own Ideal Customer Profiles and buyer personas across the Hospitality and Experiential segments, grounded in customer and market insight
• Translate complex software and payments capabilities into simple, compelling narratives
• Ensure consistency across Product, Marketing, and Sales

Go to Market and Launch Execution

• Lead go to market strategy for launches, releases, and commercial initiatives in Travel
• Partner with Product to turn roadmap into market ready messaging and materials
• Drive coordinated execution across Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships
• Continuously refine approach based on performance and feedback

Enablement and Revenue Impact

• Build and maintain high quality enablement materials including decks, battlecards, demos, and value narratives
• Equip Sales and Relationship Management teams to position and sell effectively across both lines of business
• Partner with Sales and RevOps to improve win rates, deal quality, and conversion
• Support deal strategy in competitive situations with clear articulation of value

Customer Insight and Market Feedback

• Synthesize customer feedback, win loss insights, and field input into actionable direction
• Build a strong understanding of travel and hospitality buyers, market dynamics, and competition, including gateways, point solutions, and incumbent PMS and CRM workflows
• Feed insights back into positioning, targeting, and product decisions

AI Driven Execution

• Use AI to improve speed and quality across content, messaging, and research
• Experiment with workflows that increase productivity and scalability
• Help shape how the team incorporates AI into day to day execution

Here's what we're looking for

• At least 5 to 8 years of B2B product marketing experience across SaaS, payments, fintech, or similar environments
• Proven track record owning positioning, go to market launches, and enablement with clear ties to pipeline, conversion, and revenue

• Comfortable operating cross functionally and partnering closely with Product, Sales, and broader commercial teams
• Hands on experience using AI in day to day marketing workflows, with a focus on improving speed, quality, and scale
• Curiosity and willingness to continuously evolve how work gets done and experiment with new approaches
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence across teams
• Highly organized, able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail

Nice to have

• Bias toward action with a focus on execution and outcomes
• Experience in travel, hospitality, or hotel technology, or marketing to travel operations and finance buyers
• Experience in payments, fintech, or vertical SaaS platforms
• Experience supporting multi product or platform environments
• Experience directly tying product marketing efforts to pipeline and revenue outcomes

jobs.description:

The Chief Infrastructure Engineer serves as the senior technical advisor for enterprise infrastructure modernization and technology strategy supporting the Army Research Laboratory. This position evaluates existing technologies, researches emerging solutions, and develops recommendations that improve operational efficiency, automation, cybersecurity, resilience, and mission effectiveness.

Working across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, as well as networking, storage, virtualization, endpoint management, identity services, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies, the Chief Infrastructure Engineer provides technical analysis, modernization strategies, cost-benefit assessments, and expert guidance to Government leadership and engineering teams.

This role requires deep enterprise infrastructure expertise combined with strong analytical and communication skills. The successful candidate will assist technical leaders in solving complex infrastructure challenges, evaluating emerging technologies, and identifying innovative solutions that support long-term organizational objectives.

Job Responsibilities:

• Serve as the senior technical advisor on enterprise infrastructure modernization, engineering, and technology strategy initiatives.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data Governance & Master Data Management
jobs.description:
The Director, Enterprise Data Governance & Master Data Management will be responsible for establishing and leading Relias's enterprise-wide data governance, master data management, and business information strategy necessary to support our evolution into a data-driven and AI-enabled organization. Reporting into the CFO organization, this leader will serve as the central authority for enterprise data definitions, stewardship, quality, ownership, and governance across all business and product domains.

The Director will also serve as the enterprise Data Governance Lead supporting Relias’ privacy operations and Data Subject Access Request (“DSAR”) operating model. In this capacity, the Director will be accountable for the enterprise data inventory and map, data stewardship, classification, lineage, and know where personal data starts, where it gets copied or sent, which systems should be addressed first, how that map stays current, and who must certify that each system handled a privacy request correctly. The Director will partner closely with the Privacy Operations, Legal, Information Security, Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, HR, Procurement, and individual system owners.

The Director will create the framework that allows Relias to operate from a single source of truth by aligning Product, Engineering, Revenue, Finance, Customer Success, Operations, and Corporate functions around common business definitions, trusted reporting, governed data assets, and enterprise-wide accountability. This role will lead the development of enterprise data policies, stewardship programs, governance councils, master data standards, metadata practices, and data quality frameworks that support executive decision making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, analytics, and AI initiatives.

The Director will support the implementation and ongoing governance of enterprise data-discovery, catalog, lineage, master-data, and privacy-operations technologies, including the data mapping and stewardship components of any DSAR automation platform.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Enterprise Data Governance Strategy & Operating Model:

• Define and implement Relias's enterprise data governance operating model, stewardship framework, governance councils, business ownership structure, and decision-making processes.
• Create accountability for business data across departments and establish governance standards that ensure consistency, transparency, and trust in enterprise reporting and regulated data-processing activities.
• Lead the Data Governance Council and steward network while partnering with business leaders to resolve data ownership and definition issues.
• Establish clear accountability for enterprise data assets and systems, including designated business owners, technical owners and Data Stewards, with defined escalation and certification requirements across downstream and third-party data flows.
• Create escalation mechanisms, supported by the CFO and applicable executive sponsors, for unresolved ownership gaps, overdue attestations, deficient data controls and non-participating system owners.
• Ensure that enterprise data governance standards align with privacy, records-management, information-security, AI-governance, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Enterprise Metrics & Business Definition Governance:

• Establish and maintain enterprise-wide definitions for critical business metrics, including customer, learner, product usage, revenue, bookings, ARR, retention, churn, compliance, operational performance, and AI-related measures.
• Create the authoritative business glossary and semantic layer that standardizes reporting across Finance, Product, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Executive Leadership
• Partner with Finance, Product, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, IT, and Technology leaders to eliminate conflicting definitions and create a consistent enterprise business glossary that serves as the authoritative source for reporting, forecasting, board reporting, and executive decision-making.
• Establish governed definitions for personal data, data-subject identities, authoritative identifiers, customer-controlled data, Relias-controlled data, derived data, de-identified data, suppression records, system of record, downstream system and other classifications required for privacy and DSAR workflows.

Master Data Management & Information Stewardship:

• Develop and implement enterprise-wide master data management strategies across Customer, Account, Contact, Learner, User, Product, Content, Employee, and Organization hierarchies.
• Define data ownership, authoritative source systems, data stewardship responsibilities, matching and survivorship rules, and data lifecycle accountability that ensure consistency and accuracy across Salesforce Data360, Databricks, Tableau, operational applications, and future enterprise platforms.
• Partner with system owners to roll out programs.
• Define and govern the identity attributes, matching logic, source-system precedence and survivorship rules needed to locate and reconcile an individual across customer, learner, user, employee, CRM, marketing, support, product and analytics environments.
• Identify authoritative systems, replicated systems, downstream destinations, derived datasets and re-ingestion paths so that deletion, correction, suppression and access actions are not reversed or rendered incomplete by subsequent data synchronization.
• Establish lifecycle ownership for active, archived, backup, log, cache, index, unstructured, vendor-hosted and derived data locations.

Data Quality & Trusted Data Program:

• Establish enterprise data quality standards, scorecards, monitoring frameworks, metadata management practices, data catalog capabilities, and lineage documentation.
• Develop KPIs that measure completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and duplicate management.
• Partner with technology teams to identify root causes while maintaining business accountability for remediation.
• Establish data-governance controls and monitoring for completeness of system inventories, assignment of business and technical owners, lineage coverage, steward approvals, recurring attestations, retention classifications and unresolved data-location gaps.
• Define and monitor standards for system-owner attestations supporting privacy-rights execution, including identification of the applicable system, data location, action taken, date performed, responsible owner and supporting evidence reference.
• Partner with Information Security on technical evidence standards and control validation, and with Legal on approved retention, deletion, suppression and exception requirements.
• Produce residual-gap reporting identifying systems, datasets or vendors that are unsearched, unsupported, manually controlled, not yet integrated or otherwise unable to provide complete evidence.

Privacy, DSAR & Data Lifecycle Governance

• Serve as the Data Governance Lead for Relias’s DSAR Data Governance Operating Plan and related technology implementation.
• Own and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data map required to identify where personal data is created, collected, stored, transformed, replicated, shared, archived and deleted across Relias-controlled systems, customer-controlled environments, vendors and subprocessors.
• Reconcile the initial privacy-platform baseline and subsequent discovery records into a validated enterprise inventory with named business owners, technical owners, Data Stewards, data classifications, data flows and applicable lifecycle requirements.
• Prioritize systems and datasets into risk-based implementation tiers based on privacy risk, identity significance, downstream propagation, legal role, business criticality, evidence gaps and implementation feasibility.
• Coordinate recurring steward review, platform change assessment, data-map certification and system-owner attestation processes so the inventory remains current after initial implementation.
• Partner with the Privacy Operations / DSAR Program Owner to identify in-scope systems and data locations for request workflows, while Privacy Operations retains accountability for case intake, classification, deadlines, assignments, requester communications, evidence completeness and closeout.
• Partner with Legal to translate approved retention, deletion, de-identification, suppression, legal-hold, accreditation, certification, contractual and controller/processor requirements into governed data classifications, lifecycle rules and operational metadata.
• Partner with Information Security, IT, Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics and system owners to define system-specific data locations, deletion or de-identification methods, downstream dependencies, manual execution requirements and evidence-return obligations.
• Support the proof of value, configuration, connector validation, acceptance testing, deployment and operational handoff of any approved DSAR or privacy-operations platform, including data-map stewardship, identity-resolution requirements, manual-task workflows, audit-evidence outputs and residual-gap reporting.
• Escalate incomplete inventories, absent system ownership, unsupported data locations, overdue attestations and recurring execution failures to the DSAR Program Owner and executive sponsor.
• Maintain clear separation between Data Governance responsibilities and the responsibilities of Privacy Operations, Legal, Information Security and system owners.

Data Enablement & Organizational Adoption:

• Drive enterprise adoption of governance practices through Data Steward training, business glossary adoption, data literacy programs, governance communications, and process documentation.
• Create a culture where teams understand ownership and accountability for enterprise data assets.
• Train business owners, technical owners and Data Stewards on DSAR-related data-location, lifecycle, attestation, change-notification and evidence-return responsibilities.
• Develop reusable playbooks, ownership matrices, certification processes and escalation protocols that allow governance practices to scale across Relias’s enterprise platform environment.

YOU’VE GOT WHAT IT TAKES IF YOU HAVE:

• 10 years of experience in Data Governance, Master Data Management, Enterprise Information Management, Data Strategy, Analytics, or related disciplines
• Minimum of 5 years leading enterprise-scale governance or information management initiatives
• Proven experience establishing data governance frameworks, stewardship models, governance councils, and enterprise business glossaries.
• Demonstrated ability to align business and technology stakeholders around common metrics, definitions, and data standards.
• Experience supporting executive reporting, analytics, forecasting, operational management, and enterprise performance measurement
• Experience creating or governing enterprise data inventories, data maps, lineage documentation, system-owner matrices and recurring stewardship or certification processes.
• Experience supporting privacy, DSAR, records-management, regulatory-compliance or other data-lifecycle programs involving multiple business systems, vendors and data domains.
• Demonstrated experience defining ownership and governance for personal data, identity matching, authoritative and downstream systems, retention, deletion, suppression, archives and derived datasets.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Management, Computer Science, Finance, Analytics, or a related field

IT WOULD BE IDEAL IF YOU HAVE:

• MBA or advanced degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Analytics, Data Science, or related discipline
• Experience with Databricks, Salesforce Data360, Tableau, enterprise data catalogs, metadata platforms, and modern MDM solutions.
• Experience supporting AI governance, data ethics, privacy programs, and enterprise analytics initiatives, including privacy-rights or DSAR operating models.
• Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), DCAM, or similar governance certification preferred.
• Experience within SaaS, healthcare technology, education technology, or other regulated industries preferred.
• Experience implementing or operating enterprise data catalogs, automated data discovery, privacy-request management, consent/preference management or DSAR workflow platforms.
• Experience with retention schedules, deletion and de-identification controls, durable suppression, legal holds, customer-controlled data and vendor/subprocessor data flows.
• Experience preparing data-governance controls and evidence for internal audit, external audit, regulatory review or customer diligence.

IN OFFICE REQUIREMENT:

Relias values collaboration and wants to ensure that our team members have opportunities to work with their teams regularly for professional development opportunities. Our flexible hybrid work environment requires that you live in the state of North Carolina, within a commutable distance to our office (~1-hour commute). You would be expected to work in our Morrisville, NC Headquarters (close to the Raleigh/Durham airport) approximately 40 days/quarter.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Technician I, MD Fill (Aseptic Gown), B1 Shift
jobs.description:
Please note this is our MD Fill (Aseptic Gown) B1 Shift:  6am-6:30pm Thursday/Friday/Saturday & every other Wednesday

Performs functions associated with cGMP manufacturing operations within the biologics production facility, including working with engineers in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components and final materials. Uses sophisticated programs (such as LIMS, SAP, automated control systems, etc.) to collect and evaluate operating data, which can be used to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment. Determines and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

• Shipping finished materials.
• Maintaining inventory levels.
• Sampling of in process and raw materials.
• Running glass washer / autoclave.
• Buffer / media preparation.
• Equipment preparation (CIP / SIP).
• Cell culture (from vial thaw to production scale).
• Column chromatography.
• Tangential flow filtration
• Wear an aseptic gown during an 8 hr shift. This gown covers the full body.
• Willing to complete a lot cleaning sanitation during the work shift
• Follow all clean room entry and exit procedures
• Wear the required aseptic gowning and PPE correctly at all times
• Perform hand hygiene and sanitization before entering the clean room
• Maintain aseptic technique to prevent contamination of materials and products

• Minimize movement, talking, and unnecessary activity in the clean room
• Inspect gowning and PPE for proper fit and integrity before use
• Report any contamination concerns, spills, or equipment issues immediately
• Handle sterile materials only in approved areas and in a controlled manner
• Follow all environmental monitoring and cleaning requirements

• Serve as a positive, contributing member of a grade team, collaborating with colleagues to tackle common challenges and implement grade-wide initiatives
• Share candid, solutions-oriented feedback with peers and school leadership on a regular basis
• Embody KPPS core values: Children First, Cultural Competence, Ownership, Community

• Attend designated school functions outside of school hours (Back to School Night, Report Card Conferences, Community Events, etc.)
• Contribute to the planning and execution of all school-wide events
• Develop strong relationships with the families of students through home visits, participation in school events and phone calls home
• Perform necessary support duties including (but not limited to) bus, lunch, and dismissal duties

• Additional responsibilities may arise during the school year. They will be communicated to all employees with as much notice and flexibility as possible.

• You love and see the high potential of all children
• You have experience driving student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment
• You have passion for facilitating professional learning, including a desire to continuously grow and learn as a leader
• You operate with cultural competence and a commitment to inclusion, anti-racism, and the eradication of anti-Blackness

• You are solutions-orientated and have an eagerness to adapt in order to solve problems
