jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Funds KYC
jobs.description:
As an Assistant Manager, KYC, You will co-lead the KYC Team with the support of the Manager and assist the Guernsey Funds business by co-ordinating the seamless on-boarding of investors as well as maintaining a high level of support to the Fund Administration teams for BAU.

What you'll do

• You'll develop and maintain strong relationships with fund administrators, investment managers, investors, intermediaries, administration teams, and other key stakeholders, delivering a high standard of client service while balancing commercial objectives with AML/KYC, regulatory, compliance, and risk management requirements
• You'll attend and actively contribute to board meetings, provide updates on AML/KYC matters, investor onboarding progress, remediation projects, and regulatory developments, and build trust and credibility through clear, professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• You'll drive and oversee the investor onboarding process, communicating directly with investors and their representatives to resolve complex due diligence requirements, manage onboarding timelines, coordinate risk profiling, risk ratings, periodic reviews, and regularly report on progress
• You'll ensure all investor information is accurately collated, recorded, reviewed, and maintained in a timely manner, support the review and sign-off of normal and low-risk investor files where required, and ensure onboarding activities are delivered in line with contractual, legal, regulatory, and best-practice standards
• You'll work closely with the wider Funds business, Compliance teams, and Senior Management to identify, escalate, and manage risks and issues, while providing guidance, training, and development support to junior KYC team members across jurisdictions and promoting a collaborative, proactive approach to the investor acceptance process

What we offer

• Competitive Rewards: Attractive compensation and benefits designed to recognise your skills, experience, and contribution
• Health and Wellbeing: Access to a range of wellbeing initiatives and employee benefits that support your physical, mental, and financial wellness
• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working opportunities and leave policies that help employees balance their professional and personal commitments
• Learning and Development: Ongoing training, career development opportunities, and the resources needed to support your professional growth
• Inclusive Culture: A collaborative and supportive environment where employees are valued, empowered, and encouraged to reach their full potential

• You have a professional qualification or relevant industry experience, with strong knowledge of CDD/KYC reviews and the funds industry
• You possess a good understanding of AML/KYC requirements, with knowledge of FATCA and CRS regulations considered a distinct advantage
• You demonstrate strong client-facing skills and a proven ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with fund administrators, investment managers, investors, intermediaries, service providers, and other key stakeholders
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel, and can effectively manage, analyze, and maintain information and documentation.
• You have the ability to manage and support projects, deliver against targets and deadlines, and provide accurate reporting to boards and senior stakeholders

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential.  Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.title: B.S. Psychology (Adjunct)
jobs.description:
Walden’s values and mission

Students and faculty choose Walden because of our commitment to social change. We keep our values in mind with every action we take. We are a teaching institution. Online higher education is our specialty, and we were early pioneers in this field.

We are committed to developing a community of care through inclusive teaching and learning in all our academic endeavors, using a framework of shared accountability to enhance and advance the equitable health and wellbeing of communities, systems, and organizations. We value the inherent worth, humanity, and dignity of every individual engaged in the learning process.

Our students

Walden is a broad-access institution offering degrees at the bachelors’, masters’ and doctoral levels. Women represent over 70% of our undergraduate population. Walden’s undergraduate population is 44% white, 36% black, and 10% identify as Hispanic or Latino. We proudly embrace our LGBTQIAA+, (dis)abled, and first-generation college students, working parents and caregivers, as well as military veterans, and the unique cultural, linguistic, ethnic, and religious backgrounds of all our students. Walden students are between 25 and 75 years old, with 34% falling in the 30-39 age demographic.

Most importantly, we acknowledge the impact of intersectionality on the lives of our students, and we strive to provide community, support, and rigor tailored to the individuals that are our students.

"To teach in a manner that respects and cares for the souls of our students is essential if we are to provide the necessary conditions where learning can most deeply and intimately begin."

– bell hooks, Teaching to Transgress

College of Interdisciplinary Undergraduate Studies

The College of Interdisciplinary Undergraduate Studies is a new unit within Walden bringing together undergraduate general education and all non-licensure B.S. programs.  These include:

• B.S. Communication
• B.S. Psychology
• B.S. Business Administration
• B.S. Criminal Justice
• B.S. Human Services
• B.S. Health Studies, Health Care Management and Health Policy
• B.S. in Early Childhood Studies

We meet students where they are and accompany them as they strive to move forward on their academic pathways. Our philosophy is that we are all lifelong learners. As such, we understand the challenges of balancing life and learning and support our students as they pursue their academic and professional goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Walden provides undergraduate instruction in two modalities; course based with 6-week terms and competency based using a subscription model. Faculty start teaching in the course-based modality before potentially adding the competency-based modality on an as needed basis. All modalities are asynchronous. Contributing Faculty manage their own time to fulfill their responsibilities. We value the experience you bring with you and want to make sure your voice is heard as policies and initiatives take shape and find implementation.

• Provide Course instruction as assigned:Engage in classrooms at least 4 days a week.Facilitate and engage in discussion boards. Assess student work and provide substantive feedback in a timely fashion.Be available to students via video chat or phone as needed.
• Occasional additional duties may include:Course content developmentService on university and school committees, and school initiatives as needed.Support administrative needs within the college.Course maintenance as needed.
• Establish an accessible and supportive virtual classroom environment.
• Collaborate with colleagues and supervisors, sharing experiences and observations.

Training

All new faculty members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of online teaching: use of the Learning Management System (LMS), specifics of the policies, procedures, and degree programs in which they are going to teach; socialization int the Walden University culture; assessment of academic integrity of student work including use of www.TurnItIn.com and acceptable use of AI. A faculty peer mentor is appointed at the start of the first teaching assignment to provide mentorship and establish collegiality.

Qualified candidates will possess:

This post is for Contributing Faculty serving primarily the B.S. Psychology program within the College of Interdisciplinary Undergraduate Studies. Some interdisciplinary teaching will be involved as appropriate to a candidate's expertise and interest

• Demonstrated commitment to fostering empowerment and providing support for adult learners.
• Experience with and dedication to serving a diverse population of adult learners who manage multiple responsibilities while pursuing education.
• Experience working collaboratively with faculty and staff to effectively support a positive student experience.
• Completion of appropriate advanced and/or doctoral degrees along with experience in the field and/or interdisciplinary fields within academia.
• Experience with building and fostering communities in online environments. Online teaching experience is assumed.
• Documented contribution to research, thought leadership, and/or scholarship is valued in applicants, as well as participation in community organizations, organizational leadership, and social change initiatives. However, we preference teaching experience over publication records.

Qualifications

• Master's degree in the discipline being taught or a closely related field required.
• Three or more years of postsecondary teaching experience preferred.
• Experience teaching adult learners, particularly in a community college setting, strongly preferred.
• Experience teaching in an online or distance-learning environment preferred.

Your advanced degrees and scholarship will get you in the door, but your commitment to working with students will get you the job and keep you going when challenges arise.

What our students say about our faculty:

“Finding a professor who works hard to make a positive impact on the overall lives of their students is a rare blessing. I am fortunate to have been one of your students.”

Process

When applying, be prepared to upload your CV, as well as a cover letter describing your experiences with students, including challenges and successes. While your teaching philosophy is important, your individuality and experience with students is of most interest to us. We ask that you include a description of an experience you may have had as a student yourself that informs your approach to teaching today. We welcome applications from faculty at all career stages.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

• Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
• Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring. For more information regarding these opportunities, including the Faculty Compensation Schedule, please Click Here.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
David Weekley Homes is seeking an experienced Product Owner for our Application Development team. This position is based at our Houston headquarters located in West Houston near the intersection of I-10 Katy Freeway and 610 W Loop N Freeway. This position will require frequent on-site presence in the Houston office.

We are looking for an experienced product owner who wants to share their knowledge and learn new skills in a fun, intense, and challenging environment.  Qualified candidates will have the ability to learn and apply new methodologies.

If you understand the significance of the number 42; if you’ve ever dreamed of traveling in a blue British police box; if you are afraid of Winter coming; if more of your friends call you by your gamertag than your given name – there is a good chance you are a good fit for our team.

The Position-- You will be required to:

• Work within the development team to create, implement, and enhance internal systems and ensure high-quality solutions that meet business needs.
• Effectively communicate and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams through face-to-face, audio, and video conferencing to maintain alignment and drive work forward.
• Collaborate and coordinate with stakeholders, including customers, internal IT teams, and executives, to understand customer and business needs.
• Integrate stakeholder perspectives to effectively define and prioritize requirements, ensuring development efforts remain focused on delivering business value.
• Plan and coordinate development work across UX and development teams, establishing priorities, sequencing work, aligning cross-functional team members, and resolving issues to ensure teams have the clarity and direction needed to effectively deliver results.
• Manage the release of new features and enhancements, coordinating readiness, timing, dependencies, and communication with development teams and business stakeholders.
• Review and evaluate systems and solutions to ensure adherence to company business rules and customer quality standards.
• Communicate project, product, and release updates to Team Members at all levels of the company.
• Anticipate risks, dependencies, and obstacles that could impact successful delivery and escalate or coordinate resolution as appropriate.

The Candidate:  We are looking for:

• A versatile problem solver. On any given day, you may be researching a business process, defining product requirements, exploring solutions to a business challenge, meeting with customers, collaborating with UX and developers, testing a new feature, or digging into data to better understand a problem or opportunity.
• Strong product ownership skills. You understand how to maximize the value of a product and the development team.
• Strong planning and prioritization skills. You can turn product goals and business needs into an actionable plan, manage competing priorities and dependencies, and keep cross-functional teams aligned on what needs to happen next.
• Software development lifecycle knowledge. You understand how products move from discovery and design through development, testing, release, and ongoing enhancement. You are comfortable adapting your approach to the needs of the product and team rather than relying on a single development framework.
• An effective communicator. You believe you learn more by listening than talking. You can effectively communicate verbally and in writing including formal presentations to developers, non-technical peers and executives.
• A good fit with our team. We need someone the team can trust, rely on, bounce ideas off of, and interact with positively and professionally. You value collaboration, welcome different perspectives, and help the people around you succeed.
• An incredibly hard worker. You take ownership of your responsibilities and reliably see work through to completion without requiring constant direction. You know when to ask for help, communicate risks and bad news early, and look for opportunities to contribute beyond the task immediately in front of you.

The Technical-- You need to have or know:

• The ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with developers, UX professionals, customers, business stakeholders, and leaders at varying levels of technical expertise.
• Knowledge and experience with software product development practices with an understanding of how to identify and prioritize work that delivers meaningful business and customer value.
• Experience translating business and customer needs into clear, actionable product requirements and acceptance criteria that enable UX and development teams to effectively design, build, and deliver solutions.
• The ability to solve complex problems, make sound decisions, communicate clearly, and maintain a sense of urgency.
• Experience using analytical skills, tools, and techniques, including AI-enabled tools, to investigate issues, interpret data, evaluate opportunities, improve efficiency, and inform product decisions.
• The ability to plan, prioritize, and coordinate work across multiple priorities and dependencies while maintaining attention to detail and following through on commitments.
• Experience with software testing, defect identification and tracking, and validating that delivered solutions meet defined requirements and customer expectations.
• The capacity to thrive in a flexible and dynamic environment, contributing to a high-performance, driven corporate culture.

It would be nice for you to have or know:

• Scrum Product Owner role
• Roadmap planning
• SQL skills
• Kanban methodology
• Experience working with geographically dispersed teams

Note to Job Seekers: No telephone calls or walk-ins please. Interviews are by appointment only. Your resume will be reviewed and qualified candidates may be contacted in the event of a potential job match, or if further information is needed.

What We Offer:

Come build your future with our winning team, recognized by Fortune Magazine as one of the "100 Best Companies to Work For" 20 times! David Weekley Homes builds in 19 markets across the U.S. and is one of the largest private home builders in America.

jobs.title: DT&A Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

This position will be a technical manager and leader of the resources at LDC Grand Junction, for overseeing all instrumentation and control activities at the site including real time health of said systems in our DCS SCADA system. This position will be responsible for overseeing multiple operational technologies and electrical power systems. This includes directing LDC and 3rd party I&E technicians as needed, to support the efficient installation, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all instrumentation, measurement, control, power generation, and CSD devices for power generation both boiler steam and turbine electrical. This manager will also interface directly with the utility on incoming and outgoing power systems. This manager will be focused on optimizing the performance and reliability of all plant systems related to power generation, combustion, or instrumentation, driving preventative maintenance and repair initiatives, while maintaining world class safety standards and expectations. In addition, this manager will work closely with peers and other management to support operational objectives and foster enhanced team coordination. To be successful this individual should not only be highly technically adept, but also innovative, with a keen eye for detail and problem solving.

Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions

• Lead and manage the Instrumentation and Controls (I&C) team, including I&C technicians both internal and external, and support staff.
• Develop and implement training programs to enhance the technical skills and expertise of team members in control systems and instrumentation.
• Ability to work on-site in a power plant environment, perform hands-on tasks in the field solely or with the Solar team ensuring tasks are carried out efficiently and safely.
• Plan, prioritize, and oversee the maintenance of process automation systems to optimize steam and electrical power production, ensuring the reliable operation of boilers and environmental systems.
• Foster a safe work environment by promoting adherence to safety protocols and addressing unsafe practices or conditions.
• Cultivate strong communication and relationships across all teams
• Oversee maintenance activities related to electrical systems, process control, and automation systems, including installation, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and calibration, ensuring thorough documentation and peak system performance and reliability.
• Collaborate with Area Managers on routine electrical and mechanical engineering tasks as well as special projects.
• Supervise troubleshooting and maintenance of distributed control systems (DCS) and programmable logic controllers (PLC), including Allen Bradley, Schnieder and Solar systems and the ability to troubleshoot and evaluate plant performance issues using eDNA and historians.
• Oversee the reception, installation, and configuration of all process related servers, networks, and equipment
• Monitor all data communication platforms
• Organize and maintain all license support documents
• Prepare documentation diagrams, process control narratives, instrumentation lists, I/O lists, as any part of project design or maintenance activities
• Provide oversight and support for Solar workstation computer and related equipment maintenance.
• Ensure that all responsibilities are executed in accordance with LDC Management’s established expectations.
• Contribute to the annual budgeting process for maintenance-related parts and materials.
• Schedule and manage preventive maintenance (PM) calibration of various field instrumentation.
• Identify and report necessary spare parts for efficient plant operation and improvement initiatives to Area Managers and direct managers
• Offer technical guidance and mentorship to the I&E team, ensuring continuous development and expertise.
• Uphold plant policies and procedures, ensuring all tasks are performed safely and in compliance with environmental regulations.
• Participate in Process Safety, 3D Model and Design Reviews such as:PRA/PHA/HAZOPControl narrativesCause and Effect documentsElectrical Area Classification
• Take on additional responsibilities as required and mutually agreed upon with Primary Energy Management.

Additional Responsibilities

• Serve as one of the primary interfaces for engineering on instrumentation, electrical generation or boiler issues with operations.
• Problem solving and troubleshooting as requested by operations or maintenance when requested.
• Works with the Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) staff to assure regulatory certifications and compliance on capital and process improvements, normal operating practices regarding SHE
• Reviews plant operations for potential process / procedural improvements for higher throughput and / or cost savings.
• Maintains good working knowledge of SHE policies, rules and procedures applicable to area of responsibility and ensures all applicable requirements are adhered to.
• Ensure employees are provided required training for area assigned, and jobs and tasks prior to assigning work.
• Ensures unsafe working conditions are remedied as soon as practicable.
• Follows construction completion criteria and construction requirements with the maintenance manager.
• Assists in the project start-up with local management.
• Additional projects and duties as assigned.

Education/Professional Certifications/Licenses

The following is the basic qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering; Chemical, Electrical or automation/Instrumentation engineering
• Professional Engineer (P.Eng) is preferred.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) is desired.

Experience

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

Mirantis is seeking a Corporate Security Engineer to join our security team, based remotely in the United States. We're adding this role to extend our security operations coverage beyond EU hours and to bring additional hands-on capacity to the team — improving how quickly we detect, triage, and respond to issues across the working day.

This is a broad, hands-on engineering role covering the core of corporate security: endpoint protection (EDR) and device management (MDM), identity and access (IAM/SSO, MFA), and the detection-and-response stack (SIEM, alerting, and coordination with our existing external SOC). You will be part of the team that responds when something happens, and you'll help harden the environment so that fewer things do. Alongside this, you'll support our compliance program — ISO 27001, SOC 2, and related efforts — by operating and evidencing the controls these systems enforce.

In this role, you will operate and improve the tooling that protects our workforce and corporate environment, take part in incident response, and partner closely with IT, Product Security, and Compliance. You'll join a distributed team, bring US-hours ownership to work that currently leans on EU coverage, and have real latitude to raise the bar on how corporate security runs day to day.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Security & Device Management: Define and own the security policies, hardening baselines, and compliance posture for our EDR and MDM stack across the fleet, and drive threat response on endpoints. Partner with IT, who handle day-to-day enrollment and administration, so that devices are consistently enrolled, compliant, and protected across operating systems.

Identity & Access Management: Administer and strengthen identity and access — IAM/SSO, MFA, provisioning/deprovisioning, and least-privilege access reviews. Partner with IT to keep the identity layer both secure and workable for employees.

Detection, Monitoring & Incident Response: Operate the SIEM and detection tooling — tuning rules, triaging alerts, and investigating suspicious activity — and coordinate with our existing external SOC on monitoring and escalations. Take an active part in incident response end to end: investigation, containment, remediation, and root cause analysis. Contribute to post-incident reviews and runbooks, and bring US-hours ownership to work that currently leans on EU coverage.

Security Tooling & Hardening: Operate, integrate, and improve the broader corporate security toolset. Proactively harden the environment — configuration baselines, access controls, and reducing attack surface — so that fewer incidents occur in the first place.

Compliance Support: Support our compliance program (ISO 27001, SOC 2, and related efforts) by operating and evidencing the security controls these frameworks require. Partner with Compliance on audits, control mapping, and evidence collection.

Vulnerability & Threat Management: Track and help remediate vulnerabilities across endpoints and corporate systems. Stay current on relevant threats and translate them into concrete improvements to our posture.

Security Awareness & Phishing: Run and improve the security awareness program — training, phishing simulations, and employee-facing guidance. Help build a security-conscious culture and reduce the human attack surface across the company.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Coverage: Work closely with IT, Product Security, and Compliance as part of a distributed team. Extend security operations coverage into US time zones and help ensure smooth handoffs with EU-based colleagues.

Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in a corporate/enterprise security, security operations, or IT security engineering role.
• Hands-on experience with endpoint security (EDR) across macOS and Windows; experience with device management (MDM) and managing Linux endpoints is a plus.
• Strong working knowledge of identity and access management — SSO, MFA, and modern IAM platforms (e.g., Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, Google Workspace) — and least-privilege access practices.
• Experience operating a SIEM and detection tooling — writing and tuning rules, triaging alerts, and investigating suspicious activity. Experience with Splunk is preferred.
• Practical incident response experience — investigation, containment, remediation, and root cause analysis — and comfort coordinating with an external SOC/MSSP.
• Solid grasp of security fundamentals — network and host hardening, common attack techniques, and how to reduce attack surface.
• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and experience operating or evidencing security controls.
• Experience with vulnerability management and translating findings into concrete remediation.
• A collaborative working style suited to a distributed team, with clear written communication and reliable handoffs across time zones.
• Based in the United States, with the ability to provide security operations coverage during US business hours.
• Scripting/automation ability (Python, Bash, PowerShell) to streamline security operations is a strong plus; alternatively, a demonstrated ability and strong desire to pick these up quickly.
• Experience running security awareness and phishing-simulation programs is a plus.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, GIAC/GCIH/GCIA, CISSP, or vendor-specific EDR/SIEM/IAM certs) are a plus.
• Exposure to cloud and SaaS security posture (AWS, Google Workspace, M365) is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
• Professional development and training;
• Attend conferences and working groups;
• Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
• Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

jobs.title: Head of Sales, Legal
jobs.description:
About Centari

At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them.

Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can.

The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it.

We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition.

For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Sales, Legal to own new business in the law firm market: the relationships, the deals, and the playbook for how Centari expands its market share with the most demanding transactional practices in the world.

This role is based in our New York office, with travel of up to 30%.

What You'll Own

 - Revenue. You run the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed six or seven-figure engagement, working with law firm partners and knowledge management and innovation leaders. You’ll start with both a warm pipeline and target list and make every relationship your own from the first meeting.

 - The vertical playbook. Positioning, messaging, outbound, and account targeting for AmLaw and Magic Circle firms. You build the system that keeps the pipeline full, and you set the pilot and pricing guardrails the team sells within.

 - Partnerships. Centari's channel and integration partners open doors into law firms. You make sure every introduction turns into a real opportunity and, where it earns it, a closed deal.

 - The function itself. As the law firm business grows, you'll have the room to shape how Centari serves the market and to grow with it.

What You Bring

 - You've personally sourced and closed six-to-seven-figure deals with sophisticated buyers, ideally law firm partners, and you can run a multi-stakeholder sale end to end without a playbook handed to you. Come with a specific example: how you reached the decision maker, what they needed to see, and what closed it.

 - 10+ years in or selling into law firms, including enterprise sales of software, data, or information services to AmLaw or Magic Circle firms; time in practice at a leading transactional firm counts toward it. You bring real law firm relationships or the sales background to build them fast.

 - You've personally built part of a sales motion before: an outbound program, an account plan, a piece of positioning you wrote and tested yourself.

 - You have the executive presence to hold your own with a law firm partner and the discipline to run your own pipeline before there's a team under you.

 - Nice to have: you've generated demand and closed deals at an early-stage company without an established category or team behind you.

What We Offer

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Comprehensive health coverage (Centari covers 100% of employee premiums)

 - Dental and vision (Centari covers 75% of employee premiums)

 - 401(k) with employer match up to 4%

 - Lunch covered for in-office team

 - Flexible PTO

• Participate in case rounds, continuing education opportunities, mentorship activities, and hospital-wide clinical improvement programs.

Why Orchard Park and Western New York?

Located just outside Buffalo, Orchard Park offers an exceptional quality of life with the perfect balance of career opportunity and personal fulfillment. Whether you're looking for outdoor adventure, a family-friendly community, or a vibrant place to build your career, Orchard Park offers the best of both worlds—a rewarding professional environment and an outstanding place to call home.

• Generous paid time off

• Opportunity to help shape and expand a growing oncology service

• Supportive leadership team committed to your success and professional growth

Make a Difference

If you are passionate about advancing cancer care, building meaningful client relationships, and collaborating with a talented team of veterinary professionals, we invite you to join Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center and make a lasting impact on pets, families, and referring veterinarians throughout Western New York.

• DVM or equivalent degree from an accredited veterinary school.
• Board Certification in Oncology (ACVIM) or completion of an Oncology Residency with intent to pursue board certification.

• Experience with diagnostic imaging interpretation, cytology, cancer staging, and chemotherapy protocol development.

Here, your work matters. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, rewards curiosity, and gives you the tools to keep growing. Whether you’re just getting started or looking for your next big challenge, this is a place where you can thrive and make a real impact.

Making robotic surgery accessible to every patient starts with exceptional people. As Intuitive grows globally, the Vice President, Talent Acquisition will help us attract and hire the talent to advance that ambition—and build a TA organization ready to deliver at greater scale.

We’re looking for someone who takes the time to understand the business and its people, earns trust through honest conversations and follow-through, and brings fresh perspective to how we work. A leader who listens closely, challenges thoughtfully, and gives people a clear reason to embrace change.

Working closely with executives, Finance, and HR, you’ll help shape the talent decisions behind our growth. You’ll build on the team’s strengths while making the changes needed to simplify hiring, strengthen our global capabilities, and deliver consistently across markets.

What you’ll lead:

This individual must be passionate about building a strong team in support of a great company.  We’re looking for a leader who is deeply curious about the business, builds trusted relationships across teams and across regions, and sees opportunities to rethink how we attract and hire talent globally. Someone who brings fresh perspectives, turns ideas into results, and inspires a global team to do its best work. This is an opportunity to shape the future of TA at a defining moment in Intuitive’s growth.

What this looks like:

• Shape talent strategy with the business. Engage executives and our HR function early in business planning. Translate growth priorities into a multi-year talent acquisition strategy, bringing informed advice on talent availability, location, and hiring trade-offs.
• Connect workforce plans to delivery. Build a regular planning rhythm with Finance, the business, and HR that aligns hiring priorities, timing, investment, and recruiting capacity. Own global hiring performance and the TA budget, making commitments clear and addressing gaps early.
• Build a truly global function. Strengthen regional leadership and recruiting capabilities, particularly outside the US. Involve regional teams in designing shared systems and processes so they work across markets, with clear accountability and room for local judgment.
• Bring fresh thinking to how we hire. Question processes that add work without adding value. Introduce technology, automation, and new approaches where they improve hiring outcomes, and help teams adopt changes that make a lasting difference.
• Make data meaningful. Bring together hiring performance, talent market intelligence, and workforce trends to explain what’s changing, why it matters, and what we should do next. Help leaders use those insights to make better decisions about priorities, investment, and risk.
• Develop an exceptional team. Give leaders and recruiters clear direction, meaningful development, and the support to become trusted talent advisors. Invite different perspectives, coach candidly, and follow through on commitments. Lead change in a way that helps people understand the purpose and take ownership of the outcome.
• Lead as one HR team. Work closely with HR Business Leaders and Partners and Centers of Excellence—including Talent Management, Total Rewards, People Analytics, People Services, and Inclusion & Diversity—to solve talent challenges together. Connect hiring with broader talent priorities and share accountability for an inclusive, effective hiring experience and compliant practices across markets.

What you’ll bring:

• Global TA leadership at scale: 15+ years of demonstrated TA leadership experience, including 10+ years leading people and managing TA leaders across regions. This is a role where that global depth truly matters. This is a centralized, global function with significant growth ahead, and you've been here before: scaling TA functions through periods of rapid growth, building and leading recruiting across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas, and standing up teams in new markets from the ground up. You understand what it takes to hire effectively in diverse geographies — local labor markets, regulatory environments, cultural nuances in candidate experience, and how to design shared systems that actually work across regions without sacrificing local judgment. Ideally, you've lived or worked in-region, not just managed from headquarters — giving you firsthand perspective on what global recruiting really requires on the ground.
• Industry depth: Background recruiting in hardware manufacturing, technology manufacturing, or similarly complex, highly technical environments — with a strong grasp of the talent landscape, competitive dynamics, and specialized hiring challenges those industries demand.
• Talent magnet: A reputation for building organizations and employer brands that top talent wants to join. You know how to position a company compellingly in competitive markets and create candidate experiences that convert.
• Deep partnership and influence: A highly collaborative approach, with the credibility to advise executives and build strong partnerships with Finance, HR Business Leaders and Partners, and Centers of Excellence to deliver shared outcomes.
• Exceptional people leadership and team development: An open, transparent style that builds trust across cultures. You invest deeply in developing strong leaders, create clear expectations and accountability, and leave teams meaningfully better than you found them.
• Problem solving and business judgment: A natural problem solver who cuts through complexity, connects the dots across competing priorities, and brings practical, high-impact solutions. Strong business and HR acumen, with the ability to translate data into a clear story — connecting insights to business priorities, investment decisions, and action.
• Innovation and operational results: Demonstrated success modernizing TA through technology, automation, and simpler processes, while managing competing priorities and delivering measurable improvements in hiring quality, speed, and cost.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
• Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.

jobs.title: Freelance Campaign Manager, Sports & Entertainment (US)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



Fully remote · Freelance, up to 3 months with potential for extension · Multiple roles

across verticals · Must work 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET)

Immediate start. We have freelance campaign roles available right now, and we're looking to fill them quickly.

 


FREELANCE OPPORTUNITIES

We're hiring freelance Campaign Managers across four verticals: AI and tech, fintech, sports and beauty. Each freelancer works predominantly with one client.

Our clients want to be great at creator marketing, and they move quickly. Briefs evolve once a campaign is live, and our best campaign managers enjoy shaping them with the client.

 
 


YOUR ROLE

- Day-to-day delivery on your campaigns is yours

- You cast, negotiate with and contract creators

- You keep the client updated day to day on progress and performance

- Your campaign lead sets direction, and a director leads strategic client conversations

 


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

Commercial

- You hit the CPV or CPM agreed with the client. You watch reach and engagement closely and shift budget or creators mid-campaign to stay on target

- You negotiate rates that fit the budget, and creators are keen to work with us again

- When a client wants to add a link in bio or a repost, you scope and cost it with them first

 

Casting

- Your casting lists are culturally spot on and go beyond the usual names, often to creators we haven't discovered yet

- You turn a brief like "performance marketer who's also a TikTok creator" into clear search filters

- Your creator briefs and scripts get the content right first time

- You hold every piece of content to a high standard before it reaches the client

 

Platform, AI and data

- You're running full campaigns in our platform from day one: discovery, casting, outreach, contracts, payments and reporting. Experience with other influencer marketing tech platforms is a huge plus

- Your outreach works at volume and still feels personal

- AI is part of your daily workflow for research, outreach and briefs, and you check its

output

- You know TikTok, Instagram and YouTube analytics inside out

 

Complexity

- Complex, bespoke accounts are your comfort zone, and that experience carries over to high-volume work

- You've freelanced in agile, fast-moving teams, like a big beauty group, an agency or a

tech start-up. You get up to speed quickly and adapt when priorities shift

 

Communication and leadership

- Your writing is clear and confident, and everyone knows what's happening

- Clients hear from you before they need to ask, and your performance updates are easy to follow

- You stay composed on tough client calls and keep the relationship strong

- You flag risks early, with a fix in mind

- Leadership gets honest numbers from you, including when results are behind

- You give your Campaign Manager clear direction and useful feedback

- You build strong relationships with our Client Solutions and Strategy teams, and with your creators

We're growing our beauty team fast. If you've worked with beauty or fragrance brands, we'd especially love to hear from you.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

- 3+ years in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management

- A solid grasp of how influencer campaigns run end to end

- Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms for discovery, outreach and reporting

- Creator negotiation and contracting experience, including usage rights

- Some client-facing experience, ideally with enterprise brands

- Campaign experience and strong US cultural knowledge in AI and tech, fintech, sports or beauty

- Availability 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET), Monday to Friday. This is mandatory,

wherever you're based

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

GridCARE is a leading venture-backed startup solving the most critical constraint in AI’s growth trajectory: immediate access to power. As demand for computing skyrockets, access to energy has become the defining bottleneck in the AI infrastructure race. While leading tech companies invest billions in speculative, long-term solutions that may take decades to arrive, GridCARE’s pioneering physics-based generative AI platform unlocks gigawatts of hidden capacity in today’s electric grid — enabling hyperscalers, data center developers, and utilities to power AI infrastructure years sooner than conventional approaches and without costly upgrades.

Founded at Stanford’s Doerr School of Sustainability and backed by leading climate-tech and deep-tech investors, GridCARE has assembled a world-class team spanning power systems, AI, and infrastructure.



Learn more about GridCARE:

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for a product engineer with infrastructure instincts and a platform mindset. You'll build a cloud-based system that manages and operates data centers for some of the largest AI compute providers in the world, the kind of infrastructure that powers the leading cloud and chip companies driving the AI boom. You'll be the one owning the architecture, the decisions, and how it runs in production. Reliability isn't optional. When it's live, it has to stay live, stay accurate, and update safely without ever putting a customer's infrastructure at risk.

The role is best suited for an experienced Senior to Staff-level engineer who can independently architect, build, and operate mission-critical backend systems in production. What matters most is depth: real experience in architecting, implementing, tuning, and debugging real time systems that have to run reliably in production, and genuine curiosity about growing that depth into broader platform and infrastructure ownership as GridCARE scales. 






RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build a cloud native backend platform that is reliable, real time, scalable, and secure, including:
   
   - Time series data storage and retrieval
   
   - Real time streaming and event processing
   
   - Integrations with simulation, forecasting, optimization, and market modules

 - Design for continuous deployment and safe updates to live, mission critical infrastructure, so systems keep running without disruption or unexpected side effects.

 - Lead code quality and engineering excellence: automated testing, continuous deployment, CI/CD pipeline development, performance tuning, and system observability.

 - Own architecture decisions with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, cybersecurity, and suitability for on premises control center deployments.

 - Collaborate across disciplines, working alongside data scientists, power systems engineers, and DevOps teams to bring AI driven solutions from prototype to production in mission critical environments.

 - Own services end to end, from design through deployment and ongoing operation.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - 7+ years of experience architecting, implementing, and operating cloud native, real-time backend systems that are highly available, reliable, secure, and scalable.

 - Strong software architecture, distributed systems, concurrency, and security fundamentals.

 - Proficiency in at least one backend language, e.g., Python.

 - Strong experience with REST/gRPC API design and event-driven architectures.

 - Experience with time series data, real time streaming, and databases across relational and non relational systems (e.g., Kafka, MQTT, TimescaleDB, or similar).

 - Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and production operations.

 - Experience with AI assisted development tools such as Cursor, CodeRabbit, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, comfortable prioritizing and working cross functionally in a startup environment with limited guidance and evolving requirements.

Preferred

 - Someone who's passionate about making a real difference in the world.

 - An entrepreneurial self starter with a focus on scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

 - Background in energy, climate tech, power systems, or other complex infrastructure domains, including grid operations.

 - Experience with industrial telemetry systems such as SCADA or Ignition.




LOCATION

 - This is a hybrid, in-office role based in Redwood City, California. Only candidates currently located in the area or planning to relocate will be considered.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Lunch is provided three days a week in the office.

 - Hybrid schedule: 3 days in office for collaboration, 2 days remote for focused work.

 - Access to leading academic, industry, and government partners in the AI-energy ecosystem.

 - A mission-driven team focused on shaping the future of the energy transition.

 


SALARY RANGE

$184,000 - $284,000 Total



Join us in tackling one of the most important infrastructure challenges of our time — enabling the energy foundation for the age of AI.

Navan is seeking a high-energy, hands-on Director of Procurement to lead, optimize, and scale our procurement organization. What You’ll Do:

• End-to-End Ownership: Act as a trusted advisor on purchasing strategy, drive cost reduction, build cross-functional alignment, and maintain spend transparency for executive leadership.

• Complex Vendor Negotiations: Drive commercial and contractual negotiations across external suppliers. Partner closely with internal stakeholders, Legal, GRC, and FP&A to maximize value, optimize total cost, and mitigate risk.

• Category Strategy: Align with executive leadership to develop and execute comprehensive category strategies across Enterprise functions, GTM, Marketing, and Professional Services.

• Operational Excellence & Workflow Rebuilding: Rebuild, streamline, and optimize end-to-end procurement workflows and contract management processes within Zip to fix operational bottlenecks and scale efficiently

Versant is seeking a Senior Accounting Analyst, Entertainment and Sports to support accounting and financial reporting activities across its Entertainment & Sports portfolio. This role will be an integral member of the TV Networks Controllership team, supporting the monthly and quarterly close, financial analysis, internal controls, and reporting for the business.

The Senior Accounting Analyst will partner across Controllership, FP&A, and other business functions to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting while helping identify opportunities to improve and automate accounting processes as Versant continues to evolve as an independent public company.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the monthly and quarterly financial close for Versant’s Entertainment & Sports entities, ensuring accurate and timely recording of transactions in accordance with U.S. GAAP and company policies.
• Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting analyses across key balance sheet and income statement accounts.
• Support accounting and analysis for key TV Networks activities, including production, marketing, and other revenue and expense areas.
• Review transactions for proper accounting treatment, coding, entity usage, and support within SAP and related reporting systems.
• Support revenue-recognition analysis under ASC 606, including contract review, identification of performance obligations, assessment of variable consideration, and maintenance of related accounting schedules.
• Prepare and analyze financial reporting and account activity, investigate variances, and partner with relevant teams to resolve accounting issues.
• Maintain documentation and execute assigned SOX controls, and support internal and external audit requests.
• Collaborate with FP&A, Controllership, Legal, and other business teams to support accounting requirements and ensure alignment across financial reporting activities.
• Support enhancements to accounting processes, reporting tools, and systems, identifying opportunities to standardize, simplify, and automate recurring activities.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 2–4 years of Accounting and/or Finance experience, preferably within media, entertainment, sports, or a related industry.
• Strong Knowledge of U.S. GAAP, general accounting principles, revenue recognition and financial reporting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across Finance and business teams.

Desired Characteristics

• CPA or progress towards CPA preferred.
• Experience within the media, entertainment, television, or sports industry.
• Advanced Excel skills and experience with SAP, Blackline or other enterprise ERP and financial reporting systems.
• Experience working within a SOX-compliant public company environment.
• Interest in process improvement, automation, and Finance transformation.
• Ability to manage competing priorities, meet close deadlines, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the Englewood Cliffs, NJ office a minimum of three days per week.

Job Title: Foreman

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Loenbro South
Location: Afton, TX / On-site
Reports to: Site Superintendent
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Position Summary

The Foreman is responsible for overseeing and coordinating daily pipeline construction, installation, maintenance, and repair activities. This role provides direct supervision to field crews, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in compliance with company standards, client requirements, and regulatory guidelines. The Pipeline Foreman serves as the primary field leader and acts as the key liaison between craft personnel, subcontractors, and project management.

Essential Responsibilities

• Supervise and direct pipeline construction crews in the installation, maintenance, and repair of pipeline systems.

• Plan and coordinate daily work activities, manpower, equipment, and material requirements.

• Review project drawings, specifications, alignment sheets, and construction schedules.

• Conduct daily safety meetings and enforce all company, client, and regulatory safety requirements.

• Ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, environmental, and company policies.

• Coordinate excavation, trenching, pipe installation, welding, coating, hydrostatic testing, tie-ins, and restoration activities.

• Verify elevations, grades, alignments, and installation requirements are met according to project specifications.

• Monitor crew productivity, project progress, and quality standards.

• Identify and resolve field issues that could impact project schedules or budgets.

• Coordinate with inspectors, utility companies, landowners, subcontractors, and project stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate daily reports, production records, timesheets, equipment utilization reports, and safety documentation.

• Ensure proper use, maintenance, and accountability of company equipment and tools.

• Train and mentor crew members, fostering a culture of safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

• Assist project management with project planning, forecasting, and resource allocation.

• Participate in incident investigations and implement corrective actions when necessary.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED.

• 5+ years of pipeline construction experience.

• 2+ years of supervisory or foreman experience leading pipeline crews.

• Strong understanding of pipeline construction methods, excavation, trench safety, and utility coordination.

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, alignment sheets, and survey information.

• Knowledge of OSHA regulations and industry safety standards.

• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

• Ability to pass pre-employment and client-required screenings.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with oil & gas, natural gas, water, wastewater, or industrial pipeline projects.

• OSHA 30 Certification.

• NCCER Foreman Certification.

• First Aid/CPR Certification.

• Competent Person Trenching and Excavation Certification.

• Experience managing subcontractors and multiple work crews.

• Knowledge of hydrostatic testing, welding inspection processes, and pipeline integrity requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong leadership and team management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

• Strong understanding of pipeline construction equipment and methods.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills.

• Commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

• Ability to work effectively with project managers, superintendents, inspectors, clients, and field personnel.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and travel as project demands require.

• Ability to safely access active construction sites and uneven terrain.

Work Environment

• Heavy civil and pipeline construction projects.

• Exposure to construction equipment, noise, dust, vibration, and changing weather conditions.

• Travel between project locations may be required.

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

jobs.title: Project Control Officer/Manager
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

Project Controls (Core Focus)

 - Own and maintain project/build schedules covering hardware and R&D milestones.

 - Track spend against budget across project workstreams; flag variances and help prepare forecasts.

 - Prepare weekly/monthly status reports on schedule progress, budget position, and key risks for leadership.

 - Maintain the project risk and issue log, and follow up on action items across teams.

 - Support change control — logging and tracking scope, schedule, or budget changes as projects evolve.

 - Build and maintain dashboards (Excel, Power BI a plus) that give a clear, single view of schedule and cost status.

Supply Chain Awareness (Supporting, Not Primary)

 - Monitor delivery status of critical long-lead components and contracted work (cryogenics, optics, lasers, RF electronics) as an input to the schedule — not managing procurement itself.

 - Flag to the procurement team when a part's status puts a milestone at risk, and reflect that in your reporting.

 - Coordinate with procurement/lab teams to keep schedule data accurate, without owning vendor relationships, RFQs, or purchase orders.

Cross-functional Coordination

 - Act as the point person for "where do things stand" across schedule, budget, and key dependencies — pulling information from hardware leads, program managers, and procurement into one coherent picture.

 - Support project audits, close-out documentation, and lessons-learned tracking.



Qualifications:

Essential

 - 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, project controls, program/business operations, or a related analytical role — internships and adjacent experience count. 

 - Degree in Engineering, Physics, Business, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

 - Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfortable building and maintaining schedules, trackers, and dashboards; advanced Excel/Power BI advantageous.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable pulling status updates from multiple people and systems. 

 - Clear written and verbal communication — you'll be reporting schedule and budget status to technical and leadership audiences alike.

Desirable

 - Exposure to hardware, lab, or fab environments (physics, optics, cryogenics, semiconductor, or similar deep-tech programs). 

 - Formal project management qualification

 - Exposure to procurement or supply chain coordination (including buy, ally, DIY decisions) is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 - Interest in quantum computing or emerging hardware technology.

 - Regular company outings, team building and training opportunities.

 - Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Digital Content and Social - GolfNow & GolfPass
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Versant is seeking a Senior Director, Digital Content & Social to lead digital content, editorial, social, and audience strategy across GolfNow and GolfPass. Reporting to the VP, GolfNow Marketplace Growth, this leader will build a shared content and audience engine designed to grow reach, strengthen brand relevance, deepen golfer engagement, and connect content performance to broader business outcomes.

You will set the multi-brand content and channel strategy, establish priorities and operating rhythms, and provide leadership across editorial, social and community, audience development, and content operations. You will bring together shared capabilities across GolfNow and GolfPass while ensuring each brand maintains a distinct voice, audience strategy, and business agenda.

This role also has a significant mandate to advance how the organization uses AI, automation, and emerging technology. You will identify practical applications across ideation, research, production, editing, publishing, distribution, personalization, measurement, and optimization—balancing experimentation and speed with strong editorial judgment, brand standards, and responsible use.

Why This Role Matters: Golfers increasingly discover, engage with, and build relationships with brands through content, creators, communities, and digital platforms. This role will shape how GolfNow and GolfPass show up in those environments, create stronger connections with golfers, and establish a more integrated and measurable approach to content and audience growth.

Success will be measured through clear audience and business outcomes, including audience growth, engagement quality, content efficiency, qualified traffic and actions, channel health, and the ability to translate performance insights into better content and investment decisions.

This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from our Orlando office a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Do

• Set the content and audience strategy. Define how GolfNow and GolfPass show up across social, video, editorial, owned platforms, and emerging channels, with clear objectives, audience priorities, channel roles, and measures of success for each brand.
• Lead an integrated content organization. Provide strategic leadership across social and community, editorial, audience development, programming, and content operations while creating planning processes that connect these disciplines rather than treating them as separate workstreams.
• Accelerate content through AI and innovation. Build and execute a roadmap for applying AI, automation, and emerging tools to increase content velocity, improve workflows, support personalization and adaptation, and create scalable operating models while maintaining appropriate human judgment and oversight.
• Grow audiences and strengthen communities. Develop platform-native strategies across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and emerging channels; advance social listening, creator participation, real-time engagement, experimentation, and community-building approaches.
• Turn performance insights into action. Establish a measurement framework and scorecard for audience and content performance, partner with Analytics to understand audience behavior and conversion signals, and use those insights to guide content choices, experimentation, resource allocation, and investment.
• Build and lead a high-performing team. Develop managers and individual contributors across multiple disciplines, establish clear accountability and decision rights, create effective operating rhythms, and partner across Marketplace Growth, GolfPass Membership, Product, Production, Marketing, Analytics, Ad Sales, Finance, Legal, Technology, and other stakeholders.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of progressive experience in digital content, social media, audience development, digital publishing, media, or another relevant consumer-facing discipline, including 5+ years leading and developing teams.
• Demonstrated success building digital content and social strategies that grow audiences and engagement, with a strong understanding of audience development, content distribution, platform algorithms, and digital performance measurement.
• Experience leading across multiple content formats, such as social-first video, long-form video, editorial, creator content, and owned digital platforms, along with experience overseeing editorial, publishing, or content-production operations.
• Hands-on curiosity and experience with generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies, including the ability to turn successful experiments into practical, scalable workflows while maintaining standards for quality, brand integrity, and responsible use.
• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate audience, cultural, and performance insights into strategy, experimentation, prioritization, and resource-allocation decisions.
• Strong executive communication, people leadership, and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to operate across multiple brands, stakeholders, and competing business priorities.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Experience in sports, golf, media, entertainment, marketplaces, subscription businesses, or other passion-driven consumer categories is a plus.
• Trust: You build credibility through sound judgment, responsible decision-making, and a commitment to maintaining strong editorial and brand standards.
• Teamwork: You bring multidisciplinary teams together around shared goals and build productive partnerships across functions, brands, and levels of the organization.
• Transparency: You communicate priorities, decisions, performance, and tradeoffs clearly, creating alignment and clarity for teams and stakeholders.
• Agility: You adapt quickly to changing audience behaviors, platforms, technologies, and business needs, using experimentation and insights to evolve the approach.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: You challenge traditional ways of working, identify opportunities to innovate, and turn new ideas and technologies into meaningful audience and business impact.

Why You’ll Love It Here

This is an opportunity to shape the future of digital content and audience engagement across two established golf brands while leading work at the intersection of content, community, technology, and growth. You’ll have the scope to build new capabilities, develop talent, experiment with emerging technology, and influence how GolfNow and GolfPass connect with golfers across platforms.

You’ll work with teams across content, product, marketing, membership, technology, analytics, production, and commercial functions, giving this role significant visibility and the opportunity to connect creative strategy directly to measurable audience and business outcomes.

This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from our Orlando office a minimum of three days per week.

The Staff Pharmacist is responsible for daily patient care including processing prescriptions, inspecting completed prescriptions prior to shipment, patient counseling and prospective and concurrent Drug Use Review. • Routine patient touches to review and document adherence (compliance) and persistence and to assess the impact of prescribed therapy.

• Process and verify patient prescriptions.

• Counsel patients to prepare and to motivate adherence to pharmacotherapeutic regimens.

• Evaluate drug use including prospective and concurrent drug use review.

• Evaluate lab values and clinically available patient history including concomitant medications, allergies, and disease states.

• Educate, coach and supervise pharmacy technicians.

• Monitor REMS adherence and documentation standards as required.

• Manage patient adverse events including reporting and reconciliation.

• Resolve and document all after hours inquiries from patients and prescribers including occasional emergency dispensing and shipping.

jobs.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What You'll Do

As an engineer on SimpliSafe's Video team you will build and maintain the cloud-based systems that empower customers to interact with their home security cameras from anywhere in the world.

We're looking for a motivated, experienced Distinguished Software Engineer to design, develop, maintain and own software solutions. We're a backend team solving large-scale video streaming and recording problems to ensure customers have real-time control and visibility into their cameras. You'll be working with our stack of Go, C#, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes, SQS, SNS, ffmpeg, WebRTC.

The safety of our customers is important, and as such our key pillars are reliability, simplicity, and performance.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

• Bring your wealth of video knowledge to build and improve SimpliSafe’s video services.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and design simple, reliable, flexible solutions.

• Drive the implementation of those solutions, both by writing code yourself and supporting other engineers with code reviews and mentoring.

• Long-term support & maintenance work, such as performance optimization, bug fixes, feature additions, design and usability improvements, and automation.

• Document the systems you are building to ensure they can be maintained by the next generation of developers.

• Serve as an on-call first responder for software owned by your team.

What You'll Bring

• 10+ years of industry experience, including having owned the architecture of a production backend system end-to-end, from design through long-term operational ownership.

• 4+ years designing, building, or operating a real-time or low-latency video streaming service, e.g. HLS/DASH delivery

• Experience architecting cloud video storage systems at scale such as designing cost-efficient storage tiers, lifecycle and archival policies, and retention strategies that hold up across millions of recording devices.

• Experience designing metadata and indexing systems for video - enabling fast retrieval and scrubbing of recorded clips by camera, timestamp, or event across large-scale datasets.

• Deep expertise in the implementation of HLS/DASH, fragmented MP4 (fmp4), H.264, and AAC.

• Familiarity with video streaming standards such as adaptive bitrate packaging, video codecs (HEVC, AV1), and transport protocols (SRT, RTMP, WHIP, MoQ).

• Experience with technologies such as WebRTC, GStreamer, ffmpeg, or libav.

• Proven ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decision-making within a team.

• Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Go, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, etc.).

• Passion, curiosity and a desire to continuously learn and grow.

• Extensive experience with AWS, GCP or Azure.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and proven track record to break down complexity.

• Experience with IoT or smart home video streaming applications is a plus.

• Familiarity with the Agile Scrum process.

What Values You’ll Share

• Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.

• Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.

• No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.

• One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.

• Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.

• Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

• A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive

• A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)

• Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $193,900 to $258,500

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others.
