jobs.description:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview of Opportunity
Two Six Technologies is searching for a Cyber Mission Analyst to help translate advanced cyber capabilities into effective operational employment for our government customers. This role sits at the intersection of cyber operations, engineering, and mission execution. The selected candidate will work closely with operators and developers to understand mission requirements, develop schemes of maneuver, and demonstrate how technical capabilities can be applied to real-world operational problems.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on offensive and/or defensive cyber experience, strong technical judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with both operators and software engineers. You will become deeply familiar with our technical capabilities, understand their strengths and limitations, develop creative approaches to mission challenges, and lead technical demonstrations that show customers what is operationally possible.
This work will be onsite in Arlington, VA.
Responsibilities:

• Develop and refine cyber schemes of maneuver that translate operational objectives and mission requirements into executable technical approaches.

• Work directly with government agencies and mission users to understand operational needs, user stories, use cases, constraints, and desired mission outcomes.

• Build, rehearse, and deliver technically credible demonstrations that show how capabilities can be deployed in realistic cyber environments.

• Develop a deep understanding of TST capabilities, architectures, workflows, and limitations and communicate those effectively to technical and operational audiences.

• Collaborate closely with software developers and engineers to translate operator feedback and mission needs into technical requirements, improvements, and potential workarounds.

• Apply offensive and defensive cyber operations expertise to evaluate how existing and emerging capabilities can be integrated into customer missions.

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including during demonstrations, exercises, testing, and other customer-facing activities.

• Capture feedback from demonstrations and technical syncs with external stakeholders to better inform, improve, and reprioritize internal development and integration efforts.

• Document SOPs, technical procedures, and operational workflows and identify opportunities to iteratively improve processes.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience supporting or conducting offensive and/or defensive cyber operations, cyberspace operations, or intelligence missions.

• Strong working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, networking concepts and protocols, and common cyber operations workflows.

• Understanding of offensive/defensive tradecraft, attack lifecycle frameworks (ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain), and signature management/OPSEC constraints.

• Demonstrated ability to understand cyber mission objectives and translate them into technical approaches and workflows.

• Experience developing, delivering, and leading technical demonstrations.

• Ability to understand complex software systems and work directly with engineers to identify and troubleshoot technical issues.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently, solve ambiguous technical problems, and adapt quickly as mission requirements change.

• Strong collaboration skills and experience working across multidisciplinary teams of operators, engineers, developers, and government stakeholders.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience/familiarity with SQL, relational databases, Python/bash scripting.

• Experience/familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.

• Experience with cloud computing platforms such as Azure and AWS.

• Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, CEH

• Active Top Secret Clearance is required with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 



Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.



About the Role

We're looking for a Sr. Director of Machine Learning to lead the teams building the AI services at the core of the Hims & Hers experience. This leader owns the applied side of our AI portfolio: the LLM-powered services that handle clinical intake, provider support, personalization, and operational workflows, as well as the in-house deep learning models that drive recommendations and predictions where accuracy and clinical soundness matter most.

This is a builder's leadership role. You'll set the technical direction for how we turn foundation models and custom models into dependable production services, grow a team of ML modelers and ML production engineers, and partner with our ML platform and evaluation organization to make sure what we ship is measurable, safe, and continuously improving.



You will:

 - Lead and grow ML engineers, applied scientists, and ML production engineers building AI services end to end — from problem framing through production operation.

 - Own the strategy for how we build on top of frontier LLMs: prompt and context design, retrieval, tool and function calling, agentic workflows, structured output reliability, fallback and degradation behavior, latency and cost management.

 - Drive the design of the harnesses and glue around LLM calls — orchestration, validation, guardrails, deterministic scaffolding — so probabilistic components produce dependable, auditable outputs inside product and clinical workflows.

 - Direct development of in-house deep learning and classical ML models where a custom model outperforms a general-purpose one, including clinical and recommendation use cases such as medication and treatment-plan recommendations surfaced to providers.

 - Set the bar for how AI services are productionized: SLOs for accuracy, latency and cost, graceful failure, rollout strategy, and clear ownership of production behavior.

 - Make build-versus-fine-tune-versus-prompt decisions deliberately, and revisit them as model capabilities and pricing shift.

 - Partner with Clinical and Medical Affairs to ensure clinically-facing models are developed with appropriate oversight, validation, and human-in-the-loop design; ensure providers stay in control of clinical decisions.

 - Partner closely with the ML infrastructure and evaluation team members to define evaluation criteria, feedback loops, and annotation needs for every service your team ships — and to hold your team accountable to the resulting metrics.

 - Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Security, Legal, and Compliance to translate ambiguous business and clinical problems into scoped, high-leverage ML work.

 - Establish engineering and scientific standards across the team: experiment design, model documentation, reproducibility, code quality, and responsible AI practices.

 - Build the team's hiring, leveling, and mentorship practices; develop senior individual contributors and managers.

 - Act as a senior technical voice in the AI organization, shaping multi-year roadmap and investment decisions and representing AI strategy to executive leadership.

You have:

 - 14+ years of experience in machine learning and software engineering, including 8+ years leading ML teams and experience managing managers or senior tech leads.

 - A track record of shipping ML-powered products to production at scale — not just prototypes or research — and owning them operationally over time.

 - Depth in understanding modern LLM application development: RAG, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and adaptation, evaluation, agent and tool-calling architectures, and the practical limits of each.

 - Real experience training and deploying deep learning models (recommendation, ranking, classification, or sequence models) where model quality directly affects user or business outcomes.

 - Strong software architecture judgment — you can reason about service boundaries, data flow, failure modes, and cost as fluently as you can about model architecture.

 - Experience balancing model quality against latency, cost, and operational complexity, and making those tradeoffs legible to non-technical partners.

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity: taking a vague, high-value problem and turning it into a shipped system with measurable impact.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence peers, executives, and clinical stakeholders.

 - Bonus: experience in healthcare, digital health, or another regulated domain or with safety-critical ML systems.

 - Bonus: experience with clinical decision support, clinical NLP, or ML systems where a human expert is the end user.

This leader will actively drive the development and execution of strategies related to commercial data, analytics, and data services. The role focuses on optimizing quality, unifying access, and streamlining analytics for a diverse set of pharma-specific data, including sales, patient, prescriber, claims, and promotional analytics. The position will partner closely with AbbVie’s Analytics & Performance Insights, IT, and cross-functional Procurement teams to deliver improved financial, operational, and marketing outcomes.

Core Responsibilities:

• Lead a team of category management professionals to create best-in-class strategies for AbbVie’s procurement of commercial data and analytics services.
• Build comprehensive long-range category strategies for sourcing and managing data sets such as sales data, physician and prescriber data, patient-level claims data, promotional response data, and market analytics
• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, unify access protocols, and streamline analytics workflows across business units, and work cross-functionally to implement.
• Build constructive relationships with stakeholders in functions related to data governance and technology, driving alignment and influencing business strategy.
• Identify areas to improve enterprise collaboration with IT, R&D, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and other related organizations.
• Lead supplier segmentation, performance management and governance processes
• Lead Supplier Relationship Management activities, driving innovation with key category suppliers and collaborate to co develop solutions that delver on long term business needs. Work in partnership to host QBRs, conduct due diligence, evaluate service levels, and integrate business-specific KPIs.
• Develop and activate mitigation strategies to proactively define and manage procurement risk
• Lead end-to-end sourcing events (RFP/RFI/RFQ/Pricing Auctions), with support from a sourcing team, to identify and onboard data and analytics vendors in alignment with category strategies.
• Serve as lead for contract negotiations (MSAs, SOWs, JBPs), with support from a contracting team, factoring in business and compliance priorities, leveraging multiple data sources.
• Partner with related teams (legal, compliance, finance) to draft and execute contracts, ensuring risk mitigation, compliance, and timely delivery.
• Collaborate cross-functionally to support innovation and transformation initiatives in commercial analytics.
• Contribute to a cross functional team that informs strategic decision making by leveraging market intelligence, staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and market dynamics.
• Mentor Category Managers and Procurement Specialists, contributing to talent development and functional capability building.
• Implement short- and long-term cost reduction strategies while operating with high ethical standards and in compliance with AbbVie policies and procedures.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, supply chain, or related discipline (master’s preferred).
• Minimum 10 years’ experience in procurement, supply chain, or category management, specifically with commercial data or analytics in pharmaceuticals or healthcare.
• Demonstrated expertise managing supplier relationships and leading business reviews for data or analytics solutions.
• In-depth understanding of pharma-specific data types: sales tracking, patient and claims data, prescriber and physician analytics, promotional impact, and market research data.
• Solid understanding of industry dynamics, cost structures, compliance standards, and regulatory constraints for data and analytics.
• Strong executive communication and conversational skills.
• Strong communication and consensus-building skills with mid-to-senior management and diverse stakeholder groups.
• Advanced project management ability to execute multiple strategic initiatives and drive results.
• High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook); experience with relevant data analysis tools preferred.
• Self-motivated, resilient, collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
• Experience in talent/team development strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Website Operations
jobs.description:
About Betterment

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About the Role

The Website Operations team at Betterment is responsible for building and maintaining our public-facing marketing website. The team plays a critical role in ensuring content accuracy, compliance readiness, accessibility, SEO hygiene, high-quality publishing standards, and CRO testing and optimization across all lines of business.

As Sr. Manager, Website Operations, you will serve as the platform owner for our website, inclusive of the systems, governance, and experiences that span our multiple lines of business, resource center, and more. Building on our current intake process, you’ll create a scalable operating model that guides smart decisions about where to focus and how to sequence work for the greatest business impact. You’ll partner closely with Creative, Marketing, Engineering, Growth, Analytics, and Compliance to ensure those decisions reflect platform standards and team capacity while keeping the site reliable, on-brand, and aligned with business priorities. Reporting to the Director of Brand Operations, you’ll manage our Website Operations Associate and help shape the team as it grows.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

• New York City: $141,500 - $162,500

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A Day in the Life:

• Establish governance for site navigation, templates, modules, and publishing standards

• Lead development of landing pages and site experiences tied to marketing campaigns and media buys

• Partner with Product and Engineering on product integrations and interactive experiences (e.g., calculators, tools), guiding one-off or technical-debt-prone requests toward stable, reusable components

• Collaborate with Creative Operations on capacity planning to ensure web timelines align with corresponding marketing and campaign work

• Execute and implement website A/B tests and experiments, from build through QA and rollout, in collaboration with Analytics, Product Marketing, and Product

• Improve technical SEO and content discoverability, including visibility in LLM-driven and AI-assisted search (AEO)

• Provide mentorship, coaching, and clear prioritization support to junior website operations team members

What We’re Looking For:

This role is for someone who combines attention to detail and strong operational thinking with a focus on outcomes, and is excited to build the systems and processes that help a growing marketing website perform better, scale effectively, and drive business growth.

• 7+ years of experience in web operations, digital platform management, or a related field, with prior experience managing people

• Hands-on CMS experience (HubSpot experience preferred), with strong fundamentals in content modeling and design systems; familiarity with HTML/CSS/JS is a plus

• Demonstrated experience partnering with product and engineering teams on scoped technical work, integrations, or platform decisions

• Familiarity with CRO (conversion rate optimization) principles and experience executing website experiments (e.g., A/B tests)

• Familiarity with technical SEO and emerging AEO (answer engine optimization) best practices

• Comfortable establishing and evolving intake, governance, and prioritization processes, with the ability to balance competing priorities and communicate tradeoffs clearly

• Experience in financial services or another regulated industry is a plus, given the compliance and disclosure requirements that shape our marketing website

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:

• We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options

• Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.

• Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.

• Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.

• Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.

What happens next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.

On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.

We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!

Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.

Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Come join us!

We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Nurse Case Manager Care Coordination Part Time Days
jobs.description:
Days Part time, 0.7 FTE, hours are 8-4:40. One weekend every 7 weeks and one holiday per year.

The Nurse Case Manager reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• Assists in coordinating the patient's stay from admission through discharge. Assists to expedite medically appropriate, cost-effective care. Helps to ensure patient is at the right level and site of care, and the patient moves along the continuum of care in a safe and timely manner.

Responsibilities:

• In collaboration with the patient/family, and members of the health care team, assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the plan of care and the patient's response to treatment.
• Continually proactive in collaborating and educating physicians and multidisciplinary team in appropriateness of admission, continued stay, utilization of resources and expected LOS.
• Refers appropriate cases to patient financial services, peer review, patient relations, risk management.
• Collaborates with physicians and other health care team members to clarify admission status and plan of care.
• Utilizes all available tools and resources to gain better and complete picture of clinical assessment of the patient: notifies physicians and staff of concerns/variations.
• Relays pertinent information to appropriate care team members relative to admission, continuum of care and concerns related to discharge.
• Ensures that the interdisciplinary care plan and the discharge plan are comprehensive and consistent with the patient's clinical course, continuing care needs, and coordinated with covered services as available.
• Assesses and reassesses the patient for on-going care needs with knowledge of high-risk criteria and initiates referrals to the appropriate resources in a timely manner to progress toward the discharge plan.
• Participates in rounds and complex patient care conferences as indicated, identifying needs, barriers, and action plans.
• Performs utilization management activities of all inpatients and observation patients by applying approved criteria. Notify physician advisor of any outlier cases.
• Provides timely and thorough reviews to third party payers as requested or required. Experiences minimal denials based on lack of medical necessity.
• Has a good working knowledge base of available and diverse extended care providers for general population served. Asks co-workers for references for unfamiliar cases.
• Researches patient insurance plan in order to offer in-network providers of care and allow patient to make informed decisions.
• Partners with the nursing staff and physicians to convey accurate and timely information to post-acute care providers to encourage a smooth hand-off and create a seamless and safe discharge to the next continuum of care.
• Partners with the care delivery team to identify proactively and coordinate any educational needs for the patient and family.
• Ensures the patient is at the most appropriate level of care for the expressed severity of illness and level of services required. Applies National Guidelines and clear communication with physicians.
• Collaborates with physicians and other health care team members to clarify admission status and plan of care.
• Coordinates appropriate bed placement for patients with Patient care services, collaborating on location, staffing etc.
• Queries the admitting physician for additional information as needed to meet medical necessity for admission or appropriate level of care. Refers cases to physician advisor for any outlier cases.
• Coordinates patient activity and flow or movement between levels of care. Identifies potential throughput barriers and acts proactively to inform and alert upper management of anticipated delays.
• Reviews clinical against Milliman criteria to help determine patient class and level of care needed. Confers with MD to discuss clinical and appropriate level of care when needed.

Required:

• Bachelors of Science in Nursing (required for hires after 01/01/2011)
• Registered Nurse in the state of Illinois
• One year of case management experience in an acute hospital setting

Preferred:

• Two years’ experience in utilization review
• Case management certification
• Prior experience in case management or insurance setting.
• Bilingual

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups, Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces, and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index!

About the Role

Attentive is building an industry-defining Marketing Agent: a unified, vertically integrated, autonomous system that builds on three years of advances to create a step change in performance for our customers.

This is a chance to define what an AI-first company looks like and change the trajectory of an industry. You will help decide what autonomous marketing should mean, build the product that makes it useful and trustworthy, and work with a stellar team to bring it to market to 1000’s of Attentive’s enterprise brands and leading companies in every vertical.

We are looking for a product leader with marketing, advertising, or ecommerce experience and AI/ML depth to turn our vision into a product that brands trust, use, and get measurable value from. You will own the product strategy and execution for the autonomous agent, working closely with engineering, research, design, machine learning, data science, GTM and our customers.

Unlike in other industries, an AI-native marketing solution does not need to simply create one deliverable – it needs to guide and operate a complete machine learning system that itself delivers 1:1 experiences at scale. You will oversee the building of that complete system.

You will co-own the revenue number for this product and partner closely with our CEO to make it a success.

What You’ll Accomplish

• Define the product thesis, strategy, and north-star outcomes for Attentive's autonomous Marketing Agent. Make clear what we are building, for whom, why it will win, and what we will deliberately not build.

• Work directly with customers and internal experts to understand how marketing decisions are made today, where automation can create leverage, and where the product must earn confidence before it acts.

• Turn an ambitious, ambiguous opportunity into a focused plan: customer problems, product principles, roadmap, sequencing, investment choices, and the decisions required to make progress.

• Own the end-to-end agent experience and operating loop - understanding a customer's business and goals, forming a plan, taking action, measuring results, learning, and improving

• Partner deeply with engineering and AI/ML teams on model strategy, data and feedback loops, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, and the platform foundations required to make the product real at scale.

• Establish a rigorous system for evaluating the agent. Define the metrics, experiments, and failure analysis that tell us how much and why it is genuinely improving customer outcomes.

• Lead across boundaries. Clarify ownership, resolve disagreements, surface risks early, and build alignment without waiting for someone else to solve the problem for you.

Your Expertise

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Cobalt Service Partners (CSP) is building the nation's leading commercial access and security integration platform. Backed by Alpine Investors, a leading middle-market private equity firm, we grow by acquiring businesses that install, maintain, and repair commercial gates, doors, loading docks, and integrated security systems.

Since launching in late 2023, Cobalt has successfully acquired 22 partner companies and established itself as one of the leading platforms in a highly attractive and fragmented industry. We have done this by partnering with founder-led companies that have spent decades earning trust in their local markets. Our mission is to honor those legacies, enhance operations through disciplined execution, and drive growth through high-frequency M&A.

The Role

In-Person - Walnut Creek, CA

As Accounting Manager, you'll own accounting for one of our newly acquired operating companies, covering the monthly close, reporting, controls, payroll oversight, and the annual audit. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes the details and wants real ownership, while working closely with our regional finance team. Our businesses are project-based, so revenue recognition, job costing, and cash management are at the center of the work. You'll also build the processes and lead the team through the changes that come with joining Cobalt.

What You'll Own

• Monthly close. Run a fast, accurate close and flash report. Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations.

• Project accounting. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, job costing, and WIP (over/under billings) across active projects.

• Financial reporting. Own the income statement and balance sheet, including deferred revenue, prepaids, fixed assets. Establish and manage cycle counts and inventory accounting. Prepare the monthly financial package and variance analysis, and explain notable swings to leadership.

• Intercompany accounting. Record, reconcile, and settle intercompany activity: record entries, reconcile balances, and coordinate settlements with the Cobalt platform finance team and sister companies.

• Cash forecasting. Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.

• Controls, audit, and compliance. Maintain and strengthen internal controls. Prepare PBC schedules and answer auditor questions for the annual audit. Keep tax and regulatory filings current with outside advisors.

• Budget and KPIs. Prepare the annual budget and track the KPIs that drive the business.

• Process and systems. Create, document, and maintain standard procedures for close, AP/AR, payroll, and reporting. Replace manual or risky workflows with standardized, automated ones, and support the regional team on ERP implementations and integrations.

• Team and change management. Lead and develop accounting staff, and make sure payroll, AR, and AP are accurate and on time. Guide the team through new systems, policies, and reporting requirements: explain what's changing and why, train people, and make sure new processes stick.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with hands-on ownership of the monthly close.

• Strong command of GAAP, including ASC 606, reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting.

• Experience with project-based accounting: job costing, WIP, and over/under billings.

• Experience with inventory accounting, including cycle counts, valuation, and reconciling physical counts to the general ledger.

• Experience running close and reporting across multiple entities, branches, or subsidiaries.

• Comfort with accounting systems (our operating companies run tools such as QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, and ServiceTitan) and the ability to learn new ones quickly.

• Strong Excel and modeling skills.

• Self-directed, and able to bring structure to ambiguity.

Preferred: CPA; public accounting background; construction or field-services industry; experience supervising a team.

Why Cobalt

• A high-growth, PE-backed platform where finance is close to the business and your work drives real operating decisions.

• The chance to build and strengthen finance processes as we scale across a growing set of companies.

• Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus, benchmarked to your market and the scope of the seat.

• Full health benefits, 401(k) with match, paid time off, paid holidays, life and disability coverage, and professional development support.

Cobalt Service Partners and its operating companies are equal opportunity employers. Employment is at-will.

jobs.title: Staff People Partner, EPD
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product,  the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. 



What You’ll Do

We are looking for an experienced, savvy HR Business Partner who operates with conviction and urgency to help Horizon3 http://horizon3.ai scale through its next phase of growth. The People team is evolving quickly to support a high-growth business, and we are looking for teammates who are thoughtful, collaborative, and excited to build and scale programs that drive real business impact.

As an HRBP, you will partner closely with leaders and employees across our Engineering, Product, Design, Security Research, and Data organizations to help scale high-performing teams during a period of rapid company growth. You will serve as a trusted advisor to leaders as they navigate organizational change, develop managers, build strong teams, and translate ambitious business goals into people strategies that enable execution.

Working alongside a growing team of HRBPs and People Ops partners, you will help shape and execute HR strategy, bringing a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, building as they go, and helping leaders successfully scale organizations in a fast-moving environment.



This role will be responsible for…

 - Partnering with Engineering, Product, Design, Security Research, and Data leaders to scale high-performing organizations while supporting delivery of an ambitious product roadmap.

 - Advising leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and resourcing strategies to ensure teams are structured to meet evolving business and product priorities.

 - Coaching managers and leaders through the challenges of hypergrowth, including scaling teams, leading through change, developing talent, and building strong management practices.

 - Helping leaders build high-performing organizations through clear expectations, accountability, continuous feedback, and consistent performance standards.

 - Partnering with Engineering leadership and Finance on headcount planning, hiring prioritization, and organizational investments aligned to roadmap delivery and business goals.

 - Driving talent reviews, calibration, succession planning, and promotion discussions to build leadership bench strength and support long-term organizational growth.

 - Using organizational health, engagement, attrition, and workforce data to proactively identify risks, inform decisions, and improve team effectiveness.

 - Supporting leaders through organizational changes, ensuring teams remain aligned, engaged, and able to execute as the business scales.

 - Accelerating the effectiveness of new managers and leaders through coaching, onboarding, and ongoing leadership development.

 - Managing employee relations matters with sound judgment, balancing business objectives, employee experience, and organizational risk.

 - Partnering with People Operations to build scalable people programs, processes, and manager enablement that support a rapidly growing technical organization.

 - Serving as a trusted thought partner who brings data, business insight, and practical solutions to help leaders make informed people decisions and execute with confidence.



What You’ll Bring

 - 7–10 years of HR Business Partner experience supporting high-growth technology organizations.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, or other technical organizations through periods of rapid growth and change.

 - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business priorities into practical people strategies.

 - Proven ability to influence and coach leaders at all levels using data, sound judgment, and credibility.

 - Experience with organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, and performance management.

 - Strong judgment in employee relations and navigating complex people situations.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with a builder mindset.

 - Experience supporting globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

 - Deep knowledge of HR practices, employment law, and scalable people programs.



Travel Encouraged

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% of travel to be successful. We encourage our people partners to join the departments they support at things like Sales QBRs, Engineering Planning Onsites, etc.



Perks of Horizon3 http://horizon3.ai

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $169,000 - $200,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, (Adobe - AEM Lead)
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The role

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to serve as the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Tech Lead on website and platform projects. You are the technical anchor for the delivery team, taking projects from inception through launch with minimal oversight: turning architecture and product goals into a coherent implementation, documenting scope, requirements, estimates, timelines, and risks, owning day-to-day technical communication, helping engineers make good decisions, and keeping quality high when the work gets complicated. This role reports into our Software Engineering practice in the US.

You will be hands-on and client-facing. You will lead technical workshops, design and build important pieces, review code, shape technical tasks and estimates, and work directly with a CMS (AEM) Architect, Product Owner, QA, DevOps, UX, Content, and client engineers. You will create the conditions for a team to deliver steadily, without becoming a bottleneck every decision has to pass through.

This role suits an engineer who enjoys both the code and the people around the code. You can go deep on a Sling Model or an OSGi configuration, then come back up and explain the decision in a way a product owner can use.

What you'll do

• Anchor delivery: Take ownership of the technical workstream from inception through launch, breaking architecture and product goals into an implementation plan, technical stories, sequencing, dependencies, estimates, risks, and clear definitions of done. Surface scope gaps, ambiguity, and documentation debt before they become delivery problems.

• Build the important parts: Contribute production-quality website components and blocks, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, Java, and AEM code, especially where the work involves complex components, services, workflows, integrations, responsive behavior, or performance-sensitive behavior.

• Keep the codebase healthy: Establish coding standards and patterns for website components and blocks, Universal Editor models, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, responsive web design, Sling Models, OSGi services, servlets, schedulers, workflows, error handling, logging, testing, and configuration.

• Lead and mentor: Review pull requests, pair with engineers, explain the why behind patterns, and give useful feedback that raises the whole team's capability. Lead smaller delivery teams when needed, mentor P2 engineers, and build a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing.

• Protect quality early: Partner with QA and DevOps on automated testing, build gates, security, accessibility, performance, observability, and deployment readiness.

• Make integration behavior explicit: Help define API contracts, payloads, retries, timeouts, authentication, failure handling, and ownership across AEM and external systems.

• Unblock delivery: Investigate defects, environment issues, build failures, and performance problems. Bring the right people together and make the next decision clear.

• Partner with the CMS (AEM) Architect: Turn architecture decisions into codebase conventions, flag when a proposed approach creates unnecessary risk, cost, or operational load, and help resolve technical tradeoffs quickly.

• Consult with the client: Lead technical workshops, presentations, demos, and day-to-day communication. Explain implementation choices at the right altitude for engineers, product partners, and executives, and help client engineers understand how to extend and operate the solution.

• Support release readiness: Help the team move safely through development, UAT, hardening, launch, and hypercare. A release is not finished when it compiles; it is finished when it can be supported.

• Improve how we deliver: Leverage GenAI tools, capture reusable patterns, share lessons through craft sessions and documentation, improve estimates and templates, and make the next project easier to start well.

What you bring

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with proven success leading technical delivery for engineering teams.

• Demonstrated experience delivering production websites or digital platforms, including hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting AEM-based solutions.

• Strong consulting, communication, and leadership capabilities, with a track record of articulating technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product partners, and client stakeholders.

• Full-stack technical depth—combining practical Java experience with strong HTML5, JavaScript, and CSS fundamentals—to make sound technical decisions and guide component architecture without needing to be the deepest specialist in every underlying tool.

• Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI productivity tools (such as Gemini CLI, Claude Code, or Codex) within your development workflow, alongside the drive to push their boundaries to accelerate team delivery.

• A practical understanding of core LLM concepts and the judgment to identify where AI solutions create real value.

• Full-stack leadership experience across CMS website projects, providing the technical breadth required to guide engineers and unblock delivery while partnering with the CMS Architect for deep specialist architecture ownership.

• Experience designing, integrating, and maintaining external APIs, microservices, data sources, and distributed systems—ensuring secure authentication, retries, resilient error handling, and optimal frontend rendering performance.

• A strong commitment to engineering standards across testing, accessibility, security, performance, observability, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Solid understanding of responsive web design, mobile-first delivery, cross-browser compatibility, Core Web Vitals, Accessibility standards and SEO-aware frontend architecture.

• Proven ability to quickly navigate unfamiliar codebases, diagnose root causes, and introduce targeted improvements without unnecessary rewrites.

• Clear communication, composure during incidents, and the pragmatic judgment to prioritize investigation over guessing when addressing complex technical challenges.

Helpful and nice to have

• Deep technical experience with AEM internals (e.g., Sling, OSGi, JCR/Oak, HTL, Clientlibs, Sling Models, servlets, workflows, schedulers, and component patterns) and ecosystem tools like AEM as a Cloud Service, Cloud Manager, Dispatcher, Edge Delivery Services, Universal Editor, AEM Assets, Content/Experience Fragments, MSM, or headless delivery.

• Experience with Adobe Skills for AEM, dispatcher etc.

• Experience with Adobe Commerce, Adobe App Builder, API Mesh, Workfront, or Analytics integrations.

• Experience mentoring engineers, leading distributed or cross-functional teams, or acting as a technical lead across multiple teams.

• Adobe certification or equivalent production experience.

How we will know you're succeeding

• The team knows what to build next and why.

• Code reviews improve the system instead of becoming a late-stage approval queue.

• Defects are found earlier, releases are less dramatic, and production issues are diagnosed with evidence.

• Engineers grow in confidence and ownership rather than waiting for the Tech Lead to solve everything.

• The implementation reflects the agreed architecture while still adapting sensibly to what discovery and delivery reveal.

• Clients experience a team that is technically credible, direct, and easy to work with.

WHAT DO WE OFFER

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401k plan, plus matching

• PTO

• Paid Company Holidays

• Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work.  Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter — Contract with Option to Hire
jobs.description:
About VGS
VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.
 

 
About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter to join VGS on a 6–12 month contract and help support our growing Engineering organization. This person will own a portfolio of technical roles end-to-end and partner closely with hiring managers to identify, engage, and close exceptional talent.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities move quickly and recruiters are expected to operate with a high level of ownership and autonomy. Own full-cycle recruiting across multiple technical roles, from kickoff and sourcing through offer and close

Manage multiple searches and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
Create a strong candidate experience throughout the entire interview process
Use recruiting data and funnel metrics to identify challenges and adjust search strategies
Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data within our ATS
Help improve recruiting processes, interview practices, and hiring efficiency as we scale

 

 
What You Bring
5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong focus on technical/engineering hiring
Proven experience recruiting for roles such as Software Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Platform Engineering, or other highly technical positions
Experience working in a fast-paced startup, high-growth technology company, or similarly dynamic environment is required
Strong sourcing skills and demonstrated ability to identify and engage passive technical talent
Comfortable independently managing multiple searches at different stages
Strong hiring manager partnership and stakeholder management skills
Ability to move quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and operate with limited oversight

BA/BS degree

jobs.title: HSE Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.



The HSE Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Own safety on gigawatts of high-energy infrastructure, built from zero. Headcount and sites are scaling faster than institutional knowledge can keep up. The gap between a control written on paper and one actually applied in the field is where fatalities happen.

 - Keep a 24/7 workforce running at full intensity, not sidelined by injury. Fatigue, shift work, and high-energy exposure compound on the people running the sites and show up as injuries or claims if no one is tracking them. The work is to catch them first.

 - Keep environmental compliance ahead of the fastest build in the industry. Behind-the-meter generation spans multiple states, each with its own air permit conditions, runtime limits, and reporting deadlines, and the company adds sites faster than any manual compliance model can keep up with.

Role Scope

 - Own HSE across a leased campus another operator controls, where buildings in construction, commissioning, and live operation sit side by side.

 - Review design and commissioning packages for the hazards they build in, and push engineering controls into the drawings before a crew has to work around them.

 - Run hazardous energy control across the site's electrical distribution: switching plans, LOTO, and zero-energy verification as gear lands, tests, and energizes.

 - Own workers compensation and case management at the site, from first report of injury through the carrier and TPA handoff, treatment, and fitness for duty, with transitional duty defined ahead of time so shift-based field crews come back on modified duty in days.

 - Keep injury, illness, and environmental recordkeeping current so the OSHA 300, 300A, and 301 logs, the New York state filings, the stormwater and air permit records, and the claims and near-miss trend view all hold up on inspection and in front of leadership.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've run site safety on a data center or heavy industrial build where construction crews, commissioning, and energized systems shared one campus.

 - You hold OSHA 30 Construction and current First Aid, CPR, and AED certification.

 - You've reviewed design and commissioning packages and gotten an engineering control into the drawings instead of a procedure telling a crew to be careful.

 - You've taken workers compensation claims from first report through closure, and you've worked adjusters, occupational physicians, and clinics hard enough to change how a claim went.

 - You've built or run a return-to-work and transitional duty program that field supervisors actually used, and the return-to-work numbers moved because of it.

 - You've owned OSHA 300, 300A, and 301 recordkeeping through an inspection or an audit where the logs held up.

 - Bonus: Construction safety credentials (CHST, CSP, ASP). Professional engineering licensure (PE). Case and disability management credentials (CCM, CPDM, occupational health RN). New York construction and labor compliance (Industrial Code Rule 23, Labor Law 240 and 241). Claims and injury analytics tooling (Origami, Riskonnect, Intelex).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: CX Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

THE ROLE

OLIPOP is hiring a CX Operations Analyst to serve as the operational backbone of our Omnichannel Customer Experience organization. This is an individual contributor position built for someone who can take ownership of the systems, tooling, and cross-functional relationships that enable the broader CX team to perform at its best.

The ideal candidate will balance meaningful project work, including AI-enabled customer service tooling and subscription experience enhancements, with the operational discipline required to keep DTC & B2B order management, fulfillment, technical tools, and fraud prevention running smoothly day to day. Success in this role requires comfort contributing to vendor strategy discussions, executing detailed system configuration work, and building reporting to help make informed decisions across the CX org.

RESPONSIBILITIES

CX Program Management

Manage cross-functional CX initiatives from planning through execution, including:

• efforts tied to new product launches and new market expansion

• Own documentation, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment across each initiative working with partners internally and externally

Systems and Tooling Ownership

Own the configuration, maintenance, and continued evolution of our backend CX tools, including:

• Rule sets, routing rules, and workflow updates as business needs evolve

• New tooling set up and maintenance

Technology includes but is not limited to Gorgias, Digital Genius, Guru, Shopify, NetSuite, Stay.ai, Rediem, Redo/Malomo, and Klaviyo.

Logistics and Order Operations

• Serve as the primary point of contact for our third-party logistics partner on B2B and DTC order management and fulfillment strategy within our ERP system

• Own the relationship with our 3PL, Amazon partner, retail.com partners, internal Supply Chain team, and others, end to end

• Partner closely with the supply chain team to maintain a comprehensive, end-to-end understanding of the order lifecycle, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they affect customers.

• Partner with CX Manager and third party software provider to enhance

Fraud and Chargeback Strategy

• Manage payment operations, including payment issues, failures, and escalations

• Execute fraud detection, monitoring, and resolution, including Fraud review workflows anf customer communication related to fraud decisions

• Track and report scams and impersonator trends, escalating to Legal and internal stakeholders as needed

• Partner with CX Manager to ensure fraud decisions are communicated clearly and consistently to customers

Customer Journey and Subscription Experience

• Partner with cross-functional internal and external (Stay.ai) teams to enhance the customer journey on our website.

• Particular focus on improving the subscription experience and contact pages

Ecommerce Fulfillment Operations

Own communication and strategy with fulfillment partners to ensure timely, accurate order delivery and rapid resolution of issues as they arise.  Includes DTC and TikTok shop

AI Enablement and Automation

• Lead the development and ongoing refinement of AI-powered tools for the CX organization.

• Report on tool performance and business impact, identify new automation opportunities, and serve as the primary strategic partner to our third-party AI vendor (Digital Genius), in partnership with our CX Associate

Voice of Customer (VoC) Reporting

• Contribute to Voice of Customer reporting for the CX organization

• Synthesize recurring themes and customer feedback into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional partners using helpdesk (Gorgias) and review platform (Bazaar Voice) insight

• Work closely with CX Manager on ticket tagging/tracking strategy and reporting optimization

REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of applicable experience in customer experience, ecommerce operations, or a related operational function, ideally within a DTC and CPG environment

• Hands-on experience with a helpdesk platform (Gorgias experience strongly preferred), an ERP system (Netsuite), an ecommerce platform (Shopify) and 3PL relationship management

• Required: hands-on experience building, implementing, or managing conversational customer service automation tools and workflows (e.g., ticket automation, workflow rules, or AI-assisted tooling), beyond simply operating existing solutions

• Proven experience leading or supporting cross-functional projects with competing deadlines and multiple stakeholders

• Working knowledge of ecommerce fraud and chargeback processes, or the demonstrated ability to build this expertise quickly

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to represent CX policy and process clearly to both internal and external audiences

• Demonstrated ability to move fluidly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting large-scale, cross-functional operational rollouts

• Familiarity with ecommerce platforms (Shopify), ERP Systems (NetSuite), and their unique support considerations

• Experience partnering directly with supply chain or fulfillment functions

• Experiencing working with helpdesk data and tools

• Experience working with conversational AI tools

REPORTS INTO:

Sr. Manager, CX & Loyalty Marketing

COMPENSATION:

$62,000 - $78,000 + Bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

• Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.

• Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.

• Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.

• Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

• Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks

• Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment

• Value real human connection and honest collaboration

• Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

jobs.title: Product Architect
jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

Note: This role's initial assignment is serving as the dedicated product owner for a contracted enterprise client build. This will allow the Team Member to learn the product deeply. Scope of that assignment (partial vs. full-time) is subject to the final Statement of Work.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Our fastest-growing home lending product line delivers streamlined digital origination, taking borrowers from application to a qualified, rate-locked loan in a single digital flow. Deployments range from out-of-the-box to highly customized builds for major banks and credit unions.

Every lender runs origination a little differently, and our platform is built to flex to that. We need a Product Architect to step in and advise clients on what's standard, what's configurable, what's custom, and what we won't build, and to turn that guidance into a repeatable discovery process the whole go-to-market team can run. This is a forward-deployed role — you work where the client is, embedded in their process, backed by our engineering and product teams. What you learn in daily client conversations should shape how we package and price the product as our product lines converge onto a single platform.

INITIAL ASSIGNMENT: DEDICATED PRODUCT OWNER, ENTERPRISE CLIENT BUILD

We are contracting with a major enterprise client for a highly customized build on this product line, and the contract calls for a dedicated product owner. The first assignment for this role is owning that build: gathering and iterating requirements directly with the client, running the backlog with our globally distributed engineering team, and working day to day with the product team.

Owning a complex build end-to-end is the fastest way to build deep product knowledge — the configuration model, the integration points, where custom work gets expensive — and that knowledge is exactly what the advisory side of this role requires.

MISSION

Own the technical product relationship with clients on this product line, from first pre-sales conversation through post-implementation. Advise clients on solution design during discovery and before contract signature, translate their needs into buildable requirements during delivery, and bring what you learn back into product strategy, packaging, and pricing.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the dedicated product owner for a contracted custom client build, owning requirements, backlog, and sprint execution with our globally distributed engineering team

• Advise prospects through pre-sales discovery, guiding component selection and setting clear expectations on what's standard, what's custom, and what we won't build

• Make discovery repeatable by building the discovery questions, scoping method, and gap-analysis template that account executives, sales engineers, and deployment leads can run themselves on standard deals

• Support pre-sales on scoping, technical feasibility, solution design, and proposals for both standard and high-touch deployments

• Hand structured, buildable requirements to product owners for execution, with clear ownership so requirements are owned once

• Stay engaged after go-live on stabilization, adoption, and expansion opportunities

• Bring client signal into packaging and pricing decisions as we move toward a base-product-plus-add-ons model and converge our home lending product lines onto a single platform

KEY PARTNERSHIPS

• Home lending product leadership (reporting relationship)

• Product owners, on backlog execution and sprint operations

• Pre-sales and solutions engineering

• Globally distributed engineering teams

• Delivery leads and customer success managers on active client programs

PROFILE

• Technical depth plus product sense; equally at home in an architecture conversation with client engineers and a roadmap conversation with client executives

• Experience in a client-facing technical product role such as solutions architecture, technical product management, or implementation consulting

• Mortgage or fintech background strongly preferred; home equity and refinance domain knowledge is a significant advantage

• Self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity; this is a strategic individual contributor role that helps define where we're going, not just operate inside today's setup

• Writes requirements engineering can build from without rework

• Comfortable working across global time zones and traveling to client sites as programs require (travel required)

Compensation:

• Base Salary Range: $118,000 – $139,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

• Bonus (if applicable): Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

• Equity : Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

• We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

• Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage

• Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more

• Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance

• Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being

• Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA
