jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product,  the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. 



What You’ll Do

We are looking for an experienced, strategic HR Business Partner who operates with conviction and urgency to help Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai scale through its next phase of growth. You will partner with leaders across corporate functions such as Finance, Legal, and IT/Security to build the organizational structure, leadership capability, and talent strategies needed to support a rapidly growing global business.

This role requires proven experience supporting high-velocity growth and leading organizational design and workforce planning. You understand how corporate functions evolve as a business scales and can help leaders anticipate capability gaps, clarify accountability, and sequence investments to balance growth, efficiency, and operational discipline.

Working alongside a growing team of HRBPs and People Ops partners, you will translate business priorities into practical people strategies and drive execution. You bring the judgment to advise senior executives, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the willingness to work hands-on as we build.



This role will be responsible for…

 - Serving as a trusted advisor to G&A executives, translating global expansion priorities into organizational structures, leadership capabilities, and talent plans that enable the business to scale.

 - Leading organizational design for global corporate functions, clarifying what should be centralized, regional, or local and establishing clear accountability across teams and geographies.

 - Partnering with Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and People Ops to anticipate the capabilities and staffing required for new market entry, entity expansion, and increasing international complexity.

 - Building workforce plans across growth scenarios, prioritizing critical roles, evaluating talent locations, and sequencing hiring to establish capacity ahead of business needs.

 - Helping leaders evolve G&A operating models to support a larger global footprint, strengthening cross-functional coordination, regional coverage, and service delivery.

 - Coaching executives and managers on leading globally distributed teams, delegating effectively, and maintaining consistent performance expectations across regions.

 - Guiding organizational change as functions expand, including new leadership layers, regional responsibilities, reporting relationships, and transitions in ownership.

 - Leading talent reviews and succession planning to strengthen the global leadership bench, reduce dependency on key individuals, and develop talent for broader scope.

 - Driving performance management grounded in role expectations and business impact, ensuring standards are applied consistently and thoughtfully across geographies.

 - Using workforce, retention, engagement, and performance data to surface capacity constraints and organizational risks early and guide investment decisions.

 - Partnering with People Ops, Legal, and regional experts to navigate employee relations, compensation, and local employment considerations as the company enters and scales in new markets.

 - Partnering with Talent Development and People Ops to build onboarding and manager development programs that accelerate productivity and strengthen collaboration across a growing global organization.

 

What You’ll Bring

 - 7–10+ years of progressive HR experience, including substantial HRBP experience in a technology company through high-velocity growth and global expansion.

 - Demonstrated success helping corporate functions build the talent, leadership, and organizational capacity needed to support new markets and a growing international footprint.

 - Strong organizational design experience, including defining global versus regional responsibilities, clarifying decision-making ownership, and evolving structures as business complexity increases.

 - Experience advising CFOs and other senior functional leaders, with the business acumen and confidence to challenge assumptions, navigate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.

 - Strong coaching and change management skills, with experience guiding leaders through international team growth, leadership transitions, and shifts in organizational responsibilities.

 - A track record of strengthening performance, succession planning, and leadership development.

 - The ability to turn workforce and business data into clear recommendations, identify risks early, and move between strategic advising and hands-on execution.

 - Sound judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias for action, paired with the candor, discretion, and follow-through needed to earn trust across cultures and time zones.



Travel Encouraged

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% of travel to be successful. We encourage our people partners to join the departments they support at things like Sales QBRs, Engineering Planning Onsites, etc.



Perks of Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

You Belong Here

jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

• Background :

GiveDirectly (GD) vise à remodeler les dons internationaux - et des millions de vies - en fournissant des subventions en espèces directement aux plus pauvres du monde. The Brookings Institution estime que 70 milliards de dollars de transferts en espèces seraient nécessaires pour éliminer le fossé de la pauvreté ; le secteur de l'aide dépense actuellement 135 milliards de dollars par an, dont une grande partie pour des interventions non fondées sur des données probantes. GiveDirectly veut changer cela, en faisant des transferts d'argent liquide une référence pour l'aide étrangère - comme le fonds indiciel est une référence pour l'industrie financière - et en accélérant ainsi la fin de l'extrême pauvreté.

GD a levé plus de 700 millions de dollars depuis son lancement en 2011, distribué de l'argent à plus d'un million de personnes et ouvert des bureaux dans 10 pays. Nous avons également soutenu des recherches expérimentales à grande échelle qui indiquent un fort impact de nos programmes sur les bénéficiaires. En conséquence, GD a été reconnue comme l'une des organisations à but non lucratif les plus innovantes par Fast Company, tandis que le mouvement croissant des transferts d'argent liquide (et le rôle de premier plan joué par la GD dans ce cadre) a fait l'objet d'un article dans le magazine New York Times Magazine, This American Life, Foreign Affairs, et The Economist.

GiveDirectly offre la possibilité de travailler avec des personnes originaires de 21 pays différents et parlant 69 langues différentes. Nous travaillons activement à la mise en place d'un environnement équitable et inclusif pour tous les membres de l'équipe, et notre personnel apporte des perspectives et des expériences diverses à notre organisation. Dans nos bureaux du monde entier, notre culture est franche, analytique, non hiérarchique et rapide. Nous valorisons les capacités, l'adaptabilité et la volonté d'apprendre. Le Bureau de représentation nationale de GiveDirectly en RDC est situé à Goma, 322, Avenue du Musée, Quartier Himbi, Commune de Goma, Ville de Goma, Province du Nord Kivu.

À propos de GiveDirectly en RD Congo :

GiveDirectly RDC a été créé en 2018 afin de permettre des transferts monétaires aux populations pauvres et rurales via les téléphones portables, afin de promouvoir la sécurité alimentaire, la réduction de la pauvreté et l’inclusion financière. Nous souhaitions démontrer la faisabilité opérationnelle et la rentabilité du transfert d’importants volumes monétaires sous forme numérique dans l’un des pays les moins développés du monde. Depuis sa création, il y a quatre ans, GiveDirectly RDC a utilisé les téléphones mobiles pour transférer plus de 14 millions de dollars à plus de 65 000 bénéficiaires dans quatre provinces : Sud-Kivu, Nord-Kivu, Ituri et Kinshasa. Les activités de GiveDirectly en RDC se sont développées de manière à inclure, notamment : des preuves de concept convaincantes des transferts d’argent liquide basés sur les téléphones portables ; la mise en œuvre de technologies innovantes de ciblage des populations urbaines défavorisées de Kinshasa, en collaboration avec l’agence de protection sociale de la RDC, le Fonds Social de la RDC ; la livraison d’argent liquide sans contact aux bénéficiaires de Beni et Bunia affectés par les conséquences économiques de la COVID-19. Vous rejoindrez Give Directly RDC à un moment passionnant de son histoire, alors que nous mettons en place et espérons lancer plusieurs nouveaux programmes et renforcer notre partenariat avec le gouvernement de la RDC.

But principal

Le Chauffeur est engagé :

jobs.description:

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission visant à transformer la façon dont les gens achètent et mangent, où l'impact, l'innovation et la croissance motivent tout ce que nous faisons. Notre équipe Commerciale est au cœur de la marketplace de Deliveroo : elle façonne la manière dont nous servons les restaurants, les commerçants et les nouveaux secteurs à travers le monde. De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Si vous aimez les environnements commerciaux dynamiques et que vous souhaitez influencer l'avenir d'une marque mondiale, cette équipe est faite pour vous.

Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDI - 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais.

 


CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions. Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien :

 - Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires.

 - Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises.

 - Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi.

 - Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité.

 - Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.


CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

Essentiel :

 - Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

 - Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

 - Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome.

 - Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP.

Souhaité :

 - Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant.

 - Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée).

 - Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.


POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à :

🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs.

🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités.

🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise.

🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler.

Nous visons à créer un processus équitable qui laisse briller vos compétences — notre parcours de recrutement comprend généralement 3 à 4 étapes. Pour en savoir plus sur notre façon de recruter, cliquez ici https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/how-we-hire/.


NOTRE STRUCTURE MONDIALE

Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique.


DIVERSITÉ, ÉQUITÉ ET INCLUSION

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement où chacun peut donner le meilleur de lui-même et se sentir à sa place.

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et accueillons des candidats de tous horizons, quels que soient leur âge, leur sexe, leur origine ethnique, leur handicap, leur orientation sexuelle, leur identité de genre, leur milieu socio-économique, leur religion ou leurs convictions.

Si vous avez un handicap ou une condition de santé de longue durée et que vous avez besoin d'aide pour postuler, ou si vous avez besoin d'ajustements raisonnables pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez contacter notre équipe de recrutement à accommodations@deliveroo.co.uk. Nous serons ravis de vous aider pour vous garantir une expérience juste et équitable.

Si vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'avoir un impact réel dans une marketplace en mouvement rapide et de développer votre carrière aux côtés d'équipes ambitieuses et solidaires, nous serions ravis de vous entendre !

Job Overview

As a Content Strategy Manager, you will be an integral member of the AvidXchange marketing team, helping develop high-impact content and research-driven thought leadership that builds brand authority, engages prospective customers, and supports business objectives.

This role is ideal for a strong writer, editor, and strategic thinker who enjoys turning complex topics, proprietary research, and subject matter expertise into compelling stories. You will lead content projects from idea through publication, partner across marketing and communications, and support select public relations initiatives. The role is primarily focused on long-form content strategy, editorial development, and research-driven thought leadership rather than social media management or technical SEO.

What You’ll Do

• Partner with cross-functional teams to develop and execute content strategies and thought leadership programs aligned with marketing priorities, audience needs, and business objectives.

• Collaborate with demand generation, digital, brand, public relations, product marketing, and subject matter experts to develop, refine, and amplify content across channels.

• Use proprietary survey research, industry trends, and subject matter expertise to develop clear, differentiated narratives and actionable insights for target audiences.

• Manage all aspects of content creation, including strategy, research, writing, editing, and production for research-based white papers, eBooks, blog articles, executive thought leadership, case studies, webinars, and other long-form assets.

• Use audience insights, performance data, and search best practices to inform content decisions and improve discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search experiences.

• Support public relations initiatives as needed, including editing press materials and executive thought leadership, coordinating internal reviews and approvals, and helping maintain consistency across earned and owned content.

What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Three or more years of experience developing long-form B2B marketing, editorial, or thought leadership content and managing the content process from concept through publication

• Experience managing cross-functional projects, multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment, including coordinating feedback and approvals

• Excellent writing, editing, communication, and presentation skills, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating the ability to simplify complex topics, develop compelling narratives, and produce polished long-form content.

• Experience working with research, data, subject matter experts, or industry insights to develop authoritative content; experience with survey-based thought leadership is a plus.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or another complex or regulated industry preferred; familiarity with public relations, SEO, and AI-powered search best practices a plus.

AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. What you’ll get:

AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. We help our AvidXers develop as professionals and as human beings, providing work/life balance, development programs, and competitive benefits. At AvidXchange, we are building more than a tech company – we are building an experience. We remain committed to a culture where you can fully be 'you’ – connected with others, chasing big goals, and making a meaningful impact. jobs.title: Behavior Technician (BT/RBT)
jobs.description:
Behavior Technician (BT/RBT) - Paid BCBA and BCaBA Fieldwork Program

Company: SenseSational Learning Group
Job Type:  Full-Time | Weekdays (at least three evenings 4pm - 7pm)
Location: In-Person - Lansing, MI
Pay: Direct work: $20 - $23 per hour| Indirect work:  $15 - $20 per hour


Build your clinical skills while earning paid fieldwork experience. SenseSational Learning Group is hiring full-time Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians who are working toward BCBA or BCaBA certification. Through our Wayfinder Program, team members receive free BCBA supervision, paid opportunities to complete unrestricted clinical activities, and a structured path toward greater responsibility and higher pay.



We are a small, BCBA-owned practice providing play-based, naturalistic, assent-based ABA services in homes, schools, and community settings throughout the Greater Lansing area. We follow each child’s lead, respect assent and assent withdrawal, and build skills that are meaningful to children and their families.




THE WAYFINDER PROGRAM

Wayfinder is a competency-based fieldwork pathway designed for future BCBAs and BCaBAs. As you demonstrate clinical skill, reliability, initiative, and responsiveness to feedback, you can advance through three stages:



Explorer: Build strong direct-care skills, learn our assent-based model, and participate in meaningful supervision.

Pathfinder: Take on more unrestricted work through assessments, program development, caregiver coaching, projects, and peer mentorship.

Navigator: Develop advanced clinical judgment by contributing to intakes, treatment planning, reauthorization preparation, caregiver coaching, and team training under BCBA oversight.



Advancement is based on documented competencies and available program capacity. Direct and indirect hour allocations vary by stage. Detailed program expectations, evaluation criteria, and fieldwork planning are reviewed during the interview process and provided in the complete Wayfinder Practicum Guide.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Provide one-to-one ABA services using play-based and naturalistic teaching strategies.

• Build positive, respectful relationships with children and families.

• Collect accurate data and communicate openly about client progress.

• Participate in individual and group supervision with BCBAs.

• Complete paid indirect clinical activities appropriate to your Wayfinder stage.

• Contribute to developing programs such as social groups, caregiver coaching, and professional training.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Completed 40-hour RBT training or willingness to complete it before starting.

• Previous experience working with children.

• Availability for 35 scheduled hours per week, including at least three evenings from 4:00 to 7:00 PM.

• Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license for travel between homes and community locations.

• Ability to be physically active with children, including sitting on the floor, playing outdoors, and lifting up to 50 pounds.

• Strong organization, initiative, curiosity, and willingness to seek and apply feedback.



For the BCBA fieldwork track: Enrollment in or completion of a master’s-level ABA program, or a completed master’s degree with an eligible behavior-analytic course sequence.

For the BCaBA fieldwork track: Enrollment in a bachelor’s program and enrollment in or completion of an eligible behavior-analytic course sequence.




COMPENSATION AND SUPPORT

• Explorer – BT: $20/hour direct | $15/hour indirect | Typical mix: 28 direct and 7 indirect hours per week

• Explorer – RBT: $22/hour direct | $16/hour indirect | Typical mix: 28 direct and 7 indirect hours per week

• Pathfinder: $23/hour direct | $18/hour indirect | Typical mix: 23 direct and 12 indirect hours per week

• Navigator: $23/hour direct | $20/hour indirect | Typical mix: 18 direct and 17 indirect hours per week



Additional support includes: free BCBA supervision; paid drive time and training; mileage reimbursement; covered RBT exam and application fees; a $1,500 BCBA certification bonus or $750 BCaBA certification bonus; and priority consideration for clinician openings after certification.




WHY JOIN SENSESATIONAL LEARNING GROUP

• Every approved direct and indirect hour is paid.

• Supervision focuses on your development, not simply documentation.

• You receive intentional opportunities to build unrestricted clinical experience.

• Your RBT credential and Wayfinder advancement come with defined pay increases.

• We schedule around eligible ABA coursework whenever operationally possible.

• You will join a small team where your ideas and contributions are valued.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a brief note explaining why play-based, child-led, assent-based ABA is the kind of work you want to practice. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.



SenseSational Learning Group is committed to building a diverse, neurodiversity-affirming team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager
jobs.description:
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary

May Mobility is growing and expanding our team and we are seeking our first Internal Audit Manager to help us build out our internal audit function. This role reports to the Director of Accounting, with the expectation that that will grow to report directly to our CFO and Audit Committee Chair.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead the preparation of the corporate risk assessment analysis and work with management and those charged with governance in planning audits

• Enhance the company’s control framework by contemplating documentation available to date and establishing and updating internal controls as a result of the risk assessment and business knowledge obtained within this role

• Support the execution of risk assessments for business and product areas, analyze gaps identified and recommend remediation actions for risk gaps

• Define audit scope and design control testing steps to evaluate the adequacy of the control designs and operating effectiveness

• Effectively partner with finance, legal, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure completion of remediation activities agreed upon during audit projects

• Provide guidance to all departments as to control and process best practices and assist with enhancing and establishing policies, implementation of new systems or applications incorporating responses to audit finding or recommendations

• Participate in cross-functional meetings to ensure regulatory and risk issues are properly identified and managed in new and existing product and services

• Lead trainings internally to increase awareness of internal controls

• Coordinate internal audit work performed by third-party firms

• Collaborate and provide recommendations on the future vision of the internal audit function, which includes considerations of resourcing, internal audit methods, and technology enablement

• Leads coordination with the external audit team in supporting the documentation required for internal controls for the annual audit

Skills and Abilities

Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:

• Demonstrated ability to implement new controls and processes within an organization and effectively document them

• Lead strategic advancement of the department; proactively seeking ways to elevate the technical expertise of the team

• Demonstrated ability to lead, foster and grow a team

• Identifies complex problems and devises optimal and innovative solutions that often cross organizational boundaries

• Orients work within teams to achieve business results

• Demonstrated focus on continuous improvement with regards to processes, planning and execution of activities

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

• CPA and/or CIA

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in an audit and/or advisory practice at a public accounting firm or a senior internal audit role, with a combination of both experiences a plus

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, COSO, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), risk and controls standards and business process best practices

• Firm grasp of technical accounting and SOX methodologies (controls design, risk assessment, testing strategies, etc.)

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and communicate complex issues clearly.

• Advanced technical, analytical, and communication skills

• Proven ability to deal with ambiguity

• Ability to effectively discuss audit findings and develop impactful solutions with business partners

Desirable Qualifications:

• Experience in helping a company get public company ready from an internal audit and controls perspective a plus

• Proven leadership experience managing audit teams and multiple concurrent projects, with a high degree of motivation and a strong work ethic

• Experience in identifying and implementing tools to advance and monitor Internal Controls

Physical Requirements

• Standard office working conditions which includes but not limited to:

• Prolonged sitting

• Prolonged standing

• Prolonged computer use

Travel Required?  Minimal: 1%-10%

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive healthcare suite including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans. Domestic partners who have been residing together at least one year are also eligible to participate.

• Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.

• Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.

• Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.

• Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.

• Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and/or people of color are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every qualification. At May Mobility, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you’re excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway! You may be the perfect candidate for this or another role at May.

Want to learn more about our culture & benefits? Check out our website!

May Mobility is an equal opportunity employer.  All applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetics or any other legally protected basis.   Below, you have the opportunity to share your preferred gender pronouns, gender, ethnicity, and veteran status with May Mobility to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring and recruitment processes. Completion of these questions is entirely voluntary.  Any information you choose to provide will be kept confidential, and will not impact the hiring decision in any way. If you believe that you will need any type of accommodation, please let us know.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: May Mobility does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Furthermore, May Mobility does not pay placement fees for candidates submitted by any agency other than its approved partners.

jobs.title: People Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
About Dreem Health, by Sunrise

Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We’re fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule.

Your Opportunity

Sunrise's HR function is being built from the ground up, in real time, while the company doubles in size. The foundations — job architecture, leveling, reward philosophy — are now taking shape. What's missing is the layer that keeps people *engaged, growing, and performing well* once they're hired: a consistent way to hear from employees, a real leadership development track for the wave of new managers this growth is creating, a performance management cycle that's more than a form, and an HR tooling landscape that supports the team & the managers instead of adding friction.

This role exists to improve that — to become the person who makes sure engagement data, leadership growth, and performance conversations actually take place within the organisation; the ultimate goal being to enable all employees to thrive, bring their best selves to work and go the extra mile to deliver Sunrise' compelling yet ambitious strategy.

You'll report to the HR Director and work alongside a small, senior HR team (US and EU HR Generalists, TA Principal, TA Specialist, and a Digital Workplace & AI Enablement specialist) split across Belgium and the US. You'll have real latitude to design these four programs largely from scratch, backed by leadership that already sees the gap and wants it closed — and real visibility, since engagement and leadership development outcomes will be reported at EXCOM level.

This is a build role, not a maintain role. If you like inheriting a mature, fully-staffed L&D or engagement function with established vendors and playbooks, this isn't it. If you want to design the playbook for a ~200-to-300-person healthcare scale-up and see your fingerprints on leadership development, people engagement & performance improvement, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

• Own employee engagement measurement end-to-end — design and run the engagement/pulse survey cadence, benchmark results over time, and turn findings into concrete action plans with managers and EXCOM rather than a one-off report.

• Own Learning & Development, with two clearly flagged priorities. L&D is a broad bucket and this role owns all of it, but two things matter most from day one:

• (1) leadership development — co-create Sunrise's leadership ambition hand-in-hand with EXCOM and design/deliver a leadership & manager development curriculum for first-time and existing people managers, the clear cornerstone of employee engagement;

• (2) AI adoption — build the training, habits, and team-level AI champions network that turn Sunrise's AI adoption strategy (co-led by the HR Director and the CTO) into everyday employee fluency. Everything else L&D grows into comes after these two.

• Own performance management design and delivery — run the end-to-end review cycle (goal-setting, check-ins, calibration), factoring in continuous feedback & employees' empowerment.

• Own the HR tooling landscape and its automation — map the current stack (Lucca, Justworks, Payfit, Greenhouse, Deel IT, Spendesk, and others), identify redundancy or gaps, and drive decisions on what to consolidate, replace, or automate — with the help of the Digital Workplace & AI Enablement specialist where needed. Ship the automations and process fixes that remove manual HR admin work and friction for employees and managers.

• Track and report on the health of these four pillars — build the metrics (engagement scores, manager NPS, review completion, tool adoption) that let the HR Director and EXCOM see progress, not just activity.

What You Bring

• 5+ years in HR, People Development, or a closely related field, with real ownership of at least two of: employee engagement, leadership/manager development, performance management, or HR systems

• Direct experience designing and facilitating leadership or manager development programs — not just administering someone else's curriculum

• Genuine tech savviness: comfortable evaluating, selecting, and driving adoption of HR/engagement/performance platforms, and thinking in terms of automation and process efficiency, not just policy

• Solid stakeholder management — equally credible in front of a first-time manager and an EXCOM member

• Creativity and curiosity — energized by building something from a blank page rather than running an existing playbook

• Comfortable operating in a multi-cultural, multi-entity environment (Belgium, France, US) with a profound understanding of the US working culture

• Excellent written and spoken English; French fluency would be an advantage

• Experience building or professionalizing an HR function during a high-growth phase (not just operating within a mature one) would be preferred

• Experience driving AI or technology adoption / digital change management within an organization is preferred

• Genuine interest in sleep, health, and helping people better understand and improve their well-being

Why You'll Love Working Here

• Mission that matters: you're helping fix a healthcare blind spot that affects over a billion people worldwide who don't get the sleep care they need.

• Real ownership, fast: four meaningful programs, largely undefined today, that are yours to design — not a seat in an existing machine.

• A seat close to the decisions: you'll work directly with the HR Director and have visibility at EXCOM level, on a team that's small enough that your work is seen and used, not filed away.

• A team built for this stage: a lean, senior, international HR team that already agrees on the gaps you're being hired to close — you won't have to build the case for why this role matters.

• Growth of your own: joining a company scaling from ~150 to 300+ people over the next two years means the scope of this role will grow with it.

Our Core Values

At Sunrise Group, we keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration 🤝, and lead with optimism and compassion 🌞. These values guide everything we do.

What We Offer

• Meaningful work that directly improves peoples’ lives

• Be part of an international team across the US, France, Belgium

• Annual team offsite

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• FREE One Medical membership

• 401(k) with company match

• 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + 80 hours paid sick leave

• Monthly phone and internet stipend

Compensation

$90,000 - $120,000 depending on experience.

We hire humans, not bullet points. Don’t meet every single qualification? That’s okay. We care more about who you are than what’s on your CV. We’re looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves — especially if you’re excited about building something new in healthcare. So if you think you could make an impact here, reach out to us.

Compensation Range - Depending on Experience

$90,000—$120,000 USD

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Part-Time Yard Associate
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — Forge & Build is Hiring a Yard Associate

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

Forge & Build is hiring a Part-Time Yard Associate at our facility in Imlay City, MI, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

The Yard Associate is responsible for maintaining daily yard operations and standards, ensuring an excellent customer experience while upholding safety standards throughout the yard at all times.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (Includes working weekends)

Primary Responsibilities

• Manage yard inventory control and procedures, including staging, loading, unloading, shipping, receiving, cycle counts, and transfers. Ensure all loads are accurate and delivered promptly.

• Maintain a safe, hazard-free, and organized yard in accordance with company standards. This includes general yard and building cleanup, routine inspections, maintenance, repairs, and equipment cleaning.

• Ensure all safety requirements and training are completed.

• Deliver a high standard of customer experience.

• Communicate issues that could impact the business to the Store Manager in a timely and effective manner.

• Assist with various other duties as assigned by the Yard Supervisor or Store Manager

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• 401(k) + company match

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

About Forge & Build

Forge & Build is a place contractors and customers can access all the materials and hardware they need to get the job done, as well as tech-powered equipment rentals.

At its foundation, Forge & Build was started by contractors for contractors. Its leadership team is different from our competitors because they know what it feels like to be a builder. They remember walking into a hardware store hoping to find everything in one place, but many times having to head to another store.

As a partner of EquipmentShare, Forge & Build is backed by one of the largest construction equipment buyers in the country, a nationwide support team and T3 technology that helps builders of America increase overall productivity, efficiency, and visibility. EquipmentShare is building connectivity for all verticals in construction including materials – which means having accurate and up-to-date information around inventory and location of materials to ensure our customers always have what they need.

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Ability to operate and maintain all equipment and vehicles in the yard, strictly adhering to all safety regulations and guidelines.

• Strong collaborative and autonomous work ethic; supports a teamwork mindset and is self-driven with an entrepreneurial mindset for continuous knowledge growth.

• Detail-oriented, ensuring the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned, with the ability to proactively solve problems.

• Adaptable and agile to quickly learn new and changing technologies and processes.

• Embodies the EquipmentShare mission and culture and adheres to all company employee policies.

• Regular and reliable attendance is mandatory.

Education and Experience:

• High School diploma or equivalent.

• Experience with providing a great customer experience.

• Basic math proficiency for calculating quantities and ensuring accurate inventory counts.

• Proven organizational, time management, detail-orientation, and problem-solving abilities.

• Effective and consistent communication skills with internal and external customers.

• Ability to adapt quickly, thrive, and succeed in a fast-paced environment.

• Must have an inherent desire to learn, develop, and strive for continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to work outdoors in extreme and varying weather conditions and temperatures.

• Lifting/Movement: Constantly lift and/or move objects up to 20 pounds; regularly lift and/or move objects, equipment parts, and tools up to 50 pounds or more; and occasionally move objects up to 100 pounds or more.

• Stamina & Mobility: Spend extended periods standing and walking on varying, possibly uneven surfaces, maneuvering throughout the yard and around large equipment/obstacles. May also remain stationary for long periods (standing or sitting). Move into different positions, including bending and stooping, to accomplish tasks in various environments, including tight and confined spaces.

• Dexterity: Use hands, fingers, and arms to manipulate tools, equipment, and small parts with precision and control. This includes constantly performing repetitive motions such as gripping, twisting, turning, fingering, handling, feeling, or making repeating motions and reaching.

• Senses: Good vision and hearing are essential for safely operating machinery, reading technical manuals, and communicating. Must have close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

• Safety: Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, steel-toed boots, and hearing protection at all times.

• Technology: Must be able to operate a computer and other office productivity machinery.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

jobs.title: AV Fleet Technician
jobs.description:
Kodiak Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2018 and has become a leader in autonomous ground transportation committed to a safer and more efficient future for all. The company has developed an artificial intelligence (AI) powered technology stack purpose-built for commercial trucking and the public sector. The company delivers freight daily for its customers across the southern United States using its autonomous technology. In 2024, Kodiak became the first known company to publicly announce delivering a driverless semi-truck to a customer. Kodiak is also leveraging its commercial self-driving software to develop, test and deploy autonomous capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense.

About the Role

As an AV Fleet Technician, you will execute maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair tasks across vehicle and autonomous (AV) systems in a shop environment.

You will complete assigned work orders, follow SOPs, and support day-to-day fleet operations to keep vehicles safe and operational. This role provides hands-on experience with AV systems, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows while working alongside experienced technicians.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

• 1–3 years of experience in fleet, automotive, or technical operations

• Experience working on heavy duty diesel trucks and trailers

• Hands-on electrical repair experience, including wiring harness repairs and connector termination

• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics

• Basic experience with maintenance or mechanical systems

• Willingness to learn AV systems and diagnostics

Nice to Have

• Experience in a shop or garage environment

• Exposure to autonomous vehicle systems or sensors

• Familiarity with tools, inspections, or maintenance workflows

What You’ll Do

Work Order Execution

• Execute maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting tasks on vehicles

• Complete work orders accurately and on time

• Perform inspections and basic repairs following SOPs

AV Systems Work

• Work with AV components including sensors, diagnostics, and system checks under guidance

• Capture logs, photos, and diagnostic data as required

• Follow defined workflows for AV-related tasks and escalate issues

SOP & Quality

• Follow SOPs to ensure safe and consistent execution

• Complete required documentation for all work performed

Team Execution

• Work under direction of Senior Technicians and Leads

• Participate in shift briefs, debriefs, and handoffs

• Escalate issues clearly and immediately

Mindset

• Detail-oriented with a focus on safety and accuracy

• Follows instructions and SOPs consistently

• Communicates clearly and escalates issues quickly

• Reliable and consistent in execution

Why Join Kodiak?

You will work hands-on with vehicles in a structured environment and gain experience with autonomous systems. This role provides the opportunity to build technical skills across diagnostics, maintenance, and AV technology while supporting fleet operations.

At Kodiak, we strive to build a diverse community working towards our common company goals in a safe and collaborative environment where harassment of any kind is strictly prohibited. Kodiak is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

In alignment with its business operations, Kodiak adheres to all relevant statutes, regulations, and administrative prerequisites. Accordingly, roles that carry more sensitive requirements may be limited to candidates that can satisfy additional scrutiny and eligibility for such positions may hinge on verification of a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status. Should the position require, and Kodiak determines that a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status necessitate an export license, bar the candidate from the position, or otherwise fall under national security-related restrictions, Kodiak will consider the candidate for alternative positions unaffected by such restrictions, under terms and conditions set forth at Kodiak’s sole discretion, or, as an alternative, opt not to proceed with the candidate’s application. If applicable, Kodiak may provide visa sponsorship for eligible candidates.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Engineering Finance
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Mission:

• Provide financial controlling and administrative support to the Engineering Center (Product and Manufacturing team) across the United States and Mexico.

• The position will dedicate approximately 60% of its activities to financial controlling, reporting, and budget management, and 40% to purchase order management, executive assistance, and administrative coordination.

• The role will work closely with Engineering leadership, department managers, Finance, HR, IT, Purchasing, and other support functions to ensure accurate financial monitoring and efficient day-to-day operations of the Engineering Center.

Main Activities:

Finance & Controlling | Approximately 60%

• Manage and monitor the Engineering Center budget

• Prepare and maintain monthly financial reports and dashboards, including budget versus actual cost analysis.

• Collaborate with the U.S. and Mexico Finance teams to review monthly results, identify cost deviations, and support corrective actions.

• Prepare quarterly financial forecasts and budget reforecasts for the Engineering Center.

• Coordinate the annual budget and strategic planning process with Engineering department heads and Finance.

• Maintain and consolidate headcount, workforce cost, and organizational data for Engineering center

• Monitor Engineering hours booked to projects and cost centers and prepare monthly reporting.

• Control SAP project hours and Engineering cost-center allocations, comparing budgeted hours with actual consumption.

• Support department managers with financial analysis and reporting to improve cost visibility and budget control.

• Develop and maintain financial tracking files, reports, and dashboards using Excel and, when applicable, Power BI.

Purchase Orders & Vendor Administration | Approximately 25%

• Create and manage purchase orders (POs) for Engineering activities, subcontractors, suppliers, and other departmental needs.

• Coordinate purchase requests, approvals, PO issuance, invoice processing, and follow-up payment.

• Work with Purchasing, Finance, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and internal requestors to resolve PO or invoice discrepancies.

• Track Engineering commitments and expenditures to ensure alignment with approved budgets.

• Maintain accurate records of POs, invoices, supplier commitments, and related financial documentation.

Executive & Administrative Support | Approximately 15%

• Provide executive administrative support to the Engineering Director and general administrative support to the Engineering organization.

• Coordinate business travel arrangements and related administrative activities for the Engineering Director and support the Engineering team when required.

• Maintain and update Engineering organization charts and department information.

• Coordinate new employee onboarding, working with managers, HR, IT, and other support functions.

• Facilitate coordination among Engineering teams and corporate support functions.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Management, or a related field.

• Preferably 2 to 3 years of experience in finance, business administration, controlling, purchasing support, or executive/administrative assistance.

• Experience in an engineering, manufacturing, or automotive environment is a plus.

• Technical Skills

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Good working knowledge of SAP, particularly for cost-center monitoring, project hours, purchase orders, and cost tracking.

• Experience with financial reporting, budget tracking, forecasting, and cost analysis.

• Ability to work with financial data accurately and prepare clear management reports.

• Power BI knowledge is a plus.

Professional Skills:

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities.

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with financial data.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.

• Comfortable working in a diverse and multicultural environment.

• Professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential financial and business information.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

Please beware of job seeker scams and see this important notice on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Product Foundations
jobs.description:
Why Cast AI?

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

Global team, diverse perspectives
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

Unicorn momentum
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.

This is a location-specific opportunity. We are currently accepting applications from candidates residing in the following European countries: Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Greece, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Ukraine.

What you'll be solving

Every dollar Cast AI saves a customer has to be provable, every action taken on their infrastructure has to be attributable to someone authorized to take it, and every price used to make that case has to be current across every cloud, region, and availability zone. This is the trust and accounting layer underneath the whole platform: get it wrong, and customers can't log in, can't trust the savings number, or get billed incorrectly - any one of which ends the relationship.

This posting covers multiple teams working on different pieces of the same trust-and-accounting problem: authentication, authorization, and SSO for every user and workload. Billing, audit trails, notifications, and feature flags that keep the platform transparent for every customer. Real-time cloud pricing tracking across every region and availability zone, including Spot availability and discounts. And reporting that turns high-volume time-series data into fast, accurate answers about what the automation actually saved.

Requirements

• Strong software engineering fundamentals: you design clean abstractions, write maintainable code, and can justify your architecture choices - not just make something work.

• Production experience with Go is strongly preferred; candidates without Go should demonstrate strong systems programming skills in a comparable language.

• You've built or operated trust-critical systems at scale - authentication/authorization, billing, or financial/accounting-adjacent data, where being wrong has real consequences.

• Good understanding of API design best practices - versioning, backward compatibility, auth, idempotency, async patterns, and similar.

• Strong debugging, optimization, and performance-tuning skills – including query profiling, index design, and database performance tuning beyond ORM usage.

• Experience operating and optimizing systems under high load - you know how to find and fix the bottleneck, not just add more resources.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes - you understand the core concepts (pods, services, deployments) and have deployed or debugged something on a cluster.

• Experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows.

• You've personally driven a complex project end-to-end.

• Strong English skills, both verbal and written.

• Startup mindset: adaptable, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity.

• Participate in on-call rotation for teams that require it.

Nice to haves

• Multi-tenant identity system design - authentication, authorization, SSO.

• Enterprise identity protocols - SAML, OIDC, and SCIM for enterprise account provisioning and sync.

• Billing, audit-trail, notification, or feature-flag systems in production.

• Experience with cloud provider pricing/billing APIs across AWS, GCP, or Azure, or tracking Spot instance availability.

• High-cardinality time-series ingestion and querying at scale.

• Understanding of Kubernetes internals.

• CI/CD and DevOps practices experience.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) in production.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate backend services in Go that other teams and customers depend on being correct.

• Own features end-to-end: from design through implementation, testing, and production rollout.

• Debug complex production issues involving security-, money-, or trust-critical flows.

• Collaborate with product and other engineering teams to solve problems that don't have textbook solutions.

• Contribute to product direction and backlog - shape what gets built next, not just how it's built.

Tools we use daily

• Programming Language: Go

• Cloud & Orchestration: Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

• Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Cloud Object Storage, ClickHouse

• Messaging & APIs: GCP Pub/Sub, gRPC for internal communication, REST for public APIs

• Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitLab CI with ArgoCD

What’s in it for you?

• Competitive salary (€6,500 – €9,000 gross, depending on the level of experience) plus separate compensation for on-call participation (passive coverage and active interventions)

• Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.

• Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology.

• Equity options.

• Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.

• Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.

• Learning budget for professional and personal development – including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.

• Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.

• Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Strategic Accounts)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Strategic Accounts

Okta: The World’s Identity Company™

Okta is the leader in Identity management and The World’s Identity Company™. Our mission is to build a more secure world. Okta provides a neutral, powerful, and extensible platform that puts identity at the heart of your stack. Our platforms secure all types of identity, including customers, employees, partners, and AI agents.

Top brands trust Okta. We are relied upon by two thirds of the Fortune 100 and over 40% of the Forbes Global 2000 for their Identity-powered journeys.

The Strategic Accounts Opportunity

• Okta Platform Focus: Primary focus on Workforce Identity Solutions (Okta WIC), with foundational Customer Identity (Auth0) exposure.

• Segment Scope: Strategic Accounts (Global enterprise clients with high-complexity, multi-org hybrid environments).

• Travel: Some travel is required, including in-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ OR Chicago office during the first week of employment.

This role is integral to the Strategic Segment team. As a P3 Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor and advocate for a portfolio of Okta's largest, most complex global enterprises across industries such as Public Sector, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, and Technology.

Key Identity Solutions & Technologies You Will Support

You will guide enterprise customers through complex deployment architectures across core workforce solutions and developer-focused identity integrations:

• Workforce Identity Cloud (Primary Focus): Identity & Access Management (IAM): Single Sign-On (SSO), Adaptive MFA, Device Access, API Access Management, Secure Partner Access, Access Gateway, and Universal Directory. Identity Governance & Administration (IGA): Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and Identity Governance (automated SCIM provisioning and zero standing privileges). Privileged Access Management (PAM): Privileged Access controls. Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR): Identity Security Posture Management, Identity Threat Protection, and Syslog integration.

• Customer Identity & Developer Tools: Modern authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC). Direct API interactions using Okta REST APIs. Okta Sign-In Widget and Auth JS SDKs for custom application authentication and login UI customization.

What You'll Be Doing

Strategic Partnership & Account Leadership

• Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor for identity leads, enterprise architects, and technical executives within your assigned strategic accounts.

• Independently design and drive multi-year technical adoption roadmaps aligned with customer security posture and business goals.

• Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Account Executives to secure Okta’s footprint against competitive displacement and identify expansion opportunities.

Technical Execution, API Prototyping & Advocacy

• Hands-On Demos & PoCs: Configure test environments (e.g., Salesforce developer tenants) and build Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to demonstrate live SAML/OIDC integrations, custom login widgets, and Adaptive MFA policies.

• API Validation & Scripting: Use Postman to test and validate Okta REST APIs (executing CRUD operations for user/group lifecycle management and policy automation).

• Complex Problem Resolution: Dissect multi-faceted enterprise issues, proactively identify technical risks, and independently drive escalations through Engineering and Support.

• Serve as the voice of the strategic customer internally, influencing Okta product management and roadmap decisions.

Thought Leadership & Mentorship

• Deliver custom technical workshops, architectural reviews, and best-practice sessions for customer engineering teams.

• Develop repeatable technical assets, Postman collections, and deployment strategy guides for the global TAM organization.

• Mentor P1/P2 peers, driving team enablement and technical capability expansion.

What You'll Bring to the Role

• Experience: 5+ years of related technical experience in customer-facing engineering roles (or 4+ years with a Master’s degree), including 3+ years as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Senior Support Engineer.

• Domain Knowledge: 3+ years in identity and access management (SSO, MFA, directory services, lifecycle management, or zero trust architectures).

• Education & Certifications: BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience). Okta Certified Administrator/Consultant, CISSP, or equivalent certifications preferred.

Technical Mastery

• Federation & Protocols: Practical mastery of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, and WS-Federation protocols.

• API Prototyping Tools: Hands-on proficiency using Postman to execute REST API requests, manage environments/collections, and troubleshoot API integrations.

• Development & Web Basics: Ability to read and modify simple web applications (e.g., HTML/JS, Node.js, Python) to demonstrate authentication flows, public vs. protected route logic, and group-based access control using the Okta Sign-In Widget or Okta Auth JS.

• Enterprise Ecosystems: Experience integrating major SaaS platforms (Salesforce, Workday, Office 365, Box) via SAML, SCIM, and automated provisioning workflows.

• Security & SIEM: Familiarity with risk-based authentication policies, behavioral analysis, and syslog monitoring/SIEM integrations.

Communication & Executive Presence

• Strong communication skills with proven ability to translate complex technical concepts for both developer/architect teams and C-level stakeholders.

• Confident performing live technical demonstrations, interactive whiteboarding, and real-time troubleshooting under pressure.

• Strong project management capabilities with a track record of driving technical health across high-stakes accounts.

jobs.description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm.  Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity.  We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

Summary:

Scrum Master for Digital Projects at Commercial BI&T will be responsible for facilitating and guiding the Agile development process for our initiatives. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, machine learning engineers, software developers, and product owners, to ensure the successful delivery of Digital projects. The Scrum Master will help the team adhere to Agile principles, remove impediments, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Project Description: Large-scale, multi-region Foundational Data Transformation program migrating fragmented commercial pharma data warehouses onto a governed Databricks platform. The program consolidates enterprise data sources (sales, market access, patient services, omni-channel, and master data) into standardized, AI-ready data products across US, EU, and other global markets, and rebuilds existing analytics pipelines to new data modeling standards.

Key Responsibilities and Duties:

1. Facilitate Agile Processes:

• Scrum Ceremonies: Organize and facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

• Sprint Planning: Assist the team in defining sprint goals, planning tasks, and estimating effort for each sprint.

• Backlog Management: Work with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is well-groomed, prioritized, and ready for upcoming sprints.

2. Team Support and Coaching:

• Agile Coaching: Coach team members on Agile principles and practices, helping them to understand and adopt Scrum methodologies.

• Remove Impediments: Identify and remove any impediments or obstacles that may hinder the team's progress.

• Foster Collaboration: Promote a collaborative team environment where open communication, trust, and respect are encouraged.

3. Project Coordination:

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, machine learning engineers, software developers, and other stakeholders, to ensure alignment and integration of projects.

• Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues.

4. Continuous Improvement:

• Retrospectives: Facilitate sprint retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement actionable plans to enhance team performance.

• Process Optimization: Continuously assess and improve Agile processes and practices to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

5. Performance Tracking and Reporting:

• Metrics and KPIs: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure team performance and project progress.

• Progress Reporting: Prepare and present regular progress reports to stakeholders and senior management.

6. Risk Management:

• Risk Identification: Identify potential risks and issues that may impact project delivery and develop mitigation strategies.

• Issue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve any issues that arise during the project lifecycle.

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP) is a plus.

Skills and Qualifications:

• Experience: Technical/data background with long track record of experience as a Scrum Master. Proven track record of successfully delivering data/analytics-focused projects. Pharma GxP software development experience preferred

• Agile Expertise: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and best practices.

• Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively manage teams and engage stakeholders.

• Analytical and Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify issues, assess risks, and develop solutions.

• Facilitation Skills: Ability to facilitate meetings, discussions, and decision-making processes effectively.

Competencies:

• Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and project requirements.

• Collaboration: Strong ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

• Attention to Detail: High level of attention to detail to ensure project deliverables meet quality standards.

• Continuous Improvement: Commitment to continuous learning and improvement of Agile practices and processes.
