Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS), Seres Therapeutics (NASDAQ:MCRB), Generate Biomedicines, Tessera Tx, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), and Indigo Agriculture.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly organized and hands-on Laboratory Operations Associate to support sample management, inventory, and day-to-day operations for our CMC and broader laboratory teams. This candidate will work closely with the CMC team to build and maintain an efficient sample management and inventory system, help organize final cargo and coordinate handoffs across teams, and support procurement of key reagents and consumables. We are looking for an individual with strong bench and instrument experience, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally with scientists and operations leadership. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate with sample management and/or lab operations experience who is looking to grow into a lab management role, as part of a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative team.

Key Responsibilities:

CMC Support

• Work closely with the CMC team to build out and maintain their sample management and inventory system

• Organize final cargo and support handoffs of materials to other teams across the company

• Provide regular updates on cargo inventory status to the Director of CMC, Head of Analytics, Senior Manager of Operations, and other team leads

• Partner with scientists and the Senior Manager of Operations to organize inventory and coordinate procurement of key enzymes, buffers, and other consumables.

Lab Operations Support

• Run decontamination and cleaning protocols on Fragment Analyzers and flow cytometers (including the yeast cytometer and sorter) on a weekly basis

• Complete daily “Lab Tasks” to maintain lab organization cleanliness, and readiness.

• Support lab space optimization efforts as the team grows within an increasingly confined footprint

• Troubleshoot key laboratory equipment and support routine equipment upkeep

• Perform Category B equipment maintenance (freezer defrosts, incubator PMs, centrifuge calibrations, pipette calibration scheduling, etc.)

• Provide procurement support for general lab consumables

Lab Onboarding Support

• Assist in executing new lab member onboarding, including bench allocation; procurement of benchtop equipment and consumables (pipettes, centrifuges, freezers);

• Support fridge and freezer allocation; safety training checks; and small lab consumables procurement.

• Help ensure team members are set up efficiently to work safely and effectively in the lab.

Education and Qualifications:

• BS degree in Biology, chemistry, Biochemistry or related field

• 2+ years of experience in laboratory operations, sample management or both

• Hands-on bench experience at the Research Associate or Associate Scientist level

• Experience in sample management and/or laboratory operations (experience in both is a plus)

• Hands-on experience with cytometers, Fragment Analyzers, and chromatography instruments

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with scientists and operations leadership

• Ability to lift up to 30 lbs

• Candidates with sample management experience who are looking to grow into a lab management role are strongly encouraged to apply

More About Flagship Pioneering

We are creative optimists and we would love for you to consider joining our team!  See all our open opportunities across Flagship Pioneering’s Ecosystem!

Flagship Pioneering conceives, creates, resources, and develops first-in-category life sciences companies to transform human health and sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, the firm has applied a unique hypothesis-driven innovation process to originate and foster more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in over $34 billion in aggregate value. To date, Flagship is backed by more than $4.4 billion of aggregate capital commitments, of which over $1.9 billion has been deployed toward the founding and growth of its pioneering companies alongside more than $10 billion of follow-on investments from other institutions. jobs.title: Senior SDK Engineer
jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior SDK Engineer to join our team to help design, build, ship, and support end-to-end features and products that will help developers make more money. We want to bring somebody onboard that is product focused, customer focused, and passionate about building mobile SDKs with a great developer experience.

This role will primarily focus on either our iOS or Android SDK (depending on your core experience), but also requires contributions to our other platform + hybrid SDKs, from time to time. Experience in these other platforms is not a requirement but the desire and excitement to work on them is.




ABOUT YOU:

 - You have 8+ years of experience in software, and have shipped mobile apps to Apple App Store or Google Play Store

 - You are very experienced in Swift and Swift UI (iOS) or Java/Kotlin and Compose UI (Android)

 - You are not afraid of iOS, Android, cross platform, or hybrid platforms.

 - You love making products for developers.

 - You love shipping good products.

 - You have deep empathy for customers.

 - You know how to ship high quality code using good testing practices in iterative cycles.

 - You collaborate well with others and can communicate effectively in a fully-remote culture.

 - You are proactive. When you see something broken, you jump on it to fix it or suggest improvements.

 - You move fast, test, and iterate quickly.

 - You ask questions when you're stuck on something.

 - You are excited to be part of a growing team.


BONUS:

 - You have experience building SDKs.

 - You have experience in server driven user interfaces.

 - You have shipped your own app to Google Play or the App Store.

 - You have experience in Python or other backend development.


IN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:

 - Learn about our customers, our SDK, the in-app subscription ecosystem, the problems RevenueCat helps solve, and how our SDKs fit into that.

 - Open your first pull request and deploy changes to be used by 32,000+ apps.

 - Onboard into our codebase by working on your very first project and shipping it 😺

 - Learn how we maintain as much transparency as possible with our work in GitHub.

 - Begin reviewing code and add to our engineering culture.


WITHIN THE FIRST 3 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Be able to scope and work on projects self-sufficiently.

 - Participate in code reviews, and contribute in other ways (testing, visibility, etc.) to improve reliability and quality of the codebase.

 - Understand every product owned by your team.

 - Understand and improve many of the codebases that the team works with.


WITHIN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Be the most knowledgeable person on several key features.

 - Have your own initiatives for improving the code base and our infrastructure.

 - Contribute to the team roadmap and technical direction.

 - Have shipped a major product or feature.


WITHIN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Know more about mobile subscriptions than anyone ever should.

 - Use your knowledge to contribute ideas to RevenueCat’s suite of solutions.

 - Be able to spec, architect and build any feature we might want to build.

 - Have experience in all areas of technology stack related to SDKs and be the primary expert/owner of at least one area.

 - Help mentor and onboard new engineers, shaping the RevenueCat engineering culture as we continue to expand the team.

 - Help prioritize the roadmap to provide maximum value to developers, while pushing the team and technology forward.


WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

 - 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

 - A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

 - 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

 - Paid desk at a co-working space

 - Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend


INTERVIEWING AT REVENUECAT

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat https://www.revenuecat.com/blog/company/how-we-hire-at-revenuecat/, including tips to help you succeed.

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. jobs.title: Industrial Equipment Technician - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Industrial Equipment Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of industrial equipment and machinery to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation. This position supports production by performing preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electro-mechanical systems while minimizing equipment downtime.

Key Responsibilities

• Inspect, diagnose, maintain, and repair industrial equipment and production machinery.

• Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on mechanical and electrical systems.

• Install, assemble, align, wire, and commission new machinery and equipment.

• Troubleshoot and repair electrical systems, including motors, motor starters, relays, contactors, sensors, limit switches, solenoids, transformers, and control panels.

• Diagnose and repair PLC-controlled equipment, variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo motors, and industrial automation systems.

• Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, blueprints, and equipment manuals.

• Install and replace electrical components, conduit, wiring, disconnects, and control devices in accordance with applicable electrical codes and company standards.

• Troubleshoot mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including pumps, gearboxes, conveyors, compressors, bearings, belts, chains, and power transmission equipment.

• Use electrical test equipment such as multimeters, clamp meters, insulation testers, and megohm meters to diagnose equipment issues.

• Perform equipment alignment, calibration, lubrication, and mechanical adjustments.

• Complete maintenance work orders and maintain accurate documentation using a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).

• Respond to emergency equipment failures and participate in planned maintenance shutdowns.

• Collaborate with production, engineering, and maintenance teams to improve equipment reliability, efficiency, and safety.

• Follow all OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and company safety policies.

Basic:

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• 6+ years experience working as Industrial Equipment Technician in an industrial capacity.
• Must have or be able to obtain a UAW Journey Card.

Preferred:

• Completion of a 4 year apprentice program certified by the US Dept of Labor.

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.

Hourly Compensation: The U.S. base hourly wage for this full-time position is $40.62r with an additional shift premium based on the assigned shift.

In addition to your base compensation, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.

Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: www.myboschbenefits.com. Pay ranges included in the postings generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, commission, or additional benefits.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

Please note that employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

jobs.description:

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees. We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

This position involves traveling LOCALLY to multiple sites to support Data Center Infrastructure & Cloud operations

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

• Conduct physical inspections and routine maintenance on data center equipment to ensure operational reliability.

• Frequent standing, bending, and moving within confined spaces in the data center.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (Fueling)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a passionate Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic team in Atlanta, GA. This is more than just a job — it’s a launchpad for your future. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary crew of innovators, expand your expertise, and gain invaluable field experience through travel opportunities. You’ll work on exciting and challenging projects with iconic clients like AFCEC, NAVFAC, and USACE. Ready to build what matters?

Job Responsibilities include but not limited to:

• Electrical Engineer will serve as discipline design lead on projects that include an emphasis on receipt, storage, transfer, and issue of finished fuel products such as aviation jet fuel, diesel fuel, ethanol, and motor gasoline.
• Projects include tanker truck fuel receipt, marine vessel fuel receipt, aboveground and underground transfer pipelines, aboveground and underground horizontal and vertical fuel storage tanks, and aircraft and tanker truck fuel issue systems. Projects will also include ground vehicle refueling systems such as fleet and retail service stations.
• Electrical Engineer will work and coordinate with multidiscipline engineering teams including civil, structural, and mechanical engineers.
• Position will include responsibility for development of discipline specific design execution plans for assigned projects. Position will be responsible for completing projects on schedule and within the established budgets and for ensuring that all discipline specific contract requirements have been met. Electrical Engineer will ensure that designs following established project quality procedures and that required quality control reviews and checks are completed and documented.
• Electrical Engineer will assist in training and supervision of work of junior and entry-level electrical engineers conducting fueling design work.
• Conducts engineering design under limited supervision of an experienced engineer.
• Prepare detailed calculations, drawings, technical specifications, design and installation packages, proposal evaluations, technical reports, cost estimates, detailed analyses and other materials suitable for construction purposes under the supervision of an experienced engineer.
• Collect and analyze data under the supervision of an experienced engineer.
• Applies advanced understanding of concepts, industry knowledge and technical capabilities.
• Use of computer software as a tool for solving complex engineering problems.
• Provide structured guidance and training to develop junior engineers and enhance team capabilities.
• Works independently with latitude to determine work priorities and requires minimal guidance on overall project objectives.
• Performs work in accordance with agreed upon budget and schedule with moderate supervision.
• Works and coordinates with multidiscipline engineering teams.
• Conveys complex or sensitive information, topics and concepts with internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensures that designs following established project quality procedures and required quality control reviews and checks are completed and documented.
• Able to perform surveys and evaluations of existing conditions to formulate a fully coordinated scope of work within code compliant electrical designs.
• Travel to construction sites to conduct electrical inspections.

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical engineering or a related field and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency and/or education.
• Minimum of 6 years experience in buildings and facilities engineering with specific experience in the design of modifications to low voltage (480 V and below) electrical power systems for commercial, government and institutional facilities including office tenant space, utilities and support facilities.
• Experience with Autocad (4+ years), Revit (3+ years), Microsoft Office, Bluebeam.
• Familiar with SKM, AGi32 or similar calculations and modeling software.
• Due to the nature of work, U.S. citizenship is required.
• Must have a valid U.S. driver's license and as a condition of employment, must be able to pass AECOM's Motor Vehicle Records review.
• Ability to pass background checks and gain access to military installations.
• Ability to travel one week at a time, dependent on project, within the US and internationally.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional Engineer license is preferred.
• Experience with commercial and/or Department of Defense (DoD) fuel system design projects. Other experience related to process design, wastewater treatment, and/or heavy industry design projects will be considered as an alternate.

jobs.title: Senior Software (Quality Engineer 4) - CoE structure
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Senior Software Quality Engineer serves as a technical quality leader providing independent quality oversight for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), Software in Medical Device (SiMD), Digital Health, AI/ML-enabled products, and cloud-connected healthcare solutions. This role partners closely with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Product Security, Regulatory Affairs, and Product Quality teams to drive quality by design throughout the software development lifecycle.

Unlike traditional quality roles focused primarily on documentation review and compliance activities, this position engages early in product development to identify technical risks, influence software quality practices, evaluate architecture decisions, promote testability, and strengthen software delivery processes while maintaining independent quality judgment.

The Senior Software Quality Engineer participates in requirements, architecture, design, verification, cybersecurity, and release readiness reviews as a technical quality partner. The role is responsible for ensuring software products are developed using sound engineering practices and comply with applicable regulatory, quality, cybersecurity, and risk management expectations.

This individual is expected to possess strong software engineering knowledge, a deep understanding of modern SDLC practices, and the ability to effectively challenge technical decisions through objective quality and risk-based assessment.

The Senior Software Quality Engineer serves as a technical quality partner and independent quality authority. The role actively participates in requirements, architecture, and design activities; however, ownership of engineering requirements, software architecture, implementation decisions, and design specifications remains with Engineering. The SW QE provides technical quality consultation, risk assessment, and independent oversight while maintaining objectivity for design control and release decisions.

Essential Job Duties:

Technical Quality Leadership

Serve as the Product Quality representative for software-intensive products and provide independent quality oversight across the software development lifecycle.

Partner with software and systems engineering teams to drive quality-by-design principles early in product development.

Participate in architecture, design, and technical review activities to identify quality, reliability, maintainability, and cybersecurity risks before implementation.

Evaluate software development practices and ensure alignment with industry-recognized engineering and quality principles.

Promote shift-left quality practices that prevent defects rather than relying solely on downstream verification activities.

Software Development Lifecycle Oversight

Assess software lifecycle execution against IEC 62304, FDA Quality System requirements, ISO 13485, and applicable organizational procedures.

Review software requirements, design specifications, risk controls, traceability structures, verification strategies, and release evidence to ensure lifecycle integrity.

Provide quality consultation on software development methodologies including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, iterative development, and hybrid lifecycle models.

Evaluate software engineering deliverables for quality, completeness, maintainability, testability, and technical risk.

Architecture & Design Quality

Participate in software architecture and design reviews as an independent quality and risk management partner.

Assess system designs for scalability, modularity, reliability, resilience, maintainability, and testability.

Review integration architectures, interface designs, cloud-connected systems, APIs, embedded systems, and software platforms for quality and compliance concerns.

Challenge technical assumptions and facilitate risk-based discussions regarding design decisions and implementation approaches.

DevOps, Configuration Management & Release Quality

Evaluate software configuration management practices including source control, branching strategies, build management, release management, and product traceability.

Assess CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates for effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

Review software release readiness criteria, build reproducibility controls, deployment processes, and software integrity safeguards.

Provide oversight of software bill of materials (SBOM), software configuration baselines, and release governance activities.

Verification, Validation & Test Engineering

Assess software verification and validation strategies using risk-based and quality-focused approaches.

Evaluate automation frameworks, test coverage, traceability, defect trends, and verification effectiveness.

Promote development of automated testing solutions including unit, integration, system, API, performance, and end-to-end testing approaches.

Drive testability considerations during requirements and architecture phases.

Cybersecurity & Secure Development

Evaluate software cybersecurity risks throughout the product lifecycle.

Collaborate with Product Security and Cybersecurity teams to promote Secure SDLC practices.

Participate in threat modeling, security risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, and cybersecurity readiness activities.

Support compliance with FDA cybersecurity guidance, NIST frameworks, and industry best practices for secure medical device development.

AI/ML & Digital Health Quality

Support quality and regulatory oversight of AI/ML-enabled software solutions.

Assess AI lifecycle controls related to data quality, model validation, bias mitigation, transparency, and traceability.

Promote risk-based validation strategies for AI-enabled healthcare products.

Support adoption of emerging technologies while maintaining patient safety, product quality, and regulatory compliance.

Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement

Support development and continuous improvement of software quality processes and procedures.

Participate in CAPA investigations, root cause analysis, audits, inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Develop and monitor software quality metrics that support risk-based decision making.

Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineering teams on software quality best practices.

Required Skills and Experience

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Software Engineering Experience

Minimum 8 years of experience in software engineering, software quality engineering, software test engineering, systems engineering, or related software development disciplines.

Prior hands-on experience in software development, software testing, automation engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or product development environments.

Demonstrated ability to understand and evaluate software implementations beyond document review activities.

Technical Competencies

Strong understanding of the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including requirements, architecture, design, implementation, verification, deployment, maintenance, and post-market support.

Working knowledge of software programming concepts and software development practices.

Ability to review and understand software code, architecture diagrams, interface designs, and technical implementation approaches.

Demonstrated ability to read, understand, and evaluate production software implementations, software architecture, and technical design decisions.

Ability to review source code, pull requests, automation frameworks, and CI/CD workflows to identify quality, reliability, maintainability, and compliance risks.

Experience working with software technologies such as C++, Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar languages sufficient to assess implementation quality and technical risk.

The successful candidate can credibly engage with software engineers, understand software architecture and implementation decisions, review code and technical artifacts, identify technical quality risks, and independently influence software quality outcomes throughout the development lifecycle.

DevOps & Configuration Management

Experience with Git-based source control systems.

Understanding of modern software configuration management principles.

Experience with CI/CD technologies including Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent platforms.

Knowledge of software build systems, deployment pipelines, release management, and software traceability controls.

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

Experience evaluating or developing automated testing solutions.

Knowledge of software testing methodologies including unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and performance testing.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cobalt
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Tubi's native app runtime for connected TVs on Cobalt, the lightweight, open-source browser engine behind YouTube on living room devices. You will own the layer between Tubi's React app and the device: the Cobalt engine, its Starboard porting layer, and new native components we write in C++ and Rust.

The goal is a Tubi app that launches faster, uses less memory, and behaves the same on every device, starting with Fire TV and expanding to other CTV platforms. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a small team, working closely with our web engineers, QA, and device partners.

This is a hybrid role which is two days in the SF office.

What You'll Do:

• Build, integrate, and ship Cobalt as the runtime for Tubi's CTV apps, packaged as a native library inside our Android (Fire TV) app and later on other platforms

• Implement and maintain Starboard platform integrations: graphics, input, audio/video playback, DRM, and system services

• Write new native modules in modern C++ and Rust, including safe FFI boundaries between the two

• Drive startup and memory performance on low-end, memory-constrained devices (1 GB RAM class): profile, measure, and fix

• Keep us current with upstream Cobalt releases, track and contribute fixes upstream, and manage security patches for the engine we ship

• Work with media and playback teams on video pipeline needs such as demuxing, adaptive streaming, and ad playback

• Build tooling that runs the Tubi app on Cobalt on developer machines and in CI, so we can test UI and automation without a device farm

• Work directly with device partners' engineering teams on platform issues

• Mentor engineers and raise the team's native and systems engineering bar

Your Background:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering, most of it in systems or native code

• Expert-level modern C++ (C++17/20): memory management, concurrency, templates, and debugging large codebases

• Strong production experience in Rust: ownership and lifetimes, async, unsafe code, and C/C++ interop (FFI, bindgen/cxx)

• Experience with large C++ build systems (GN/Ninja, CMake, or Bazel) and cross-compiling for ARM and embedded Linux or Android targets

• Hands-on performance work: profiling CPU, memory, and startup time with tools like perf, Perfetto, or heaptrack, and turning findings into measurable wins

• Comfort debugging on real hardware: Android NDK, adb, native crash analysis, and symbolication

• Clear written communication and a track record of leading technical initiatives across teams

Nice to Have

• Experience with Cobalt, Starboard, Chromium, or another browser engine (Blink, WebKit, Servo)

• JavaScript engine internals, especially V8: code caching, snapshots, or GC tuning

• Graphics on embedded devices: OpenGL ES, Skia, or WebGPU

• Media pipelines: MSE/EME, ExoPlayer or native players, demuxers, Widevine or PlayReady DRM

• Shipping on TV platforms such as Fire TV, Android TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, or Roku

• Open-source contributions to C++ or Rust projects

• Enough React and TypeScript to work with the web app running on top of the engine

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description:
Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams. It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.



THE JOB

You’ll work on a fast-moving AI team, owning problems from initial exploration through production.

 - Turn messy financial data and ambiguous problems into working AI products, starting with simple baselines and adding complexity only when it earns its keep

 - Build evaluations that reflect real user outcomes, then use error analysis, ablations, and production feedback to make the system better

 - Make practical tradeoffs across model quality, cost, latency, determinism, reliability, and maintainability

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to build AI features that take real work off finance teams’ plates
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Strong statistical and machine learning fundamentals, with good judgment about when the answer is classical ML, an LLM, agents, or something in between

 - Experience shipping ML or AI systems end-to-end, from data and evaluation through production

 - Comfort making progress with noisy data, weak labels, incomplete specifications, and imperfect supervision

 - Experience across several of: classical ML, embeddings, retrieval and reranking, similarity search, model evaluation, LLM applications, and agentic systems

 - Strong Python skills and the ability to contribute to production software; TypeScript or modern web application experience is a plus
   


EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

We welcome a range of backgrounds. Successful candidates will typically have one of the following:

 - A bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative field plus 3+ years of relevant industry or applied research experience

 - A relevant master’s degree plus 1+ year of relevant industry or applied research experience

 - A relevant PhD; doctoral research counts as relevant experience, with 3 years of substantive doctoral research considered equivalent to the experience above

 - Equivalent practical experience demonstrated through shipped systems, independent research, open-source work, or another nontraditional path
   


HOW WE WORK

We’re a small team, so everyone has a hand in deciding what to build and making it work in the real world.

 - We ship, learn from real usage, and iterate

 - We make assumptions explicit, follow the evidence, and communicate tradeoffs clearly

 - We stick with hard problems and welcome better ideas, regardless of where they come from

 - We help where the team needs us, even when it falls outside our immediate scope

 - We collaborate closely in person five days a week
   

No one gets extra points for making the solution more complicated than the problem.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We care most about curiosity, craft, judgment, and drive.


PERKS AND BENEFITS (FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES)

 - Competitive compensation and equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Up to 100% employer covered monthly healthcare premium (medical, dental, vision)

 - Lunch provided via Sharebite, plus dinner for any later in office days.

 - Parental leave up to 12 weeks

 - Tax free commuter and parking benefits

 - Voluntary insurances (Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, Accident)

 - Employee Assistance Program (Rightway)

 - Free One Medical Membership

 - 401k

Tabs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome teammates of all identities and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can grow, contribute, and feel comfortable being themselves.

jobs.title: Executive Producer, Game Presentation
jobs.description:
Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment creates bold, authentic, and unforgettable experiences that redefine sports, entertainment, and hospitality, The Brooklyn Way. As the parent company of marquee properties including the Brooklyn Nets, NY Liberty and Barclays Center, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment operates at the intersection of live entertainment, premium hospitality, and community engagement.

As it expands its existing portfolio, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment now includes BK Mag, Brooklyn Wine Club, and a hospitality business developing several location-based entertainment properties.

Whether on the court, on stage, or in the workplace, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment is driven by a pursuit of excellence—constantly evolving, innovating, and pushing boundaries to elevate its business and expand its fan base. The company is deeply committed to fostering a culture of belonging and inclusion, both internally and across its communities, ensuring that every interaction reflects its values of growth mindset, integrity, accountability and care.

We are guided by our core values:

• Integrity: Be intellectually honest at all times. Demonstrate the highest professional and ethical standards.

• Care: Care for everything and everyone around us. Practice empathy, respect, and inclusion to promote an environment of excellence and success.

• Growth Mindset: Develop ourselves and those around us. Experiment, learn, and improve from everything we do.

• Accountability: Deliver on our word, take responsibility for our actions, and work in the interest of our team.

SUMMARY

The Executive Producer, Game Presentation will lead the creative development, production, and execution of game-night experiences across the Brooklyn Nets, New York Liberty, and Long Island Nets. Working closely with Marketing, this role will translate the strategy, audience priorities, and business objectives for each night into a cohesive live experience that builds fan affinity and creates homecourt advantage.

The Executive Producer will oversee each game-night show from concept through execution, partnering across Basketball Operations, Partnerships, Venue Operations, Creative, Content, Social, Fan Engagement, and external production partners. This role will lead the development of runs of show and scripts, in-bowl entertainment content, entertainment-team integration, and select external events, while overseeing the performance side of game presentation, including hosts, entertainment teams, mascots, game-night staff, and music staff.

The ideal candidate is an experienced live-event producer and people leader who combines strong creative judgment with operational discipline, collaborative instincts, and a deep understanding of how live experiences can build fan affinity, create homecourt advantage, and support business objectives.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Lead the end-to-end production of game-night shows for the Brooklyn Nets, New York Liberty, and Long Island Nets.

• Translate each night’s strategy, objectives, audience priorities, and business goals into a cohesive live experience.

• Work with Marketing to establish the creative and production vision for pregame, in-game, halftime, timeout, quarter-break, postgame, and special-event programming.

• Oversee all show elements, including entertainment, music, lighting, pyrotechnics, fan interaction, promotions, contests, sponsored features, video content, live performers, and special presentations.

• Lead production meetings, rehearsals, game-night briefings, show calls, checklists, and live execution while maintaining high standards for quality, timing, safety, brand alignment, and operational readiness.

• Prepare for contingencies, including overtime, delays, injuries, technical issues, and postgame scenarios, and serve as a senior decision-maker and escalation point during live events.

• Lead the development and maintenance of game-night runs of show, scripts, cue sheets, show flows, templates, production standards, technical requirements, and operating procedures.

• Partner with Creative and Content to develop and integrate in-bowl entertainment content that advances the show strategy and brand narrative.

• Lead, develop, and manage the Game Presentation production team, including show callers, stage managers, game-night coordinators, and the performance side of Entertainment Teams.

• Oversee the integration of dance teams, hype teams, hosts, DJs, emcees, mascots, performers, and other entertainment talent into game-night programming, including scheduling, rehearsals, performance quality, and development.

• Manage budgets, resources, schedules, and competing priorities across multiple properties, and contribute to or lead production for select external events and large-scale fan experiences, including Nets Fest and Brooklyn Dribble.

• Lead post-game and after-action reviews, using fan feedback, audience engagement, executional quality, and other available insights to identify improvements and convert observations into action plans for future games.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• 7–10+ years of experience producing live entertainment, sports, television, concerts, theater, or large-scale events; live basketball production experience is a plus.

• At least five years of management or supervisory experience in live-event production, including budget management.

• Demonstrated experience leading live shows from concept and scripting through rehearsal and real-time execution.

• Proven ability to develop runs of show, scripts, cue sheets, show flows, production plans, and contingency plans.

• Strong understanding of in-venue production technology, including video boards, LED systems, lighting, audio, replay, and show-control systems.

• Excellent communication, writing, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, deadlines, and events simultaneously.

• Ability to remain calm, decisive, and solutions-oriented in high-pressure live environments.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, entertainment management, sports management, theater, television production, or a related field preferred.

• Willingness to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extensive event-day hours across all sports properties.

WHO YOU ARE

• An experienced live-event producer who combines strong creative judgment with operational discipline.

• A collaborative leader who builds trust across Marketing, Basketball Operations, Partnerships, Venue Operations, Creative, Content, Social, Fan Engagement, and external partners.

• A clear and confident communicator who can make timely decisions, solve problems in real time, and remain calm in high-pressure environments.

• A people leader who develops talent, sets clear expectations, and fosters a culture of preparation, accountability, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Focused on the customer and fan experience, with a commitment to creating bold, authentic, and unforgettable experiences the Brooklyn Way.

• Focused on continuous improvement and comfortable using fan insights, surveys, social listening, attendance data, and other available information to strengthen future shows.

• A thoughtful steward of company resources and the brand who takes ownership of outcomes.

• Committed to Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment’s values of Integrity, Care, Growth Mindset, and Accountability.

COMPENSATION

$150,000 - $200,000 base salary

Full-time employees are eligible for a robust slate of total rewards, including:

• Bonus eligibility

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage; HSA and FSA eligibility

• 401k Employer Match at 4%

• Competitive PTO policy & Company Holidays

• Parental leave policy eligible after 6 months of service

• Access to events at Barclays Center, subject to ticket availability

• Free lunch onsite Monday - Thursday; onsite barista bar

• And more!

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Works primarily in an office environment in Industry City, Brooklyn. You may be expected to attend games and other events on evenings, weekends, holidays, and extensive event-day hours.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of the Company not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion/creed, gender, gender identity, transgender status, pregnancy and lactation accommodations, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage, immigration, or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, genetic information, height and weight, arrest or conviction record, caregiver status, credit history, unemployment status, sexual and reproductive health decisions, salary history, status as a victim of domestic violence, stalking, and sex offenses, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Coordinator (part-time/contract role)
jobs.description:
Employment Type: Temporary, Part-Time
Dates: November 2026–May 2027
Location: Remote; Washington, DC, preferred
Hourly Rate: $30/hour

ABOUT THE ROLE

BBYO is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Marketing & Communications Coordinator (part-time) to support the Marketing & Communications team in the months leading up to (and potentially during) BBYO International Convention (IC) 2027, as well as with general marketing support through the spring.

The successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, has an exceptional eye for detail, and brings strong organizational and project-management skills. They can juggle many moving pieces at once and understand how a single update may ripple across multiple projects, people, and communications channels. Candidates should be comfortable learning new technology systems, such as Airtable and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. A background in marketing, communications, media relations, journalism, or a related field is preferred.

ABOUT BBYO INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION (IC)

Every year over U.S. Presidents’ Day weekend in February, BBYO unites more than 5,000 teen leaders, alumni, educators, influencers, professionals, and philanthropists from around the world for BBYO International Convention, one of the largest Jewish communal events of the year.  This year, IC will take place in Baltimore, Maryland, from February 11–15, 2027.

PHASE 1: IC SUPPORT

The Marketing & Communications Coordinator will provide essential support for all marketing related activities leading up to and at IC. They will begin by shadowing members of BBYO’s marketing team during the fall and gradually take on more responsibility as IC approaches, culminating in potential onsite marketing support in Baltimore during IC, if availability permits.

PHASE 2: GENERAL MARKETING SUPPORT

Following IC, the Marketing & Communications Coordinator will continue supporting BBYO's Marketing & Communications team through May 2027. In this phase, the Coordinator will help execute marketing campaigns, coordinate communications projects, support regional events and conventions, and assist with preparations for BBYO's summer recruitment and program launches. The role will serve as a central point of coordination across multiple stakeholders, helping ensure projects stay organized, deadlines are met, and communications are delivered accurately and on schedule.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

IC Preparation (Pre-IC)

• Shadow members of the Marketing & Communications team and learn IC communications, media, content, teen press corps, and event workflows.

• Support the coordination and tracking of multiple IC marketing and communications projects.

• Maintain project trackers, timelines, assignments, and updates, including in Airtable.

• Monitor changes to schedules, plans, content, and logistics and help identify their impact across channels and teams.

• Follow up with staff, teens, volunteers, vendors, and other partners to gather information and keep projects moving.

• Assist with preparing and organizing communications materials, content, media lists, schedules, and other IC resources.

• Support additional marketing and communications projects as needed.

Onsite at IC (Potential, but not required)
During IC in Baltimore, responsibilities may include:

• Supporting IC livestream broadcast and video studio activities.

• Coordinating with the photo and video teams and keeping track of content needs and schedules.

• Publishing or supporting the publication of blogs, photos, and other digital content.

• Jumping in wherever needed to support the Marketing & Communications team during the fast-paced IC environment.

General Marketing Support (Post-IC)

• Support the execution of BBYO marketing campaigns across email, web, social media, and digital advertising channels.

• Maintain project-management systems, campaign trackers, content calendars, and documentation.

• Assist some BBYO regions in preparing communications and marketing materials for spring conventions, programs, and events.

• Support summer recruitment marketing efforts, including preparing campaign assets, communications, registration materials, and promotional content.

• Assist with preparations for summer program launches, helping coordinate timelines, content updates, marketing materials, and registration communications.

• Assist with website updates, content publishing, and other digital marketing needs as assigned.

• Support reporting, data organization, and campaign tracking.

SCHEDULE

• November: Up to 10 hours/week

• December: Up to 15 hours/week

• January: Up to 19 hours/week

• February: Up to 19 hours/week including (potentially) supporting IC onsite in Baltimore (February 9–14)

• March: Up to 19 hours/week

• April: Up to 19 hours/week

• May: Up to 10 hours/week

Some flexibility in scheduling will be needed as IC approaches and during the event.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Some work or internship experience in marketing, communications, public relations, media relations, journalism, events, or a related field.

• Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong follow-through and ability to track details from initial request through completion.

• Ability to anticipate how changes to one project, schedule, or piece of information may affect other people, projects, and communications channels.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working collaboratively with a team and communicating with a wide range of people.

• Ability to work independently, take direction, ask questions, and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift quickly.

Preferred

• Familiarity with Airtable or similar project-management/database tools.

• Experience working on events, live programs, or large-scale projects.

• Experience working with photo, video, livestream, or other digital content production.

• Experience working with teens or in a youth-serving organization is a plus.

• Familiarity with BBYO or the Jewish community is a plus.

• Willingness and ability to work onsite in Baltimore during IC.

jobs.title: Lead AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our team is at the core of Avride's self-driving stack. We build the base infrastructure layer that powers all autopilot code. It includes a C++ framework for implementing autonomy components, execution graph building and optimization systems, as well as runtimes that execute those graphs, both onboard and in simulation.

The vast part of the execution graph is implemented as a chain of neural network operations. The onboard mode relies on stable latencies of the inference of those networks, while in simulation we also optimize throughput at scale.

About the role

We’re looking for a software engineer with a leadership mindset and deep ML infrastructure experience. You will decide and influence the ML infrastructure layer across the company. The biggest challenge we’re facing at the moment is the effectiveness of GPU inference - both for onboard applications with near real-time guarantees and for offboard cases that target high throughput and deterministic execution. It is the first priority within this role.

What you'll do

• At first, you will take on the GPU inference framework, focusing on performance

• Later, the role assumes responsibility and ownership for broader ML infrastructure scattered across ML pipelines

• Close collaboration with the applied ML team responsible for defining the neural model's architecture

What you'll need

• Experience with PyTorch

• Understanding of how GPUs work

• Experience in diagnosing and resolving performance issues

• Strong record of building infrastructure including distributed systems

• 5+ years of experience with C++

• Programming experience in multi-threaded environments - multiple processes, threads, timers, and interrupts

#LI-MS1

jobs.title: Medical Recruiter

MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Our clinical teams are at the heart of the Neko experience. They deliver the care that helps our members start their preventative health journey, so every hire directly shapes the quality of that care. jobs.title: Law Clerk (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
We exist for workers and their employers -- who are the backbone of our economy.  That is where Centivo comes in -- our mission is to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills.

Summary of role:

We are looking for a Law Clerk to support our legal team while we recruit for an Associate General Counsel. Our Law Clerk hire will work within the legal team to assist with researching and concisely summarizing evolving areas of the regulatory framework for self-funded third-party medical benefits administration. This is an excellent opportunity for 3L law student to gain hands-on experience working with a small in-house legal team (one a UB Law grad). You will be part of the legal team and have a chance to work within a contract management system and workflow improvements, engage with outside counsel if additional expertise is needed and work cross-functionally with the business. You will gain exposure to the Buffalo start up community and the chance to work with an experienced team of benefits and health tech leaders. The role is open immediately and is expected to be needed until the full time role is hired and onboarded, although there is the potential to continue for the Spring semester as well.

Responsibilities Include:

 - Researching areas of health plan and third-party administrator compliance issues, with a significant focus in ERISA, Affordable Care Act, Consolidated Appropriations Act, MHPAEA and other federal laws and regulations

 - Crafting clear, concise white papers and guidance documents – both for the legal department, as well as business audiences

 - Prioritizing work relative to risk, importance and leveraging time management skills to complete tasks on a timely basis

 - Interacting with cross-functional business departments to assist with project management of the operational implications of gaining compliance in evolving areas of the regulatory environment

 - Developing a compliance library on key topics

 - Assisting with reviewing, redlining commercial contracts at a national organization experiencing rapid growth

 - Documenting and improving processes, including how to use system integrations and AI to build efficiencies.

Qualifications:

Required Skills and Abilities: 

 - Ability to prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to speak clearly and concisely, conveying complex or technical information in a manner that others can understand, as well as ability to understand and interpret complex information

 - Strong interpersonal skills, establishing rapport and working well with others

 - Advanced Microsoft Suite skills

Education and Experience:

 - 3rd yr law student

 - Interest in health care, health benefits, start-ups required, with a preference for some related experience and a substantial interest in gaining in-house experience

 - Strong, clear research and writing skills.

Work Location:

 - An ideal candidate would be a University at Buffalo Law student who would work from the Buffalo Office with flexibility for some work from home,

 - While we believe that working in the Buffalo office would provide a better learning experience, we may consider remote candidates with a connection to Buffalo.



Skills & Behaviors:

 - Communication - Strong, proven verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to convey complex or technical information in a manner that non-lawyers can understand and understand business objectives and translate into legal and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Thinking – Knack for sorting through clutter to find the best route, often by pulling up from the current complexity to identify patterns that guide future direction and allow one to narrow the options and articulate the options from which others can work backward.

 - Business Acumen – A keenness and quickness in understanding and dealing with a business situation (risks and opportunities) in a manner that is likely to lead to a good outcome. Critical to this is an ability to think beyond their own function.

 - Systems/Analytical Thinking – Demonstrates the ability to think fluidly and integrate information. Able to anticipate non-linear and non-obvious relationships. Often includes an ability to think holistically/conceptually – very powerful when accompanied by ability to communicate & clarify tactically.

 - Flexibility/Working through Ambiguity – Tendency to be energized by new experiences/perspectives that test assumptions and thinking. Considers different points of view, sometimes with fragmented information, to arrive at practical, effective, actionable next steps.

Centivo Values:

 - Resilient – This is wicked hard. There is no easy button for healthcare affordability. Luckily, the mission makes it worth it and sustains us when things are tough. Being resilient ensures we don’t give up.

 - Uncommon - The status quo stinks so we had to go out and build something better. We know the healthcare system. It isn't working for members, employers, and providers. So we're building it from scratch, from the ground up. Our focus is on making things better for them while also improving clinical results - which is bold and uncommon.

 - Positive – We care about each other. It takes energy to do hard stuff, build something better and to be resilient and unconventional while doing it. Because of that, we make sure we give kudos freely and feedback with care. When our tank gets low, a team member is there to be a source of new energy. We celebrate together. We are supportive, generous, humble, and positive.

Who we are:

Centivo is an innovative health plan for self-funded employers on a mission to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills. Anchored around a primary care based ACO model, Centivo saves employers 15 to 30 percent compared to traditional insurance carriers. Employees also realize significant savings through our free primary care (including virtual), predictable copay and no-deductible benefit plan design. Centivo works with employers ranging in size from 51 employees to Fortune 500 companies. For more information, visit centivo.com http://centivo.com.

Headquartered in Buffalo, NY with offices in New York City and Buffalo, Centivo is backed by leading healthcare and technology investors, including a recent round of investment from Morgan Health, a business unit of JPMorgan Chase & Co.

jobs.title: Manager, External Affairs
jobs.description:
THE ORGANIZATION

The Charter School Growth Fund (CSGF) is a leading nonprofit venture philanthropy fund dedicated to identifying the nation’s best public charter schools, investing in their expansion, and helping to increase their impact. Our “portfolio” includes 200+ charter school networks that operate 1,700+ schools and serve more than 800,000 students. We are committed to expanding the impact of schools that are closing achievement and opportunity gaps. CSGF operates with the same strategies, discipline, and focus as a venture capital firm by awarding multi-year grants and loans to talented education entrepreneurs building networks of high-quality charter schools that enroll traditionally underserved students. Our goal is to serve 1,000,000 students by 2030 and 1.4 million by 2035.

This is an exciting time to join the Charter School Growth Fund. We are launching Fund V, our most ambitious fund yet, building on our 20-year track record of success. Fund V will add 250,000 new high-quality seats while helping our portfolio become durable, bedrock institutions in their communities for decades to come. We invest in the strongest charter leaders and networks in the country, and we partner closely with them to sustain excellent outcomes as they grow. Our portfolio continues to serve student populations of roughly 90% students of color and 75% students from low-income backgrounds, and we remain committed to being proximate to the lived experiences of the students and communities we serve.

THE OPPORTUNITY

CSGF is seeking a full-time Manager, External Affairs to serve on the External Relations team. This role reports to the Managing Director of Policy, Communications, and Advocacy (PCA), with a dotted-line relationship to the Managing Director of Investor Relations (IR).

The Manager, External Affairs plans, owns, and drives high-quality execution across CSGF’s most visible external communications and investor-facing content — including the Annual Investor Report, issue briefs, social media strategy, and executive communications. This is an individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of content, creative strategy, and project management. The ideal candidate designs and executes CSGF’s social media presence independently, owns complex multi-stakeholder workstreams end-to-end, and brings strong judgment and initiative to solve problems as they arise. They are a skilled written communicator who produces compelling, high-quality work with minimal oversight and takes pride in delivering results that advance CSGF’s mission and strengthen its relationships with investors, portfolio members, and the broader charter sector.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Investor & Executive Communications

• Own the development of CSGF’s Annual Investor Report — managing the full project plan, identifying key themes, drafting narrative content, and setting the vision for data visualizations; coordinates with internal stakeholders and external contractors to deliver a compelling, high-quality report on time.

• Develop and produce investor-facing content, board materials, and executive communications in close partnership with senior leadership, including ghostwriting support for key organizational communications.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to maintain a consistent editorial voice and narrative across all external-facing and investor-facing materials.

Social Media Strategy & Execution

• Design and execute CSGF’s social media strategy across all platforms (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram,etc.) — developing and publishing timely content, amplifying portfolio member contributions, and engaging in real-time with relevant sector conversations.

• Track, analyze, and report on social media performance metrics; use data-informed insights to continuously improve content strategy, platform approach, and significantly increase audience engagement, including supporting Seed applicant pipeline and podcast outreach goals.

Content Development & Knowledge Management

• Drive the identification, development, and maintenance of issue briefs that provide timely, succinct updates on topics of greatest interest to CSGF’s external stakeholders.

• Own and continuously improve team systems and knowledge management processes that enable the External Relations team to operate efficiently and deliver high-quality work.

Media Monitoring & Design

• Monitor media coverage of CSGF and portfolio members and produce two annual reports analyzing media trends and coverage quality to inform CSGF’s communications strategy.

• Execute graphics design, microsite development, short-form video editing, and list management in support of external communications deliverables.

Portfolio Member Support

• Coordinate with external contractors and internal CSGF teams to connect portfolio members with fundraising resources and skill-building opportunities that advance their organizational capacity.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Skills and Characteristics

• Deep commitment to CSGF’s mission and passion for K-12 education; excitement about expanding access to excellent public charter schools for underserved students.

• Exemplary written communication skills: synthesizes complex information into clear, compelling narratives; demonstrates consistently high-quality, accurate work across diverse content types including reports, investor briefs, and executive communications.

• Strong ownership and project management: plans, designs, and independently executes multiple high-stakes, time-sensitive workstreams; proactively identifies dependencies and risks, develops process-level solutions, and manages well upward to ensure team meets ambitious outcomes.

• High attention to quality and detail: sets a high bar for accuracy in written work and data analysis; navigates ambiguity and incorporates feedback from multiple stakeholders without compromising quality or timelines.

• Demonstrated expertise across social media platforms (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram) and design tools (Canva, Adobe Express); proficiency with Boolean search codes and media monitoring tools.

• Motivated to build relationships and influence teammates and senior leadership to take action; proactively communicates project status, risks, and recommendations across cross-functional teams.

• Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

Educational Background and Work Experience

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• 3–7 years of relevant experience in communications, content strategy, journalism, or a related field; experience in education, nonprofit, or social sector strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience owning high-visibility content deliverables — such as annual reports, investor communications, or editorial publications — with evidence of strong stakeholder satisfaction and on-time delivery.

• Proven ability to design and execute social media strategy, with measurable impact on audience growth and engagement.

• Experience with AI tools (i.e. ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in building reports, conducting research, analyzing data, creating dashboards, etc. to maximize efficiency while ensuring high-quality, accurate information

COMPENSATION

Compensation is commensurate with experience and education. The target salary range for this role is $75,000-$85,000 annually. CSGF offers a very competitive package of benefits, including: health, life, disability, and dental insurance coverage; vacation/holidays and parental leave; and participation in CSGF’s 403(b) plan. Candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the US.

START DATE

CSGF is seeking candidates who can start as soon as possible; flexible for the ideal candidate.

WORKING AT CSGF

We are focused on hiring and developing great people and believe that building diverse perspectives  across our team makes us more effective in expanding our impact. (This is reflected in Our Commitment Statement.) Our core values are:

Why you'll love working here:

• Join a team driven by purpose, collaboration, and a commitment to identifying and responding to the needs of the public charter schools that we support

• Access to professional development and learning opportunities

Our core values are:

Results

• We believe that student success is the ultimate measure of our performance.

• We work with urgency and intentionality for the portfolio and their schools.

• We hold ourselves accountable to strong outcomes.

• We relentlessly prioritize our resources to drive positive, measurable, attributable impact for the charter leaders, their schools, and ultimately students.

• We believe strong results come from good decisions, and the best decisions are made when we use data - both quantitative and qualitative - and gather input from diverse perspectives, especially those most impacted by the work.

• We celebrate our wins and learn from our losses.

Teamwork

• We value organization over team, and we value team over individual.

• We actively break down silos and collaborate across teams.

• We believe building strong, healthy relationships is critical to move our work forward.

• We seek to proactively communicate across teams to strengthen our outcomes and add value for the portfolio.

Integrity

• We believe that trust is our most important asset, and we must earn and maintain the trust of the portfolio member leaders, investors, and our team to achieve our goals.

• We are often entrusted with sensitive and confidential information about the portfolio - we do not ever violate these confidences.

• We show ownership for our successes and our failures.

• We speak directly to the person, even when it's messy and hard, and get ahead of potential problems.

• We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

Respect

• We understand and acknowledge our place in the value chain – the students, teachers, principals, and other leaders at portfolio networks are doing the hardest, direct, and most impactful work in their schools each day.

• We prioritize humility and embrace getting better every day.

• We are curious and open-minded.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Department Description

Palmetto Home is a branch of Palmetto focused on the democratization of the renewable energy and HVAC industries. We provide homeowners with financial products to benefit from solar power, energy storage systems, and home efficiency through advanced heating and cooling technologies. We empower solar and HVAC sales professionals and installation companies with access to our proprietary platform, financing, customer management system, and milestone quality control system. Our #1 focus is a phenomenal experience for our customers and partners, evidenced in our growing financial product adoption.

Location

This position will be based in New York City.

Reporting

This position will report to the Manager, Strategy New Opportunities & Analytics

Summary of Role

The Associate, Strategy, New Opportunities & Analytics is a versatile, many-hats role at the center of Palmetto Capital's corporate strategy and structured finance team. The primary focus is sourcing and structuring new capital opportunities — building financial models from scratch for structures that have never been done in the market, then rigorously stress-testing them through scenario and sensitivity analysis. Precision is paramount: this person is expected to run the numbers exhaustively and check their own work, and others', with a sharp eye for detail, while also contributing to the broader strategic analysis that shapes Palmetto's capital position and growth.

Strategic & Tactical

New Capital Opportunities (~50%)

• Build financial models from scratch for capital structures and financing products that have never been executed in the market

• Run scenario and sensitivity analyses to pressure-test new structures and identify the optimal capital mix

• Review and refine models built by senior team members, ensuring accuracy and rigor before they go external

• Evaluate new business opportunities through structuring and financial analysis of prospective initiatives

• Meet with prospective investors to explore new capital opportunities and financing facilities

Financial Modeling & Structured Finance Execution (~25%)

• Develop and own complex project finance models (Excel) supporting tax equity, debt, ABS, and other structured capital vehicles

• Support execution of debt, tax equity, and structured finance transactions, working directly with banks, investors, and legal counsel

• Conduct pricing analysis on financing structures and capital products to support competitive terms

• Maintain deal-tracking and transaction models across live and prospective financings

• Support due diligence, term sheet review, and closing processes for capital markets transactions

• Own recurring financial reporting for key Palmetto Finance stakeholders, partnering with technology teams to automate where possible

• Build and maintain relationships with banks, tax equity investors, and other external capital partners

Strategy & Analytics (~25%)

• Analyze market, competitor, and macroeconomic trends to inform financing and capital structure decisions

• Contribute to board-level and executive materials that connect capital structuring work to Palmetto's broader growth strategy

• Assess the company's future capital position and financing needs, incorporating relevant legislative and regulatory considerations

• Drive pricing initiatives across financing structures and capital products

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement (Ongoing)

• Partner closely with FP&A, Treasury, and Accounting

• Identify and implement improvements to capital markets and modeling processes

• Stay attuned to the needs of capital partners and internal stakeholders, anticipating requirements and proposing tailored solutions

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field; MBA/CFA a plus

• 2-4+ years of experience in project finance, structured finance, investment banking, or capital markets; heavy, hands-on project finance and modeling experience required

• Advanced Excel modeling skills, with a track record of building and maintaining complex project finance models (e.g., tax equity, structured debt, ABS, LBO)

• Demonstrated experience running scenario and sensitivity analysis on new or novel financing structures

• Exposure to debt, equity, tax equity, or ABS transaction structuring preferred; solar or renewables experience a plus

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with close attention to detail in financial modeling

• Ability to manage multiple transactions and workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly to senior stakeholders

• Highly motivated, collaborative, and comfortable operating with some ambiguity

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.
