Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As a Product Manager on the AI & Data Foundations team, you will build the shared platforms that power Plaid’s AI and data capabilities. This is early-stage, hands-on work: you’ll partner with data, ML, and platform engineers to take capabilities from 0→1 and scale them into infrastructure that is accessible, reliable, and easy to use across Plaid. Your scope will span our AI platform (e.g., LLM gateway, eval infrastructure), our data platform (e.g., Databricks,  AI-powered data tooling), and the systems connecting the two.


This role is for an experienced platform PM who is excited about the rapidly evolving intersection of data infrastructure and AI. You are technically fluent, strategic, and execution-oriented, and know how to turn emerging capabilities into reliable platforms, primitives, and tools that other teams can build on.

 

Responsibilities

 - AI & Data Foundations Strategy: Define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for the shared platforms that power data and AI development across Plaid.

 - Platform Development: Partner with data, ML, and platform engineers to design and ship foundational capabilities spanning AI infrastructure, developer tooling, data platforms, pipelines, quality, and governance.

 - Internal Developer Experience & Adoption: Build platforms that Plaid teams choose to use. Develop a deep understanding of internal users, remove friction from common workflows, and measure success through adoption, developer velocity, reliability, and quality.

 - Platform Evolution: Balance immediate needs from product teams with longer-term platform investments, identifying where Plaid should standardize, build shared primitives, enable experimentation, and/or leverage an existing external solution.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with product, engineering, data, research, and security to identify shared needs and embed foundational AI and data capabilities across Plaid.

 - Communication & Alignment: Translate complex technical decisions and platform trade-offs into clear narratives that enable decisions across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Qualifications

 - 8+ years of product management experience including direct experience building AI/ML platform systems, applied intelligence products, or other data infrastructure from concept to production

 - Deep technical fluency in modern data and AI/ML systems, including how data is stored and processed and how models are developed, evaluated, deployed, and monitored. You can engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on architecture and technical trade-offs without needing to be the engineer in the room.

 - Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments, turning loosely defined problems into decisions, shipped capabilities, and measurable adoption or impact.

 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Platform mindset and experience building scalable developer or data platforms through well-designed primitives, APIs, and frameworks.

 - Strategic and executional range. Skilled at setting the long-term vision while also delivering near-term experiments, specs, prototypes, and launches.

 - Strong communicator and cross-functional leader who can translate complex technical concepts into clear narratives to drive decisions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Commitment to responsible AI and transparency, especially in regulated or high-trust domains.

 - [Nice to Have] Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, or agentic systems in production.

 - [Nice to Have] Experience building AI developer tooling in production.

 - [Nice to Have] Familiarity with applied AI in regulated or high-trust domains such as fintech, identity, or risk.

 

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. jobs.title: Sr. Production Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Production Engineer to direct operations and set technical strategy at our water chemical treatment facility across Production and Logistics. This role requires a strategic engineering leader who will drive process excellence, establish safety standards, and lead organizational continuous improvement initiatives while providing high-level oversight of production operations and supply chain logistics.

Key Characteristics:

• Strategic Analysis and Organizational Problem-Solving - The role requires driving root cause analysis programs, setting the strategy for investigating quality and equipment non-conformances, and leading supply chain optimization at a regional level. The lead engineer must architect systematic solutions, synthesize complex OEE metrics into business strategies, and establish robust countermeasures for the organization.
• Influential Communication and Mentorship - The position involves championing initiatives across site, regional, and global functions, designing training curricula for operations teams, and managing strategic vendor partnerships. The lead engineer must mentor junior staff, influence cross-functional leadership, and facilitate high-level knowledge transfer across the production and logistics interface.
• Strategic Governance and Program Management - The role requires overseeing complex operational portfolios across Production and Logistics, approving bulk storage strategies for 36+ tanks, and setting the roadmap for CAPEX/OPEX project portfolios. The lead engineer must govern timelines, drive organizational compliance, and ensure strategic alignment across all operational areas simultaneously.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Support all Environmental, Health, and Safety programs, policies, and regulations

• Directs and governs the Management of Change (MOC) and Process Safety Management (PSM) programs, setting the standard for operational excellence and driving facility-wide improvement strategies.
• Oversees and validates advanced process engineering designs, ensuring technical rigor in complex heat and mass transfer analyses, material balancing, and equipment performance evaluations while mentoring staff engineers.
• Drives root cause investigation strategy for critical operational failures, leading cross-functional teams to implement systemic, long-term solutions that mitigate organizational risk.
• Shapes and champions engineering best practices by leveraging regional and global networks, driving the adoption of innovative technologies and processes that improve competitive advantage.
• Exhibits executive-level autonomy, managing high-impact engineering portfolios and making critical technical decisions that affect site performance and long-term viability.
• Applies visionary critical thinking to resolve unprecedented technical challenges, providing the organization with data-driven strategic direction and innovative solutions.
• Serves as the lead architect for key engineering initiatives, defining project vision, securing resources, and delivering strategic outcomes in collaboration with global Engineering leadership.

Production Focus Areas:

• Manage bulk storage, production equipment, auxiliary systems, and utilities
• Track and analyze Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) data to identify quality concerns, yield losses, and equipment non-conformances
• Monitor daily production and quality rates to ensure optimal performance
• Identify, scope, and execute CAPEX and OPEX improvement projects
• Provide training and classroom instruction to operations teams
• Support production scheduling and maintain critical documentation

Logistics Focus Areas:

• Balance daily administrative duties (25-40% of time) with field support activities
• Coordinate raw material scheduling and ensure adequate storage space availability
• Manage packaging schedules and prepare required documentation
• Oversee shipment scheduling and documentation preparation
• Conduct vendor management and maintain chemical organization per segregation/lean standards
• Perform supply chain analysis for optimization opportunities
• Manage over 36 bulk storage tanks and develop equipment handling procedures
• Conduct inventory accuracy assessments and ensure risk management compliance

This dual-role position offers the opportunity to gain comprehensive understanding of both production operations and logistics management while driving process improvements and maintaining the highest safety and quality standards in water chemical treatment operations.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Process Engineering and Equipment Analysis - Proficiency in heat and material transfer calculations, mass balancing, equipment performance assessments, and process optimization. This includes understanding of chemical treatment processes, equipment design principles, and the ability to analyze and improve process efficiencies for both quality and productivity outcomes.
• Data Analysis and Performance Metrics Management - Expertise in tracking, analyzing, and interpreting Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) data, production rates, quality metrics, and yield loss analysis. This includes statistical analysis capabilities, trend identification, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvement strategies.
• Process Safety Management (PSM) and Regulatory Compliance - Knowledge of Management of Change (MOC) procedures, Environmental Health and Safety regulations, risk management protocols, and chemical handling/segregation standards. This includes understanding of bulk storage tank management, chemical compatibility requirements, and maintaining compliance documentation for water treatment facility operations.

• Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or related engineering discipline
• Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred but not required
• Relevant certifications in Process Safety Management (PSM), Hazardous Materials Management, or Water Treatment Operations are advantageous

Experience Requirements:

• Minimum 8-10+ years of experience in chemical processing, water treatment, or related industrial manufacturing environment with a focus on technical leadership
• Experience with process engineering principles including heat/material transfer, mass balance calculations, and equipment performance optimization
• Demonstrated experience with data analysis, OEE tracking, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma preferred)
• Experience in project management for CAPEX/OPEX initiatives
• Background in supply chain management, logistics coordination, or inventory management preferred
• Experience with regulatory compliance (EPA, OSHA, DOT) and safety management systems
• Hands-on experience with bulk storage systems, chemical handling, and production equipment operations
• Experience in training and mentoring operations personnel
• Knowledge of Management of Change (MOC) processes and Process Safety Management (PSM) principles preferred
• Proficient in SAP, ERP, or comparable systems for production and logistics management.
• Hands on experience with Siemens automation and control systems.
• Proven ability to champion safety initiatives and foster continuous improvement in workplace safety culture.
• Direct operational experience with connection assembly/disassembly, line clearing procedure, pump operations, manifold system management
• Field experience in safe chemical handling and transfer protocols.
• Advance computer skills including Google sheets, MS excel, and Tableau

jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Money Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.

As a Specialist Solutions Architect for Money Management, you will lead in-depth product discussions with Stripe's top users and prospects and execute against our go-to-market strategy for Stripe Capital, Issuing, Financial Accounts, and our global Payouts suite. You will help users understand how these products combine to create a compounding embedded finance platform—enabling them to build card programs, hold and move funds globally, and offer financing options that increase user stickiness and unlock new revenue streams.

Responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Money Management products—Capital, Issuing, Financial Accounts, and global Payouts—to accelerate opportunities

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of embedded finance applications and articulate how Stripe's Money Management products combine to create a platform for building financial services

• Consult with users on a broad range of embedded finance use cases: charge card programs, global payouts, revenue-based financing, loans, and lines of credit

• Understand the compliance requirements of solutions built with Stripe products, including KYC/KYB, BSA/AML, card network rules, and how they apply across geographies and use cases

• Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback

• Partner closely with the Money Management product sales team on Stripe's largest opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally, providing actionable insights to product stakeholders to influence the Money Management product roadmap and feature prioritization

• Provide critical insights on emerging opportunities—including stablecoin-based money movement and global financial access—to influence the product roadmap

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

• 7+ years of technical sales experience, ideally within a fintech company

• 3+ years of product experience with embedded finance solutions—card issuing, treasury management, lending, or global payouts

• Experience with integrating RESTful APIs into web applications

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A passion for learning and researching current and emerging products to develop innovative solutions

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks governing embedded finance: KYC/KYB, BSA/AML, card network rules, and money transmission licensing

• Experience enabling and scaling a GTM team

• Experience in systems design, with a background building and deploying complex financial applications

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Opportunity

The Global Demand Center is building a signal-led demand engine — one that uses account, audience, behavioral, intent, and market signals to identify where we should focus and how we should activate. The GrowthX team, within the Global Demand Center, is taking the lead on this initiative and looking for a new Demand Signals Specialist.

The Demand Signals Specialist will help turn signal-led strategy into accurate, actionable audiences that can be used across campaigns, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation channels.

This role is focused on audience build, enrichment, segmentation, QA, and activation readiness. They will work across teams to understand unique intent and fit signals to create impactful audiences for GrowthX programs. The ideal candidate is early in their career but technically curious, detail-oriented, comfortable working across modern GTM platforms, and excited to help build the audience foundation for a more dynamic demand model.

What You’ll Do

Build account and contact audiences

Build account, contact, and buying-group audiences based on direction from GrowthX strategy leads, campaign teams, field marketing, and journey teams.

Use tools such as Clay and Common Room to support audience creation, enrichment, segmentation, contact discovery, buying-group identification, and account research.

Apply required filters, exclusions, segmentation logic, region/segment views, product focus, persona criteria, suppression rules, and activation requirements.

Support both planned campaign audiences and signal-triggered growth motions.

Prepare audiences for activation

Package audience outputs for use by campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, digital activation, and xDR teams.

Communicate audience size, coverage, regional breakdowns, segment views, exclusions, data gaps, intent, and activation readiness.

Help ensure audiences are structured in a way that can be used downstream in systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, and other campaign or activation platforms.

Own audience QA and data quality checks

Review audience builds for accuracy, duplication, completeness, field quality, enrichment quality, persona/title fit, suppression logic, region/segment accuracy, and alignment to stated criteria.

Flag issues, gaps, or unexpected findings to GrowthX strategy leads and stakeholders.

Recommend adjustments when audience size, coverage, quality, or data availability may limit activation.

Document audience logic and QA findings so teams understand what was included, excluded, and why.

Partner cross-functionally

Work closely with GrowthX leaders, campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation teams to support audience needs.

Clarify build requirements, timelines, audience logic, data sources, and handoff expectations.

Support a more consistent audience operating model across Okta or Auth0 platform priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

1–3+ years of experience in marketing operations, growth operations, campaign operations, audience operations, demand generation, sales operations, data operations, or a related field.

Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, lists, filters, segmentation logic, and QA processes.

Experience or strong familiarity with B2B marketing and sales systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Clay, Common Room, or comparable GTM platforms.

Comfort working with account and contact data, including enrichment, deduplication, segmentation, exclusions, and audience handoffs.

Ability to communicate audience size, coverage, data gaps, and QA findings clearly to stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple audience requests, timelines, and handoffs.

Curiosity about AI, signal-led demand generation, data enrichment, and modern GTM technology.

Ability to work cross-functionally with campaign, field, journey, marketing automation, and growth teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or supporting B2B account/contact audiences.

Experience with Clay, Common Room, Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, or similar platforms.

Basic understanding of B2B buyer personas, buying groups, account segmentation, lifecycle stages, and campaign activation needs.

Experience using formulas, logic, filters, or workflow tools to organize and manipulate data.

Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, developer platforms, or enterprise technology.

As it expands its existing portfolio, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment now includes BK Mag, Brooklyn Wine Club, and a hospitality business developing several location-based entertainment properties.

Whether on the court, on stage, or in the workplace, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment is driven by a pursuit of excellence—constantly evolving, innovating, and pushing boundaries to elevate its business and expand its fan base. The company is deeply committed to fostering a culture of belonging and inclusion, both internally and across its communities, ensuring that every interaction reflects its values of growth mindset, integrity, accountability and care.

We are guided by our core values:

• Integrity: Be intellectually honest at all times. Demonstrate the highest professional and ethical standards.

• Care: Care for everything and everyone around us. Practice empathy, respect, and inclusion to promote an environment of excellence and success.

• Growth Mindset: Develop ourselves and those around us. Experiment, learn, and improve from everything we do.

• Accountability: Deliver on our word, take responsibility for our actions, and work in the interest of our team.

SUMMARY

Brooklyn Basketball brings the Brooklyn Nets and New York Liberty together to establish a community-first basketball experience. Our goal is to grow the game for participants of all ages through professionally led clinics and camps, community-focused events, instructional content, unique basketball experiences, and much more. Brooklyn Basketball is seeking a highly motivated, organized, and results-oriented Manager, Sales & Service to lead sales efforts across Brooklyn Basketball programs, trainings, rentals, birthday experiences, and other revenue-generating opportunities.

The Manager, Sales & Service – Brooklyn Basketball will report to the Director of Business Operations, Brooklyn Basketball, and serve as both an individual seller and people manager. The incumbent will be responsible for driving individual and team sales performance, managing the sales pipeline, and developing strategies that increase enrollment, revenue, and retention.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Lead the sale of Brooklyn Basketball programs, including After-School Club, camps, clinics, trainings, rentals, birthday experiences, group opportunities, and other revenue-generating offerings.

• Personally cultivate relationships with high-value prospects and partners through calls, emails, events, and other face-to-face engagement opportunities.

• Manage, coach, and develop the Brooklyn Basketball sales & service team through regular one-on-ones, team meetings, pipeline reviews, call coaching, goal setting, and ongoing feedback, while communicating reports and recommendations to leadership.

• Establish clear team priorities, sales processes, performance expectations, and key performance indicators for sales staff while ensuring a seamless transition within the sales & service team from booking through event delivery.

• Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy focused on families, schools, organizations, corporate groups, and other prospective customers across the NYC Metro Area.

• Own and monitor the team’s sales pipeline from lead generation through conversion, ensuring timely follow-up, effective prioritization, accurate forecasting and strong customer communication within Salesforce.

• Collaborate with the Director of Business Operations and internal stakeholders to develop campaign strategies, lead-generation opportunities, cadence automation, AI-enabled workflows, incentive programs, and other initiatives to support revenue growth.

• Coordinate the Brooklyn Basketball sales calendar, revenue cycle and annual schedule, including priority sales events and the Brooklyn Basketball facility schedule.

• Use sales reporting, customer data, market research, and performance insights to identify trends, improve conversion, and develop innovative revenue-generating opportunities.

• Meet and exceed personal and team performance objectives while maintaining a high standard of customer service and representing The Brooklyn Way.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• 3-5 years of professional sales experiences, preferably in sports, hospitality, events, or a related field.

• At least 1 year of experience managing or coaching sales and client-facing professionals preferred.

• Proficiency in Salesforce and related software.

• Demonstrated success owning a sales pipeline, meeting individual revenue goals, and converting leads into customers.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong knowledge of basketball programming and sales strategies.

WHO YOU ARE

• Passionate about the culture of sports as a vehicle through which to lift people up.

• A player-coach who is energized by both closing business personally and helping others improve their performance.

• Able to motivate, develop, and hold team members accountable while fostering an inclusive and high-performing team environment.

• Thrives in a collaborative, hands-on team environment

• Proactive by nature, with a solution-oriented approach to anticipating needs.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to manage respectfully across multiple levels.

• Detail-oriented, organized and able to work autonomously at all levels of sales.

COMPENSATION

$72,000 - $90,000

Full-time employees are eligible for a robust slate of total rewards, including:

WORK ENVIRONMENT

jobs.title: Financial Data Scientist - Capital Markets
jobs.description:
Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Location

This position will be based in New York City.

Reporting

This position will report to the Manager, Strategy New Opportunities & Analytics

Summary of Role

The Associate, Strategy, New Opportunities & Analytics sits at the center of Palmetto Capital's corporate strategy and structured finance team, turning Palmetto's data backlog into the insights that shape capital decisions. The primary focus is strategic and analytical: mining internal and external data to inform financing and capital structure decisions, and translating existing Excel-based models into Python to make analysis faster, more scalable, and more repeatable. This person also supports sourcing of new capital opportunities and contributes to select modeling and transaction execution work, with a sharp eye for detail and a comfort moving between code, data, and financial analysis.

Strategic & Tactical

Data Strategy & Analytics (~70%)

• Mine Palmetto's data backlog — portfolio, financing, operational, and market data — to surface insights that inform capital structure and financing decisions

• Build Python-based analytical tools, models, and dashboards that translate large, complex datasets into clear, decision-ready outputs for senior leadership

• Translate existing Excel-based structured finance models into Python to improve speed, scalability, and repeatability of analysis

• Analyze market, competitor, and macroeconomic trends, using code-driven analysis to inform financing and capital structure decisions

• Contribute to board-level and executive materials that connect data-driven analysis to Palmetto's broader growth strategy

• Assess the company's future capital position and financing needs, incorporating relevant legislative and regulatory data

• Automate recurring financial and operational reporting for key stakeholders, partnering with technology teams to reduce manual effort

• Drive pricing analysis across financing structures and capital products using quantitative, data-driven methods

New Opportunities (~20%)

• Support sourcing and evaluation of new capital opportunities and financing products through data-driven structuring and financial analysis

• Build exploratory Python models to size and stress-test capital structures and financing products that haven't been executed in the market, working in parallel with the team to refine and automate assumptions

• Run scenario and sensitivity analyses, using code-based tools, to pressure-test new structures and identify the optimal capital mix

• Support meetings with prospective investors by preparing data and analysis on new capital opportunities and financing facilities

Modeling & Execution (~10%)

• Support execution of select debt, tax equity, or structured finance transactions, working with banks, investors, and legal counsel as needed

• Maintain and query deal-tracking data across live and prospective financings

• Support due diligence and term sheet review with data pulls and analysis as needed

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement (Ongoing)

• Partner closely with FP&A, Treasury, and Accounting

• Identify and implement improvements to data infrastructure, tooling, and modeling processes

• Stay attuned to the needs of internal stakeholders and capital partners, anticipating data and analytical needs

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; coursework or hands-on exposure to finance, economics, or accounting required

• 2-4+ years of experience in a data analytics, data science, quantitative research, or software engineering role, with meaningful exposure to finance, fintech, or capital markets

• Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, or similar) and SQL; experience translating Excel-based financial models into code strongly preferred

• Experience building models, dashboards, or automated reporting and analysis tools from large, complex datasets

• Working knowledge of financial modeling concepts (debt, equity, tax equity, ABS, or similar structures) a plus

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with close attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical analysis for non-technical, senior audiences

• Highly motivated, collaborative, and comfortable operating with some ambiguity

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Palmetto embraces diversity and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for four years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full privacy policy.

For more about our Privacy Policy, visit: https://palmetto.com/privacy-policy

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team´s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues

• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Director Foreign Trade
jobs.description:
The Director of Foreign Trade provides strategic leadership for the organization’s global trade compliance and customs strategy, ensuring compliance with import and export regulations while optimizing duty costs and supporting efficient international supply chain operations. The role is responsible for developing and executing trade programs, maximizing free trade agreement utilization, strengthening customs compliance, driving duty optimization, advancing trade technology platforms, and enabling cross-border operational excellence.

Serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and key business functions—including Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, and Legal—the Director balances regulatory requirements with business objectives, operational needs, and growth initiatives. The position leads a team of foreign trade professionals and oversees relationships with customs authorities, brokers, trade consultants, and other external service providers to ensure effective, compliant, and cost-efficient global trade operations.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute the organization's foreign trade and customs strategy.
• Align trade compliance programs with corporate growth, sourcing, manufacturing, and logistics objectives.
• Advise executive leadership on trade risks, tariffs, geopolitical developments, and international regulatory changes.
• Lead trade-related initiatives supporting localization, nearshoring, global sourcing, and supply chain transformation.
• Ensure compliance with all import, export, customs, sanctions, and trade regulations.
• Establish and maintain policies, procedures, and internal controls governing international trade activities.
• Oversee import/export classification, valuation, country of origin determinations, and customs documentation.
• Direct internal and external compliance audits and implement corrective actions when required.

Customs & Duty Optimization

• Lead programs to minimize trade costs while maintaining full regulatory compliance.
• Maximize utilization of:Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)Foreign Trade Zones (FTZs)Bonded WarehousesDrawback ProgramsDuty Suspension ProgramsIMMEX/Maquiladora ProgramsOther trade incentive programs
• Identify opportunities for duty savings and tariff mitigation strategies.

Operational Oversight

• Oversee import and export operations across multiple business units and legal entities.
• Ensure efficient management of customs brokers, freight forwarders, and trade service providers.
• Drive process standardization and operational excellence in cross-border transactions.
• Monitor KPIs related to compliance, customs clearance performance, duty savings, and operational efficiency.

Risk Management

• Assess emerging trade risks resulting from regulatory changes, tariff actions, sanctions, and supply chain disruptions.
• Develop mitigation plans to address customs exposure and compliance vulnerabilities.
• Support investigations, disclosures, and interactions with customs authorities when necessary.
• Ensure effective business continuity planning for global trade activities.

Technology & Digital Transformation

• Lead implementation and optimization of trade management systems and customs technologies.
• Promote automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve trade compliance effectiveness.
• Ensure integrity of trade master data supporting classification, origin, and compliance processes.

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing team of foreign trade professionals.
• Develop talent, succession plans, and training programs within the trade function.
• Partner with procurement, logistics, manufacturing, finance, legal, tax, and government affairs teams.
• Represent the organization in dealings with customs authorities, trade associations, and external stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field.
• 10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or international logistics.
• 5+ years of leadership experience managing trade compliance or customs organizations.
• Deep knowledge of:Customs regulationsInternational trade agreementsImport/export controlsTariff classificationCountry-of-origin determinationDuty optimization programs
• Experience working with customs authorities and external trade partners.

Preferred

• Master's degree (MBA, International Trade, Supply Chain, or related discipline).
• Licensed Customs Broker or equivalent trade certification.
• Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or global supply chain environments.
• Expertise with trade automation platforms (SAP GTS, GTXXI, and similar systems).

International Bosch associates can apply.

Additional Information

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

Your well-being matters at Bosch! We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success!

jobs.description:

QGenda is redefining healthcare workforce management everywhere care is delivered. We're on a mission to empower the healthcare industry to better onboarding, deploy, and manage their workforce. Over 4,500 healthcare organizations have trusted us to help them make strategic workforce decisions through our unified software platform. QGenda is headquartered in Atlanta.

To learn more about QGenda, visit us at qgenda.com or follow us on Instagram or LinkedIn.

• Experience utilizing Salesforce, or similar CRM software

• Experience utilizing Salesforce or similar CRM software as well as Google Suite Products

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Smartsheet

Not Required, but Nice to Have

• Engineering or other technical degree

Applicants for this position must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States (U.S.), including being located in the US. We are unable to sponsor, take over sponsorship of, or hire candidates with an employment visa at this time.

What’s In It For You

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package to support our full-time employees and their family’s day-to-day needs, well-being and major life events, which includes:

QGenda delivers technology solutions to improve how healthcare is delivered and increase access — for everyone. We can only succeed by bringing together diverse minds, thoughts, ideas and team members to create better solutions for our customers and make us a better company as a whole. We are committed to creating a culture of embracing diversity, inclusion and equity for all.

jobs.title: Senior Staff DSP Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Staff DSP Engineer serves as a senior technical leader responsible for defining and advancing Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions across complex programs and technical initiatives. This position provides strategic technical direction, leads the resolution of highly complex engineering challenges, and helps establish DSP methodologies, architectures, and best practices across the organization.

The candidate will have expert-level knowledge of Digital Signal Processing concepts, including RF communications, synchronization, and high-speed ADC and DAC systems, with demonstrated experience translating advanced DSP concepts into practical hardware solutions.

The candidate will have extensive experience developing and implementing DSP algorithms in hardware, including:

• Algorithm prototyping and analysis using MATLAB or similar tools.
• Determining precision, dynamic range, performance, and implementation tradeoffs.
• Algorithm validation using hardware co-simulation, C/C++ bit-true modeling, or similar techniques.
• FPGA and/or ASIC implementation using Verilog, VHDL, or comparable hardware description languages.
• Evaluating system architectures and conducting complex technical trade studies.
• Identifying and introducing advanced DSP technologies, methodologies, and design approaches.

The Senior Staff DSP Engineer will provide technical leadership throughout all phases of the engineering lifecycle, including system architecture, requirements development, algorithm exploration, trade studies, design reviews, implementation, integration, laboratory verification, troubleshooting, and delivery.

This position is expected to influence DSP technical direction across multiple projects and programs, ensuring engineering solutions align with broader technical and business objectives. The Senior Staff DSP Engineer will identify significant technical risks and opportunities, recommend solutions to engineering and organizational leadership, and provide technical guidance on critical program and technology decisions.

The candidate will serve as a technical mentor to DSP engineers and other senior technical contributors, providing technical oversight, developing engineering capabilities, and helping establish consistent DSP engineering practices across the organization.

The candidate must demonstrate the ability to operate with a high degree of technical independence and judgment while collaborating effectively with engineering leadership, program teams, customers, and other technical disciplines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are required, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to technical teams, customers, program leadership, and senior management.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline with at least 12 years of relevant engineering experience; Master's degree preferred.
• Extensive experience in Digital Signal Processing architecture, algorithm development, implementation, integration, and verification.
• Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership on complex DSP systems and/or across multiple engineering programs.
• Demonstrated ability to independently resolve highly complex technical challenges and make decisions with significant program or organizational impact.
• Experience developing and implementing DSP algorithms in FPGA and/or ASIC hardware.
• Demonstrated experience leading technical trade studies, design reviews, architecture decisions, and technical risk resolution.
• Experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical leadership and oversight to engineering teams.
• Ability to influence technical decisions across engineering disciplines, programs, and organizational leadership.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with customers and senior leadership.

Desired Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desired:

• Image Processing
• Software Defined Radio
• Channelization/Reconstruction
• Array Processing
• Radar
• AI Engines
• Advanced RF communications systems
• High-speed ADC/DAC architectures

Active TS security clearance is a plus.

Compensation: Base salary range is $180,000-230,000/year, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

SEAKR is an Equal Opportunity Employer - All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US Citizenship Required

Applications will be accepted until 10/15/26.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.location: New London, North Carolina, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

The HR Generalist serves as a key business partner to manufacturing leadership and employees, driving workforce effectiveness, employee engagement, compliance, talent acquisition, and organizational performance. This role provides coaching and mentoring to our supervisors to strengthen our position as the preferred place of employment in the community and maintain positive associate relationships. The HR Generalist role thrives in a fast-paced production environment and balances day-to-day HR support with proactive initiatives that improve retention, accountability, safety culture, and employee experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business Partnership & Culture

• Serve as the primary HR partner for associates and supervisors across multiple departments and shifts, resolving concerns proactively and providing excellent customer service. ✏️
• Partner with EHS and Operations teams to champion a strong safety culture.
• Coach supervisors and managers on performance management, employee development, corrective actions, accountability, and conflict resolution. ✏️
• Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, accountability, and psychological safety.

Employee Relations & Compliance

• Investigate employee concerns, policy violations, complaints, and workplace conflicts in a fair, consistent, and timely manner.
• Partner with the Leaves & Accommodations team to manage FMLA, ADA, and other leave-of-absence cases.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local labor laws, and help leaders understand and apply policies in a consistent, people-centered manner.
• Assist with policy development, communication, implementation, and enforcement.

Talent & Retention

• Partner with leaders to execute talent initiatives that attract and retain high-performing team members, including recruitment, leadership development, succession planning, and engagement.
• Identify staffing needs and develop action plans to meet them. ✏️
• Facilitate onboarding programs that accelerate associate integration and productivity.
• Conduct stay interviews and analyze turnover trends to identify and implement retention strategies.
• Assist in developing and implementing training programs. ✏️

Data & Compensation

• Prepare and analyze reports on turnover, absenteeism, staffing, engagement, training, and workforce demographics, and use the trends to recommend ways to improve workforce effectiveness. ✏️
• Support compensation initiatives, including market analysis and planning.

Community

• Assist in organizing company functions and community relations activities. ✏️
• May perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered
• 3-5 years of progressive Human Resources experience
• Strong knowledge of employment laws, employee relations, performance management, and recruiting
• Demonstrated experience handling sensitive and confidential information
• Excellent interpersonal, communication (written and verbal), and conflict-resolution skills
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Workday, UKG Workforce Management
• Experience supporting manufacturing, distribution, or other operational environments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• PHR, SHRM-CP, or related HR certification
• Experience sourcing and recruiting skilled trades and production roles
• Experience preparing and analyze reports related to HR metrics

• Experience championing a positive safety culture in a manufacturing environment
• Experience with continuous improvement initiatives

jobs.title: Senior Meta Strategist (Remote US) - Future Opening
jobs.description:
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: Performance, Communications, and Commerce, each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, DiscoverabilityOS™, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and Content Marketing, to PR and Paid Social, to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

The Paid Strategist is a crucial, client-facing role responsible for day-to-day client deliverables, creating and managing custom client strategies, and communicating with both clients and internal stakeholders on executing Paid Social deliverables. In this role, you will gain experience building high-performing Paid strategies for B2B businesses across Technology, Industrial, and Services markets.


(Internal Title: Senior Account Strategist, Paid Social) 



Roles & Responsibilities

 - Serve as direct support to client contacts

 - Weekly communication with any vendors or operational partners to ensure we're aligned on tasks being assigned, work quality, and any improvements we can make to that dynamic

 - Build strategies for clients each quarter

 - Have the ability to create, maintain, and optimize budgets for paid media campaigns

 - Deeply understand client positioning and unique value propositions

 - Confirm lead routing is accurate within a CRM

 - Responsible for personal productivity and utilization

 - Work directly with Associate Director to ensure internal and client goals are being achieved

 - Understand the value of Programmatic campaigns

 - Drive cross-sells, upsells and referrals via client relationships and professional network

 - Execute and optimize advertising campaigns within LinkedIn including ad copywriting, TAM development, and targeting to maximize ROI



What You Offer

 - 2+ years experience working at a performance/digital marketing agency, with hands-on experience supporting B2B clients

 - Deep expertise across paid social advertising campaigns, specifically LinkedIn Ads or Meta Ads

 - Understanding of different Ad Units within the LinkedIn or Meta Platform such as conversation ads, document ads, CTV and more

 - Proficiency in using advertising platforms and tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager or Meta Campaign Manager Zoominfo, 6Sense, and more

 - Strong understanding of Paid principles, including keyword research, ad copywriting, bid management, and campaign optimization

 - Ability to analyze campaign performance data using tools like Google Analytics, GA4, Excel, or other analytics platforms to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance

 - Ability to drive results and measure via OCT

 - Experience with audience segmentation by tier, job title etc. 

 - Proven and measurable success with mid-market or enterprise accounts

 - Ability to translate and articulate strategy and tell stories with data

 - Equal parts competitive and curious; you’re a true problem solver

 - You live on the cutting edge of the industry, always looking for opportunities to grow and share

 - Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

 - You’re quality-obsessed and have not lost your soul for advertising

 - Travel to visit clients approximately once per year, per client or as needed



What Success Looks Like

 - You encompass our core values through every interaction; internally and externally

 - Effectively manage approximately five mid-tier and enterprise accounts

 - Meet and exceed department level KPIs, such as client growth and goal attainment. Your core KPIs will be client NSMs (North Star Metrics) and Client Satisfaction scores

 - Build client trust and relationships that create consistent renewals

 - Cross-sell services that align with client goals and objectives

 - Clearly communicate results with client point of contact and executives

 - Exceptional decision making, as it relates to strategic direction for accounts



Benefits

 - 🙏  Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle
   
   - Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents

 - Benefits to Support the Whole Person:
   
   - 🧠  Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
   
   - 💪  Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
   
   - 🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
   
   - 💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
   
   - 🌟  Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time



Work Environment Requirements

As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from anywhere in the US, with the option to enjoy our state-of-the-art offices in Irvine, California. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, the UK, and Australia. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.

This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.

jobs.description:
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B performance marketing agency that delivers real revenue - not just leads.

We use Customer Generation (a marketing methodology developed by us) to cut through the noise. Forget MQLs - we’re here to drive pipeline, fuel SQLs, and scale brands that are serious about growth. From Paid Media and SEO/Content to CRO, RevOps, and Go-To-Market Strategy, we build marketing engines that win in SaaS and across B2B industries.

We move fast. We think boldly. We are elite. We hire people who challenge the status quo and push campaigns past what’s expected - sparking demand for bold, innovative brands. If you live for performance, love solving hard problems, and want your work to actually mean something, you’ll fit right in.

But here’s the fun part - we don’t just deliver results; we’re shaping the future of marketing. Ready to build something that breaks the mold? Come join us.



About The Role

We’re looking for a bold, strategic Programmatic Strategist - someone who thrives in the fast-moving world of SaaS and B2B marketing and knows how to make a big impact with budgets and even bigger ideas.

The Programmatic Strategist is a crucial, client-facing role responsible for day-to-day management of our Programmatic clients, including but not limited to campaign builds, optimization, and reporting across all Programmatic Channels (Display, Native, Video, Audio, etc). They create and manage custom client strategies and communicate with clients and internal stakeholders.



What You’ll Do: 

1. Campaign Management:

 - Strategy Development: Collaborate with internal teams to create comprehensive media strategies that align with client objectives.

 - Data Integration: Leverage first-party and third-party data for precise audience targeting and segmentation.

 - Planning and Setup: Develop and implement programmatic campaigns across various Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) such as DV360, The Trade Desk, and others.

 - Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns to achieve performance and pacing goals.

 - Reporting: Generate and analyze performance reports to provide actionable insights and recommendations.

 - Troubleshooting: Quickly identify and resolve issues related to campaign performance and delivery.

2. Team Collaboration:

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with creative, analytics, and account teams to ensure cohesive campaign execution.

3. Client Relationship Management:

 - Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates on campaign performance and strategy adjustments.

 - Presentation: Present campaign plans, performance reports, and strategic recommendations to clients.



What You’ll Bring:

 - 3+ years of proven experience in programmatic roles at publishers, advertising agencies, or ad tech companies (bonus B2B experience)

 - Hands-on expertise in media buying: building and optimizing campaigns in DSPs, with a preference for experience in TTD and DV360

 - Proven track record in Programmatic media planning, buying, and building measurement frameworks to evaluate campaign success

 - Strong understanding and perspective of how programmatic and other channels (both paid and organic) work together to holistically surpass client KPIs

 - Experience successfully driving programmatic growth across clients in the B2B/SaaS landscape with budgets over $50k/month

 - Strong cross-collaboration skills, both within the organization and externally (client-facing), with excellent interpersonal and communication abilities

 - Solid analytical ability, exceptional attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset, capable of balancing multiple projects effectively
   

Goals:

 1. NSM Attainment: 100%

 2. CSAT: 4.4+



What We Offer:

jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities

As a Maintenance Manager, your primary responsibilities include:

• Leading by example and being a role model for the standards and behaviors consistent with the core values and culture of Bozzuto

• Dedicating time to hiring, developing and providing on-the-job and classroom education opportunities to techs and community care associates

• Showing care and concern for our residents through timely follow up and meticulous completion of their apartment service tickets

• Resolving maintenance issues in the area of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and appliance repair

• Managing the make-ready and apartment turnover process with attention to detail and timeliness so apartments can be leased and new residents can move in

• Preserving the value of the building by consistently executing on preventative maintenance programs

• Preserving the beauty of the building and the safety of the community through general upkeep and cleanliness, snow removal and grounds maintenance

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis around the world since 2011, establishing cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post.

We're scaling significantly and building the People function to carry it, including evolving  the recruitment function needed to drive that growth. Today we're a team of eight, primarily based in Nairobi, and we're adding a recruiter to own our most senior and niche searches across every function: programs, tech, product, G&A, and fundraising.

The core of the job is proactive sourcing in markets where the talent is real but not obvious. You will not wait for inbound. You'll map the market, build calibrated pipelines from scratch, and get strong candidates into process quickly. Building GiveDirectly's name with institutions and networks across the continent is part of the work.

This is a generalist role for someone who has recruited senior talent on the continent across a range of functions. Our most acute needs right now are programs leadership and tech, so that's where you'll start, but the desk isn't single-function: you'll pick up our hardest searches wherever they sit.

What you'll do

Own our hardest senior searches end to end

• Own Senior Manager+ searches from launch through offer at a 6 to 8 week pace where the market allows, starting with programs leadership and tech and extending to our toughest searches across other functions.

• Serve as the recruitment focal point for these roles: the person hiring managers come to, and the person who knows where this talent is.

• Build and maintain regional talent pipelines and GiveDirectly's presence with strong institutions and networks across the continent.

Source proactively

• Lead with outbound. Map talent pools, build boolean searches, and use LinkedIn Recruiter and our other tools to build small, strong, calibrated pipelines rather than working through inbound volume.

• Translate a vague profile into a real search in a thin market, and recommend profile or approach changes when the market tells you something.

• Build diverse slates as a matter of course rather than treating it as an afterthought.

Drive the process and partner with senior hiring managers

• Run recruiter-led searches with senior hiring managers (up to c-suite): you drive, they don't. Lead launch calls and syncs, hold the timeline, challenge assumptions and hold lines on process quality when a search stalls.

• Run clean pipelines: keep Greenhouse current, review your funnels regularly to catch where candidates are stalling, and use pipeline data to diagnose a stuck search and to push hiring managers on decisions rather than letting roles drift.

• Own the candidate experience end to end: keep people warm and moving, sell GiveDirectly, run comp and logistics, and close the offer.

Contribute to the team

• Peer-coach more junior recruiters on sourcing and search craft, and turn what you learn into shared practice.

• Raise the bar for how our team recruits: build and roll out a consistent search process and outbound sourcing practice, model it in your own searches, and play a key role in coaching the team to adopt it - all while delivering an excellent candidate and hiring manager experience.

• If you bring French and/or Portuguese, put it to work on searches the rest of the team can't reach today.

• Feed what you're seeing in the market back to the Director, TA to sharpen overall strategy and take on select TA projects that improve how we hire.

What you'll bring

Required

• 5+ years of relevant experience recruiting for tech-forward INGOs, or in a mission-driven scale-up or startup. Traditional NGO experience alone isn't enough; we want someone who has hired in a fast-moving, tech-literate environment.

• Deep proactive-sourcing experience for senior roles: you've built pipelines from scratch through outbound, in markets where the talent isn't obviously labeled, and can show what you sourced and closed.

• Recruiting range across multiple functions: you've owned senior, end-to-end searches in more than one domain, ideally including both technical or professional roles (tech, product, G&A, fundraising) and programs or field leadership. This breadth is the core of the role.

• Recent experience recruiting in sub-Saharan Africa, with a real feel for the markets and where strong candidates actually are.

• A track record owning searches end to end and partnering strategically with hiring managers, including holding a line on process or profile when a search is stuck.

• Strong process hygiene and a data-driven approach: you keep your pipelines clean and current, track conversion and time-in-stage, and use what the funnel tells you to make calls and move searches, rather than going on instinct.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity: a vague brief, a thin market, no existing pipeline, and a hiring manager who wants someone yesterday.

• Strong candidate-closing instincts: you can sell a mission-driven org and carry a candidate through to signature.

Strongly Preferred

• Based on the African continent.

• Professional French and/or Portuguese language skills.

• Fluency with Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI-assisted sourcing tools.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here. Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, the US, or the UK, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

• Base Salary: $83,820

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$8,382, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $9,807 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $92,202+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

jobs.title: Senior Director, B2B Engineering, Americas Site Lead
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Flywire is seeking a Senior Director, B2B Engineering to lead and scale our B2B engineering organization across the Americas, with a strong preference for this leader to be based in Austin, Texas.

This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of engineering strategy, payments innovation, AI-first product development, and site leadership. The Senior Director will own the technology strategy and execution for Flywire’s B2B business, partner closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and Engineering leadership., This leader will also serve as the engineering site lead for Austin, helping establish Austin as a strategic engineering hub for Flywire. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in payments, high-volume transaction systems, enterprise B2B platforms, and modern engineering practices, with the leadership maturity to operate at senior levels across a complex, global organization.

What You’ll Do

• Lead Flywire’s B2B engineering organization, owning technical strategy, delivery, architecture, execution, and long-term scalability.
• Partner with the CTO, Product, B2B business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to define and deliver the technology roadmap for Flywire’s B2B business.
• Build and scale a high-performing internal engineering team, reducing dependency on external contractors and strengthening Flywire’s internal IP, technical depth, and operating leverage.
• Serve as the Americas engineering site lead, helping establish Austin as a strategic technology hub and creating the foundation for future engineering growth.
• Drive an AI-first engineering mindset, identifying opportunities to leverage AI to improve product capabilities, engineering productivity, automation, customer experience, and platform intelligence.
• Bring strong technical leadership across payments, high-volume transaction processing, enterprise integrations, financial workflows, reliability, security, and scalable platform design.
• Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, accountability, and delivery discipline across the B2B engineering function.
• Partner closely with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Data, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure the B2B platform is scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to Flywire’s broader technology strategy.
• Recruit, mentor, and develop senior engineering leaders and technical talent, creating a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, and high performance.
• Represent B2B engineering in executive-level discussions, providing clear communication on priorities, risks, tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and investment needs.
• Help shape Flywire’s technical brand in Austin and the broader Americas market.

Here's What We're Looking For

• 15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership experience at Director, Senior Director, or equivalent level.
• Proven experience leading engineering teams in payments, fintech, B2B software, high-volume transaction systems, marketplaces, financial platforms, or enterprise SaaS.
• Strong technical depth in modern backend systems, distributed architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, reliability, security, and scalable platform design.
• Demonstrated success building or transforming engineering organizations, managing external vendors and driving high performance driven engineering culture.
• Experience partnering directly with business, product, and executive stakeholders to define technology strategy and deliver business-critical outcomes.
• Strong understanding of payment flows, financial systems, transaction processing, reconciliation, compliance, risk, or related fintech infrastructure.
• AI-forward mindset, with practical experience applying AI, automation, or data-driven capabilities to improve product and engineering outcomes.
• Experience building engineering culture in a hub or site leadership capacity strongly preferred.
• Ability to operate with executive presence, influence senior stakeholders, and navigate complex organizational dynamics.
• Strong talent magnet with the ability to attract, assess, hire, coach, and retain exceptional engineering talent.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
• Location preference: Austin, Texas. Chicago may also be considered for exceptional candidates.

What Success Looks Like

• In the first 6 to 12 months, this leader will:
• Establish a clear technology strategy and operating model for B2B engineering.
• Build trust and credibility with B2B business leaders, Product, Engineering, and executive stakeholders.
• Begin transitioning critical B2B engineering capability from external contractors to internal Flywire talent.
• Hire and develop a strong core engineering team in Austin or another strategic Americas hub.
• Improve delivery discipline, engineering quality, platform reliability, and technical ownership.
• Identify practical AI-first opportunities that improve product capability, customer value, and engineering productivity.
• Create a strong foundation for Flywire’s Americas engineering site strategy.

Why This Role Matters

Flywire’s B2B business is a strategic growth area, and the technology foundation behind it is critical to our ability to scale. This role is not simply about managing engineers. It is about building the right technical strategy, strengthening internal ownership, modernizing how we deliver, and establishing a senior engineering presence in the Americas that can help shape the next chapter of Flywire’s growth.
