jobs.title: Certified Medical Assistant RMG Endocrinology Full-time Days
jobs.description:
This position is for an MA to support an Endocrinology clinic. Endocrinology experience is preferred.

The Certified Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) is a multi-skilled worker who assumes a wide range of clinical and administrative roles within the physician office setting. Under the supervision of a Physician and/or the direction of a licensed nurse, the CMA provides direct and indirect patient care, performs laboratory and other testing, and may assist with clerical functions. The CMA serves as a key team player when interacting and communicating with patients and/or clinical staff in the ambulatory care environment.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Rooms patients and provides direct patient care under the supervision of a physician, and/or direction of an RN/LPN. Records medical, surgical and family histories, medications and vital signs. Prepares patients for office procedures and assists nursing and medical staff with routine examinations and patient treatments. Always considers specific patient needs; administers care according to individual age and abilities.
• Explains treatment procedures to patients; reinforces patient education regarding medication and special diets or testing that has been provided by the RN/LPN or physician (for example, the After Visit Summary).
• Administers injections and medications as directed by physician.
• Performs point of care testing, including venipuncture, urine dips, finger sticks, strep screens, flu screens, pregnancy tests, and cultures. Independently performs other tests and/or office procedures such as EKG's, pulmonary testing, and chronic disease management testing.
• Is knowledgeable about the purpose, process and results for tests and lab specimens frequently performed in an office setting.
• Relays NORMAL test results to patient or reads results, verbatim, from the physician documentation. Consults an RN, LPN, or physician should the patient have questions regarding their results.
• Adheres to CDPG Environment of Care policies. Maintains infection control standards for exam/procedure rooms and areas where patient care services are delivered. Cleans, disinfects, changes linen etc. Performs quality checks and trouble-shoots office instruments. Is knowledgeable of sterilization techniques and biological indicators for sterilization.
• Participates in shared governance, committee work, and practice/department projects.
• Demonstrates the knowledge of proper identification and reporting of medical/health care errors.
• Demonstrates a willingness to support co-workers; voluntarily pitches in. Willing to mentor and train new staff. Acts as an integral member of the team.
• Communicates appropriately and clearly with all. Maintains a good working relationship within the office and other ancillary departments. Demonstrates a positive attitude.
• Handles situations in a mature and professional manner.
• Prioritizes and re-prioritizes workflow and maintain an organized workspace.
• Engages in teamwork as a team player and a team builder.
• Meets current standards and policies for documentation. Provides documentation that is timely, accurate, up to date, complete and legible.
• Charges for all ancillary services performed
• Participates in ongoing educational activities appropriate to the area of practice. Seeks experiences, formal and independent learning activities to maintain and develop clinical and professional skills and knowledge. Shares knowledge from continuing education programs with co-workers.
• Exhibits creativity and flexibility through the dynamics of change.
• Appropriately utilizes the functionality of the medical record and practice management systems within their job responsibilities, for example, all documentation, order entry, results, referrals, etc.
• Stays informed of medical record and practice management system updates and implements into daily work.
• Utilizes online resources efficiently including Outlook, Corridors, and Team Sites.
• Completes other duties as assigned

Required:

• Two or more years of recent experience working as a Medical Assistant in a physician office setting or completion of an accredited Medical Assisting Program
• High School Diploma or equivalent with 2 or more years of experience as Medical Assistant or completion of an accredited Medical Assisting Program
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Completion of phlebotomy class or equivalent experience. Basic computer knowledge. Ability to type proficiently and accurately. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing. Ability to assess and determine situations requiring an interpreter and to use interpreter services effectively.
• New graduates/hires must obtain certification/registration within 1 year from hire date. The following certifications will be accepted:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)An active RN or LPN license in the state of Illinois will be accepted in lieu of CMA certification

Preferred:

• Associates degree in Medical Assisting
• Second language proficiency a plus

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

NorthwesternMedicine Career Page

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager to partner with enterprise organizations as they build workforce capabilities, develop critical skills, and drive measurable business outcomes. This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers with accountability for retention, customer outcomes, expansion readiness, and long-term partnership success.

As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, helping organizations align workforce development strategies to business priorities. You will guide customers through onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and growth while ensuring they achieve meaningful outcomes from their Skillsoft investment.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager serves as the strategic post-sale owner of the customer relationship, working closely with Account Executives, Solution Partners, Professional Services, Product, and Support teams to drive customer value, retention, and growth.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as a strategic advisor to enterprise customers, connecting Skillsoft solutions to workforce, talent, skilling, and business transformation priorities.

• Act as the source of truth for customer health, account strategy, stakeholder dynamics, risks, opportunities, and next actions.

• Develop and execute customer success plans aligned to business objectives, success measures, workforce initiatives, and desired outcomes.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships across executive sponsors, business leaders, HR, talent, learning, and technology stakeholders.

• Drive customer outcomes by helping organizations define, measure, and achieve meaningful workforce and business results.

• Lead strategic reviews that connect customer goals, skills development, adoption trends, business impact, and future opportunities.

• Identify and mitigate customer risk early by monitoring account health, stakeholder engagement, adoption signals, and business changes.

• Own renewal readiness through proactive planning, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and value realization long before the renewal window.

• Create executive alignment by facilitating conversations that strengthen sponsorship, governance, and organizational commitment.

• Partner cross-functionally with sales, solutions, services, support, and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

• Surface growth opportunities by identifying expansion signals, workforce initiatives, and emerging customer priorities.

• Leverage customer insights to influence product direction, service improvements, customer programs, and go-to-market strategy.

Skills & Qualification Requirements

• 5+ years of professional Customer Success, Sales or Professional services experience with a Bachelor's Degree in business, education, or related field; or equivalent experience

• Experience leading complex customer relationships and driving measurable business outcomes within enterprise organizations.

• Solid knowledge of the digital learning industry with the ability to articulate its features and benefits to all levels of the business enterprise, including understanding of the customer's business drivers

• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into strategic recommendations and action plans.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders from program managers through executive leadership.

Preferred Skills & Experience

• Experience using Salesforce CRM and Churn Zero or CSP equivalent

• Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and data-driven storytelling tools

• Knowledge of workforce transformation, AI-enabled learning solutions, talent development, or HR technology ecosystems.

Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in AI-native skills management for the human + AI era. By unifying learning, real-time skills intelligence, and workforce insights, Skillsoft helps enterprises build their Skillforce™ — humans and AI working together to drive measurable business outcomes. Through personalized, interactive learning across leadership, technology, and compliance, Skillsoft enables organizations to close critical skill gaps and accelerate transformation. jobs.description:
The People Analytics Team at Datadog uses data to help our growing organization make better people decisions.

We're expanding our workforce planning capabilities to support how we grow and structure our teams. In this role, you'll help build and maintain the data foundation behind our headcount and capacity models, partnering with FP&A, Recruiting, and PBPs to keep workforce planning grounded in clean, trustworthy data.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture – the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Automate and expand Datadog’s headcount-driven capacity modeling, improving the underlying data pipelines and insights that they surface

• Build and maintain data models covering headcount, positions, and hiring pacing, keeping them accurate as business context changes

• Own the position data audit process, establishing and maintaining a source of truth for open, filled, and planned positions across the business

• Support workforce forecasts by analyzing attrition, mobility, hiring, and promotion trends in partnership with the broader People Analytics Insights team

• Partner with our People Tech teams (HRIS, Recruiting Ops, developers) to shape the headcount management tech roadmap, driving for infrastructure and tooling that reduces friction and unlocks better data

• Serve as a point of contact for stakeholder questions on workforce planning data, handling day-to-day communications and support requests

• Contribute to the overall maturity of workforce planning at Datadog by improving how data is sourced, modeled, and shared

• Run external benchmarking analyses to inform headcount planning by researching labor market data, translating it into internal-ready insights, and publishing findings for stakeholders

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, people analytics, FP&A, or a related analytical role

• Experience building or maintaining financial/headcount forecasting models, translating trends into forward-looking projections for capacity planning

• Proficiency in SQL and other data analysis tools, as well as dashboarding and standard BI tools such as Tableau

• Familiarity with position management concepts, ideally in Workday or a comparable HRIS

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market  research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision:  empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Marketing Intern will support the Perchwell marketing team and gain hands-on exposure to digital marketing strategy, campaign execution, and marketing analytics. You’ll help us share stories of agents and brokers working with Perchwell to prospective buyers, launch new AI features, and build content that establishes Perchwell as a thought leader in real estate.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Rising seniors in Marketing, Business, Communications, Journalism, or a related field who are excited to intern at a fast paced, NYC-based SaaS company this summer.

 - Passionate problem solvers who thrive in fast moving environments.

 - Strong communicators and team players who can work cross functionally.

 - Eager learners who want to gain real world engineering experience.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Real-estate and market research - Track industry trends, competitor activity, MLS technology, and customer insights.

 - Campaign and event support - Assist in ongoing marketing initiatives.

 - Cross-functional collaboration - Work with sales, customer success, product management, and leadership to translate Perchwell’s work into clear, compelling messaging.

 - Performance measurement - Track engagement, campaign results, and content performance, then share recommendations.

 - Project - You will own a marketing project that you will take from start to finish and present to the company at the end of your internship.




WHY THIS INTERNSHIP?

 - Real Ownership: Over 10 weeks, early June to mid August, you will choose and lead your own project, making key decisions along the way.

 - Fully In Person Experience: This is a full time, in office internship based at our beautiful New York City HQ in Soho. You’ll work on site five days a week and collaborate closely with our team, gaining hands-on experience in a fast paced, learning oriented environment.

 - Showcase Your Work: At the end of the summer, present your project to the company

REQUIRED FOR THE ROLE

$10,000 for 10 weeks (minus applicable taxes and withholdings)

jobs.title: Lead Corporate Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors. You’ll be building from 0 → 1 in some places and 1 → 10 in others.

What we don't have yet is someone who owns corporate security as a domain — who decides what the bar is, sequences the work to get there, and sees the next problem before it becomes a fire drill.

That's this role. You'll own the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. Our senior IT engineers run the platforms day to day and are your closest partners — you make their work better, not harder.


HOW THIS ROLE WORKS WITH IT

Ownership splits by layer, not by system. Our senior IT engineers own the run; you own the standard and the direction.

 - You own the corporate security roadmap. What we secure, in what order, to what bar. You bring it to IT leadership and the CISO aligned, not for arbitration

 - IT engineering owns platform operations. Okta, Lumos, Kandji, and the wider SaaS portfolio are administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce

 - You raise the bar around you. You make your reasoning explicit so IT engineers make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path

 - You're accountable for the outcome, not just the proposal. You decide, you communicate the tradeoff, and you own what happens next

The people who do well here get their plans stronger by exposing them to the people who run the systems, and they carry the room without needing the org chart to settle it.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Identity and access governance

 - Own the access model at Suno: the RBAC and entitlement design, least-privilege defaults, and the governance layer in Lumos that enforces them

 - Set the standard for what access review, certification, and approval should look like here — then build toward it rather than importing someone else's framework

 - Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible

 - Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent

Endpoint security and vulnerability management

 - Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions

 - Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem

 - Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work

Detection and response

 - Own CrowdStrike Falcon Complete and our outsourced SOC relationship: coverage, tuning, escalation quality, and vendor performance against what we actually need

 - Define what good detection looks like at Suno and hold the provider to it, rather than accepting their default view of our environment

 - Lead corporate security incidents to closure, including the executive communication, and make sure what we learn changes the system rather than just the ticket

Third-party and integration risk

 - Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal

 - Define our risk appetite in practice, in partnership with the CISO, and make it legible enough that others apply it without you

 - Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows

SaaS security posture

 - Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows

 - Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults

Cross-functional leadership

 - Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys, early enough to matter

 - Influence the scope of what comes next: how our future GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes

 - Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including IT engineers who aren't security specialists


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 90 days: you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers and the SOC, and told us the three things we're wrong about

 - First 6 months: a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving

 - First year: entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS security as a domain rather than as a set of tickets

 - Deep hands-on expertise with a modern IdP (Okta preferred) and with IGA or access-governance tooling (Lumos, Veza, ConductorOne, Opal, or similar)

 - You've designed an entitlement or RBAC model across a large SaaS portfolio and lived with the consequences long enough to know what breaks

 - Endpoint security depth in a macOS-primary fleet: MDM-delivered hardening, compliance and device trust, third-party patch and vulnerability management at scale

 - Real EDR depth — CrowdStrike preferred — and experience holding a managed detection provider or outsourced SOC to a standard you defined rather than accepting theirs

 - Strong command of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM, and of the risk model behind third-party integrations

 - A track record of setting a security standard that other people applied without you enforcing it — written policy, tooling, defaults, or all three

 - Experience influencing engineering and business teams who don't report to you, early enough in their process to change the outcome

 - Automation fluency: Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, and a habit of building integrations and internal tooling as a normal part of the job

 - Excellent writing and judgment under ambiguity. You can hold a position with an executive and change it when the evidence says to

 - A calibrated sense of risk. You know which risks to block on, which to document, and how to tell the difference in public

Helpful, not required: detection engineering, insider risk or DLP programs, zero-trust network access, SOC 2 or ISO program ownership, just-in-time access patterns or identity-as-code, securing AI agent and non-human identity access, prior experience as the first or second security hire at a fast-growing company.





Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Company Summary

At Apriori Bio, our cutting-edge platform, Octavia™, is a fully-integrated, closed-loop engine functioning as a 'Bio-OS' for advanced biotech innovation and biodefense. This biology-enabled AI/ML platform transforms complex biological data into actionable intelligence to map viral fitness landscapes, predict immune escape trajectories, and enable the rapid, modular design of variant-resilient immunological therapies, including vaccines, antibodies, and next-generation immunogens.

Position Summary

Apriori Bio is seeking a Workplace Experience Coordinator to keep our office running smoothly and welcoming for our team of wet lab scientists and computational experts. This role owns the day to day office environment, including facilities upkeep and vendor relationships, visitor management, onboarding and offboarding logistics, and office events, and serves as the central point of contact between HR, IT, Finance, and Operations on all workplace matters. It's a great fit for someone organized, personable, and hands on who takes pride in creating a great place to work.

Responsibilities

• Manage kitchen and office supply inventory, including ordering, restocking, and vendor coordination, to keep the office fully stocked and running smoothly

• Serve as the central coordination point between HR, IT, Finance, and Operations on office-related matters, and maintain office-wide communications for facilities updates, events, and building notices

jobs.title: Staff Java Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Summary

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is building the industry's most trusted, scalable, and fan-centric sportsbook experience. Our Internal Platforms power critical systems that support customer operations, marketing, support, risk, and data—through a combination of Java backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, and integrations with the SaaS and CRM platforms our business teams run on.

We are seeking a Staff Java Software Engineer to set technical direction for the services and integrations that Internal Platforms runs on. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who operates with minimal guidance, takes on our most complex and often cross-functional problems, and raises the bar for everyone around them.

At this level, your impact is measured beyond the code you write. You will own architecture for significant parts of the platform, drive decisions that span multiple teams and systems, mentor other engineers, and partner directly with Product, Operations, Support, Marketing, Risk, and Data leadership to shape what gets built and why. You will still be hands-on—Staff engineers at FBG write and review code every week—but you will spend meaningful time on design, technical strategy, and multiplying the output of the teams you work with.

You do not need to be a Salesforce specialist. Some of our systems integrate with Salesforce for CRM and workflow automation, so exposure to it is a nice to have—but we're hiring for strength in Java, distributed systems, and integration design, and we expect you to pick up the platform specifics on the job.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture (Primary Focus)

• Own the architecture for major services, integrations, and data flows within Internal Platforms, from problem definition through production operation.

• Lead design for complex, often cross-functional initiatives—defining the approach, surfacing trade-offs, and driving alignment across engineering teams and stakeholders.

• Break ambiguous, department-level problems into clear technical plans and workstreams that other engineers can execute against.

• Evaluate and select technologies, patterns, and vendors; know when a sophisticated design approach is warranted and when the simpler answer is the right one.

• Establish and evolve engineering standards for the team—API design, testing strategy, observability, deployment, and integration patterns—and get them adopted in practice, not just documented.

• Identify systemic technical debt and reliability risk across the platform, build the case for addressing it, and sequence the work alongside feature delivery.

Hands-On Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain Java-based backend services (Spring Boot or similar frameworks) that are scalable, resilient, and well-tested.

• Take on the hardest technical problems on the team: high-throughput event processing, complex multi-system integrations, thorny data integrity issues, and production incidents that cross service boundaries.

• Diagnose problems at the root cause rather than the symptom, and translate what you learn into durable fixes and better instrumentation.

• Set the quality bar through your own code and through high-signal code reviews that teach as well as gate.

• Contribute to internal web applications and user interfaces backed by Java services where it moves the work forward.

Mentorship & Force Multiplication

• Mentor and coach Senior and mid-level engineers through design review, pairing, and direct feedback; help them grow the judgment to handle complexity independently.

• Create learning and growth opportunities for teammates—delegate meaningful design work, sponsor stretch assignments, and share context generously.

• Onboard and ramp new engineers into the platform's systems and conventions.

• Write the documentation, runbooks, and design records that let the team operate and extend the platform without you in the room.

• Model an inclusive, collaborative environment where opposing views are actively invited and disagreement is resolved on the technical merits.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Delivery

• Partner with Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, and business stakeholders to shape roadmaps—bringing technical feasibility, sequencing, and risk into the conversation early rather than reacting to finished requirements.

• Work directly with Marketing, Operations, Support, Risk, Compliance, and Data teams to ensure platform capabilities meet business needs and regulatory obligations across jurisdictions.

• Represent Internal Platforms in architecture and design discussions with other engineering teams, negotiating clean contracts and shared ownership boundaries.

• Communicate complex technical problems, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to both engineering and non-engineering audiences, including leadership.

• Drive predictable delivery for initiatives you own: scope, estimate, unblock, and own the outcome—including the parts that depend on other teams.

• Engage external partners and vendors on integration design and technical escalations where needed.

Third-Party & SaaS Platform Integration

• Own the integration architecture between our Java services and the third-party platforms our business teams depend on—REST APIs, platform events, middleware—including data ownership, consistency, and failure handling.

• Define scalable, reusable integration patterns and prevent the platform sprawl that comes from point-to-point fixes.

• Lead resolution of complex integration issues spanning backend services, vendor platforms, and data pipelines.

• Partner with platform-specialist engineers (including our Salesforce-focused engineers) to keep integration boundaries clean and maintainable.

Operational Excellence

• Own production health for the services in your remit: SLOs, alerting, on-call quality, incident response, and post-incident follow-through.

• Anticipate failure modes, capacity limits, and blockers before they surface, and build the safeguards in advance.

• Improve engineering practice across the team—CI/CD, test automation, release safety, and developer productivity.

• Hold the line on the standards required of a regulated, highly available gaming platform.

Qualifications

Required

• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java.

• Demonstrated ownership of the architecture and delivery of complex production systems, including work that spanned multiple teams or functions.

• Strong experience designing APIs and integrating distributed systems, with sound judgment about consistency, failure handling, and service boundaries.

• Track record of operating with minimal guidance: taking an ambiguous problem, defining the approach, and driving it to production.

• Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards on a team—through design review, code review, and direct coaching.

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly in writing and in person, to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

• Experience with Git-based workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience operating services in production, including on-call ownership and incident response.

Preferred

• Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar) at meaningful scale.

• Experience in cloud environments (AWS preferred), including infrastructure-as-code.

• Experience with highly available or regulated systems (gaming, fintech, payments).

• Experience contributing to internal web UIs or tooling, including Java-backed web frameworks and/or modern front-end frameworks consuming Java APIs (React, Angular, etc.)

• Experience working with AI model or agent platforms, including building on or integrating agents into production workflows. Familiarity with platforms such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, CrewAI, or AutoGen is a plus.

• Fluency with AI-powered coding assistants to design, build, and test new functionality from the ground up—moving quickly while maintaining high code quality and test coverage—and interest in helping the broader team adopt these workflows effectively.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to Salesforce as an integration target or platform—Salesforce APIs, platform events, or light development work in Apex, Lightning Web Components, or Flows. Helpful context, not a requirement.

• Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Developer).

What We Value

• Passion for building high-quality internal platforms that directly impact business outcomes.

• Strong ownership mindset: you own the outcome, not just your piece of it.

• A solutions-first approach—you anticipate problems and bring options, not just escalations.

• Genuine interest in making other engineers better.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with incomplete information.

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

jobs.description:

About the Role

Title: Revenue Operations Associate

Reports to: Director of Revenue Operations

Location: Remote, US

We are searching for a Revenue Operations Associate who loves translating big picture strategic goals into actionable tooling, automation, and analysis outputs. This is a great role for someone who wants to shape a rapidly-scaling B2B and B2C marketplace business and who enjoys learning new technologies on the job. We’re looking for a transversal thinker who is curious and intrepid.

You’ll be a driving force behind ensuring our multi-segment Sales team can push the pace, looking each day to improve their efficiency and effectiveness, and to ensure management visibility into key metrics and trends. You will also build and refine the automations that intelligently score and assign leads and accounts, ensure smooth client handoffs between internal teams, streamline proposal-handling, and ensure we can use leading indicators to make decisions proactively.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, this role is critical to helping us ensure alignment across our Sales segments, Finance, Marketing, and Partner and Service Operations.

What You’ll Do

• Collaborate with sales unit leaders and executive leadership to define, document, and manage the end-to-end revenue process, identifying bottlenecks and areas for optimization.

• Design, implement, and document standardized processes for lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-close, and post-sales activities.

• As a secondary administrator for our revenue stack (centered on Salesforce and Outreach), configure and customize our instance, lead projects to enhance integrations with other services, and ensure data integrity. Contribute to the revenue stack tech roadmap, ensuring that we can stay nimble as we continue to scale.

• Develop and maintain key performance indicator (KPI) dashboards and reporting across Sales, Account Management, Support and other revenue-related functions to provide actionable insights into revenue performance.

• Own monthly commission calculation, data review process and Cost of Sales analysis.

• Analyze and assist in setting annual and quarterly revenue targets, forecasting, and compensation plan design.

• Provide regular forecasting support, working closely with sales leadership and finance to improve forecast accuracy and pipeline visibility.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on pipeline health, sales productivity, campaign effectiveness, and customer churn/retention.

What You’ll Bring

• A bachelor's degree, and 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. Experience in a marketplace business is a plus.

• Enviable analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations. Advanced Excel/GSheets skills and some experience with SQL.

• Expert-level proficiency as a CRM Administrator (Salesforce required; certification not required), and demonstrated experience managing an integrated tech stack, including sales engagement (we use Outreach), marketing and process automation, AI, and other analytics products.

• Superb communication and personal organization, with a knack for helping translate concepts and breaking down broad needs into actionable projects. You’re able to recommend solutions and then bring them to life.

• Proven ability to propose solutions that balance speed and durability/scalability, and eagerness to steer projects to completion.

• Eagerness to incorporate AI intelligently to help our organization run smoothly at scale.

• Familiarity with financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts related to revenue.

• Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.

jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Position Description

Voyager Technologies is seeking an experienced and strategically minded Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to serve as the dedicated people partner for one of Voyager's core business divisions. Reporting to the Senior Director, HR Business Partners, this role is the critical link between the business and the broader HR function, translating division-level goals into actionable people strategies while ensuring employees and leaders have the day-to-day HR support they need to perform at their best.

As an HRBP at Voyager, you will be embedded in your business unit - attending leadership meetings, advising organizational decisions, leading complex employee relations matters, and partnering with HR Centers of Excellence to bring the right programs, tools, and talent strategies to your client group. You will be expected to know your business deeply, speak the language of your leaders, and bring HR solutions that are practical, compliant, and mission-aligned.

The ideal candidate is a confident HR advisor with the presence to influence leaders, the judgment to navigate ambiguity, and the drive to build something meaningful in a high-growth environment.

Reporting Structure & Location

This role reports to the Senior HR Director, HR Business Partnerships and sits within the People department. The position is onsite, based out of San Diego, CA and will have multi-site responsibility.

What You'll Do

Strategic People Leadership

• Serve as a key member of the Site Leadership Team, partnering with leaders to develop and execute a long-term people strategy aligned to business priorities

• Champion Voyager Technologies’ culture, values, and behaviors, creating an inclusive, engaging, and high-performance work environment.

• Partner with leaders to identify and solve complex people and organizational challenges, developing and implementing targeted strategies including engagement and retention initiatives.

Employee Relations

• Lead employee matters, including investigations, grievances, and conflict resolution, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant outcomes

• Build and maintain strong, productive relationships with plant stakeholders and employees

• Coach leaders to strengthen frontline leadership capability and reduce risk through effective people management.

Talent, Capability & Organization

• Own workforce planning, staffing strategy, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development for the site.

• Partner with leaders to build organizational capability and support change initiatives.

• Partner with business leaders on organizational design, including organizational structure, roles, spans of control, and workforce alignment to support evolving business needs.

Change & Continuous Improvement

• Support the people and change management aspects of Voyager’s site operating system and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Enable disciplined routines, standard work, and leadership behaviors that support sustainable adoption of new ways of working.

• Use people data and metrics to identify trends, measure progress, and drive targeted improvement actions.

HR Operations & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with employment law, company policies, and HR processes.

• Maintain accurate HR data and support reporting/analytics.

• Accurately process employee payroll

• Partner with centers of excellence (COEs).

Travel

• Must be able to travel between multiple sites, as needed

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 5 years in a dedicated HR Business Partner role supporting a specific business unit or client group.

• Experience working with a highly technical/engineering-heavy and manufacturing workforce.

• Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment law compliance; California experience strongly preferred.

• Experience partnering with HR COEs to deliver integrated people solutions within a business unit.

• Proficiency with HRIS platforms (ADP, Workday, or similar) and comfort generating and interpreting workforce data.

• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to analyze workforce data, create reports, utilize formulas, and translate data into actionable business insights.

• High degree of professional discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

Preferred

• PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification.

• Experience working with ADP and WorkDay

• Experience supporting HR in a government contracting, defense, aerospace, or national security environment.

• Familiarity with DCAA compliance and OFCCP obligations.

The good faith base salary range for this role is $125,000–$155,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Registered Nurse (RN) will provide and oversee the medical services provided to a caseload of patients. This licensed nursing professional will act as the medical treatment plan coordinator for the multi-disciplinary team in the development and implementation of the master treatment plan and the discharge plan for each patient. This person will actively communicate with support staff, treatment teams, providers, and outside agencies on treatment and safety issues pertaining to patients and their family members. The Registered Nurse (RN) will work under the supervision of a Registered Nurse or provider, and will perform duties according to established patient care protocols, standards, and procedures. This position is expected to complete all documentation associated with these duties in a professional and timely manner.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

• Interact routinely with patients, observe behaviors and communicate significant observations to multidisciplinary team as necessary

• Administer medications to patients, and engage in education process

• Utilize de-escalation skills when exposed to volatile patients to maintain personal safety for the patient and other individuals in our care

• Provide admission, orientation, education and discharge plans to patients, families and others to aid in the treatment process

• Consult with the multidisciplinary treatment team in the development of treatment plans and discharge planning to strive for excellent patient care

• Participate in the maintenance of a clean, orderly and safe environment, and report needs for repairs and maintenance to appropriate staff

• Admissions and discharges of patients

• Obtain vital signs, monitor symptoms and document in the patient record

• Comply with all laws, regulations, and scope of licensure

• Oversee and participate in the quality assurance and compliance activities of the facility

• Adhere to all company policies and procedures

• Maintain confidentiality in accordance with established policies and procedures and standards of care

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

• Current, unencumbered, active license to practice as a Registered Nurse in the state where services are rendered

• Must be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

• Current and nationally accredited CPR/First Aid/AED certification

• Knowledge of computer and electronic medical records systems (KIPU preferred)

• Enthusiasm, passion for working with people, and an internal drive to improve the lives of individuals in our care

• Must maintain applicable state licensure requirements throughout duration of employment

• Ability to work with a diverse population along with interpersonal skills and knowledge required for treating patients in area of assigned specialty

• Demonstrated ability to hold strong personal boundaries and ability to build rapport with patients

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Team Lead - Membership Sales, New York Liberty
jobs.description:
Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment creates bold, authentic, and unforgettable experiences that redefine sports, entertainment, and hospitality, The Brooklyn Way. As the parent company of marquee properties including the Brooklyn Nets, NY Liberty and Barclays Center, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment operates at the intersection of live entertainment, premium hospitality, and community engagement.

As it expands its existing portfolio, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment now includes BK Mag, Brooklyn Wine Club, and a hospitality business developing several location-based entertainment properties.

Whether on the court, on stage, or in the workplace, Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment is driven by a pursuit of excellence—constantly evolving, innovating, and pushing boundaries to elevate its business and expand its fan base. The company is deeply committed to fostering a culture of belonging and inclusion, both internally and across its communities, ensuring that every interaction reflects its values of growth mindset, integrity, accountability and care.

We are guided by our core values:

• Integrity: Be intellectually honest at all times. Demonstrate the highest professional and ethical standards.

• Care: Care for everything and everyone around us. Practice empathy, respect, and inclusion to promote an environment of excellence and success.

• Growth Mindset: Develop ourselves and those around us. Experiment, learn, and improve from everything we do.

• Accountability: Deliver on our word, take responsibility for our actions, and work in the interest of our team.

SUMMARY

The Senior Account Executive, Team Lead – Membership Sales for the New York Liberty is a player-coach role for a proven hunter who wants to sell at a high level while beginning to lead people. This individual carries their own aggressive new-business targets across New York Liberty full season memberships, partial plans, group memberships, and premium seating (suites, courtside, and other premium inventory) while directly overseeing a small team of Account Executives whose day-to-day results and development also roll up to them.

This is a hybrid selling and people managing position. The Team Lead is expected to out-produce the team they oversee, and to use that credibility to coach, ride along with, and hold accountable the reps who report to them. It's built for someone with real leadership aspirations who has earned the right to start managing by being the best seller in the room first.

This role reports to the Director of Business Development.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Sales & Revenue Generation

• Carry and consistently exceed a personal new-business quota across full/partial season memberships, group memberships, and premium seating products (suites, courtside, and other premium inventory).

• Develop and execute outbound sales strategies through phone, email, text, networking, referrals, digital outreach, and in-person appointments to build and maintain a robust personal pipeline.

• Identify and close cross-sell/upsell opportunities into Barclays Center concerts, family shows, and other live entertainment events.

• Host prospective and current members and premium clients during Liberty games and assigned events, delivering a best-in-class experience from first contact through post-sale engagement.

• Represent the New York Liberty at community events, networking functions, watch parties, and other fan engagement opportunities to generate new business.

Team Leadership & Coaching

• Directly oversee a pod of Account Executives: set daily/weekly activity and revenue expectations and hold the team accountable to them.

• Onboard and ramp new Account Executives, pairing them with scripts, playbooks, and hands-on floor coaching.

• Partner with sales leadership on performance management: goal-setting, 1:1s, informal performance feedback, and input into hiring decisions for the pod.

• Serve as the connective tissue between frontline reps and the Director above them — surfacing what's working, what's not, and where reps need support.

Strategic Prospecting & Client Experience

• Maintain strong knowledge of New York Liberty ticket and premium products, Barclays Center events, promotions, scheduling, and industry trends, and translate that knowledge into team-wide talk tracks.

• Build a personal pipeline and playbook rigorous enough to model for the team — the goal is to lead by example, not just by title.

• Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and pipeline forecasting, both personally and in review of the team's activity.

WHO YOU WILL BRING

Required

• 3-5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience with a demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue goals; sports, entertainment, or premium hospitality sales strongly preferred.

• Prior experience training, mentoring, or informally leading other sales reps (a top performer who others go to for help, a lead rep, a peer mentor, etc.).

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Strong consultative selling skills across both transactional (membership) and higher-touch, longer-cycle (premium) products.

• Comfort giving direct, constructive feedback and holding others accountable, not just closing your own deals.

• Experience managing pipeline through a CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar).

• Availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the New York Liberty schedule and other Brooklyn Sports & Entertainment events.

Preferred

• Prior experience as a Senior AE, Team Captain, Assistant Manager, or similar hybrid selling/leadership title.

• Existing book of business in NYC metropolitan arena preferred.

• Familiarity with premium/B2B sales motions (suites, hospitality, sponsorship, or enterprise sales).

WHO YOU ARE

• A hunter first: you love prospecting, chasing the next deal, and the thrill of closing, and you have no interest in stepping fully off the phones.

• A natural leader who other reps already gravitate toward for advice, energy, or a second opinion on a deal.

• Competitive with yourself and with the team: you want the team to win as much as you want your own number to hit.

• Direct and coachable: you can tell a teammate their pitch isn't working, and you can hear the same from your own manager.

• Passionate about women's sports, live entertainment, and creating unforgettable fan experiences.

• Comfortable operating in the gray area between IC and manager.

COMPENSATION

$70,000 - $75,000 base salary, plus commission and bonus eligibility

Full-time employees are eligible for a robust slate of total rewards, including:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage; HSA and FSA eligibility

• 401k Employer Match at 4%

• Competitive PTO policy & Company Holidays

• Parental leave policy eligible after 6 months of service

• Access to events at Barclays Center, subject to ticket availability

• Free lunch onsite Monday - Thursday; onsite barista bar

• And more!

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Works primarily in an office environment in Industry City, Brooklyn. This position is expected to work New York Liberty home games, Barclays Center events, and other assigned events, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

As a Strategic Finance Lead, you'll tackle the most important problems and opportunities across the business, bringing analytical, operational, & strategic lenses to drive towards the best possible outcome. Every day will look different — helping our partnership team set smarter quotas, optimizing D2C channel mix, driving retention uplift through better provider-patient matching, and finding collection optimization opportunities. You'll be trusted to lead critical cross-functional initiatives and solve problems you've never faced before.

This person will report into our CFO or Senior Strategic Finance Lead and work closely with founders and VPs across every team in the organization.

This role is full-time and open to NYC-based candidates only (expectation to work in-person 3-4 days per week, with some remote flexibility). Our office is located in Gramercy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as a high-impact business partner on key strategic projects across the organization — driving smarter investment decisions, optimizing cost, improving unit economics, and accelerating growth

• Lead planning efforts, supporting business partners in setting goals and outlining the path to get there

• Analyze messy, ambiguous data to surface non-obvious trends and insights that inform critical business decisions

• Support high-importance ad hoc work, including board meetings, capital raises, and M&A

• Navigate problems you've never encountered before, working from first principles to figure out the right approach

• Communicate findings and recommendations in a clear, structured way to leadership and cross-functional partners

• Proactively identify operating gaps and lead end-to-end efforts to close them

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 2-5 years of experience in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Growth Equity/Venture Capital, with the exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills that come with it

• You have strong financial modeling skills and advanced proficiency in Excel

• You have exposure to fast-paced, high-stakes environments where you've had to balance attention to detail with seeing the bigger picture

• You take extreme ownership — you don't wait for someone to assign you a task, you chase down a problem until it's solved

• You are a first principles thinker — you don't need to be an expert in something to ask great questions and get to the heart of what matters

• You sweat the small stuff — and know that the difference between good and great is in the details

• You are hungry to improve, coachable, and willing to put in the work (and take the tough feedback) it requires to get there

jobs.title: Product Manager II - Agentic Platform
jobs.description:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Product Manager to help unify and scale our agentic AI platform, the shared foundation that grounds every solution built on it in two decades of accumulated retail expertise. The near-term work is getting the platform's first capabilities launched and consolidating what exists today onto a common core across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the fleet of agents that runs on both. It serves teams across Toshiba and the customers and partners who build on it.

This is a build-and-ship role: writing specs, working alongside engineering to get capability out, putting it in front of the teams who use it, and bringing back what you learn. You will work closely with platform and engineering leadership on direction, own turning it into well-defined, shipped work, and supply the evidence from real use that shapes what comes next.

What Success Looks Like

Toshiba's twenty years of retail expertise lives in its products, its architecture, and the judgment behind both. The platform brings that together in one place and puts it to work for anyone who needs it, whether they are building something, answering a question, or delivering for a customer.

Success is how far that reaches: engineers shipping faster, expertise available without waiting on the expert, people doing work that used to need a specialist, and customers and partners building on the same foundation.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the shared platform backlog across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the agent fleet.

• Write clear product requirements and specs, translating business use cases from internal stakeholder teams into actionable work.

• Partner day to day with Engineering/Architecture on platform structure, flagging feasibility issues and trade-offs.

• Support execution of the governance model for agent build, review, and release: registry entries and ownership, risk tiers, human-in-the-loop review, evaluation thresholds, promotion criteria, and the data access and customer data protections that apply at every step.

• Ship the curated workflows, skills, and reference patterns that make the platform faster to use and more reliable in what it produces, along with the onboarding documentation that lets a team get going without the platform team in the room.

• Operate with a builder mindset: use the platform yourself, prototype what you are asking for, and drive adoption directly with the teams rather than only through documentation.

• Close the loop: gather feedback and usage signals from the teams on the platform, turn friction into concrete backlog items, and bring the evidence that informs the roadmap.

• Build the instrumentation and reporting behind the platform's KPIs, so progress is visible to the teams and to leadership: adoption and breadth of use across teams, onboarding time, the share of portal usage that reaches merged and deployed code, developer experience, agent and retrieval quality, and usage cost and attribution.

Required Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent combination.

• 5-8 years of product management experience, ideally including some exposure to platform, developer-tools, or infrastructure products.

• Working familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval/RAG, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation) and genuine interest in building deeper hands-on fluency.

• Ability to write clear product requirements and specs, and to prioritize a backlog.

• Enough technical fluency to work day-to-day with engineering on APIs and platform architecture, comfortable asking questions and following trade-off discussions without necessarily driving architecture decisions.

• A builder's instinct: you use the tools you manage, try things yourself before writing the spec, and can show what you mean rather than only describe it.

• Experience supporting an internal-facing product, or a strong interest in internal/platform product work over pure customer-facing feature work.

• Comfortable operating with ambiguity and escalating appropriately rather than needing fully defined requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior exposure to RAG, LLM-based assistants, or agent frameworks in a shipped product.

• Familiarity with evaluation, tracing, or observability for LLM and agent systems.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics or platform-engineering measurement concepts (deployment frequency, lead time, developer satisfaction/NPS).

• Experience instrumenting a shared service and building the reporting people actually use.

• Experience with a platform serving both internal teams and external customers: multi-tenancy, self-service onboarding, packaging, or support-model work.

• Exposure to usage metering, cost attribution, or internal chargeback for a shared service.

• Experience in retail technology or another vertical with SaaS/on-prem hybrid constraints.

• Exposure to working with Legal/Compliance on data-rights or AI risk questions.

• Experience supporting an internal tool or platform used by other teams rather than end customers.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc. offers a competitive salary and generous benefits package including the following:

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should email benefits@toshibagcs.com to request an accommodation

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

We at Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions firmly believe that our people are an integral part to the success of our customers. Furthermore, we're committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion for all our people as highlighted by our 5 Core Principles (Create Outreach, Foster Belonging, Unleash Opportunity, Diverse Cultural Engagement and Culture of Transparency).
