jobs.title: Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London, the UK

About the Role:

As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results.

What you'll do

• Responsibilities: Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks. Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences. Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company

• Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks

• Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions

• Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

• Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.

• Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others

• Excellent communication (verbal & written) — able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership

• Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude

• Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Flagship Labs 103: Proteomics Co-Op
jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full-time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About Flagship Labs 103

What if… you could help build a platform that reveals the biological state of any cell in the human body from a simple blood draw?

Flagship Labs 103 (FL103), a Flagship Pioneering-backed biotechnology company, is developing a novel diagnostic platform to decode cellular dynamics through extracellular vesicles (EVs). EVs carry rich molecular information from their cells of origin and circulate throughout the body, offering an unprecedented opportunity to non-invasively monitor tissue biology and connect individuals to the most effective interventions to prevent and manage disease.

About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Labs 103 is a product of Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to the Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You’ll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learn firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneers new ventures that change the world.

The Role

FL103 is seeking a Co-Op to join our small, hands-on Proteomics team, working directly alongside a scientist and the team lead. You’ll help develop and run mass spectrometry–based proteomics assays that support our diagnostic platform, and help analyze the resulting data.

Depending on project needs and the direction the team takes, work may involve materials derived from cell culture and/or materials derived from human plasma; you’ll get exposure to both as potential sample sources as our assays and platform evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Help develop, execute, and troubleshoot proteomics assays under the guidance of the team’s scientist and team lead.

• Prepare and process samples derived from cell culture and/or human plasma, following established and evolving protocols.

• Support mass spectrometry–based proteomics sample preparation workflows, including protein extraction, digestion, and clean-up.

• Assist with LC-MS/MS sample handling and instrument runs alongside the team.

• Support analysis of MS-based proteomics data — for example, organizing and processing datasets and helping summarize results.

• Maintain clear, complete records in an electronic lab notebook (ELN) — conditions, calculations, raw data, and observations.

• Help document and refine protocols so they’re easy for others on the team to follow.

• Present progress and results in team meetings; flag questions, unexpected results, and ideas early.

Qualifications

Required

• Pursuing a BS or MS in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, Bioengineering, Analytical Chemistry, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience with common molecular biology or biochemistry lab techniques (e.g., pipetting, buffer/solution prep, protein or nucleic acid handling, basic assay execution) from coursework, research, or prior lab work.

• Comfort following and adapting written protocols, with strong attention to detail and good documentation habits.

• Ability to work well in a small, collaborative team and communicate clearly about progress, questions, and problems.

• Genuine interest in proteomics, protein biochemistry, or diagnostics.

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with proteomics techniques, mass spectrometry sample prep, or protein biochemistry — for example, through a research role, prior co-op/internship, or extended independent lab work (not just coursework).

• Prior exposure to mammalian cell culture and/or handling of human plasma or other biological samples.

• Prior industry or academic research experience in a proteomics, protein biochemistry, or diagnostics-focused lab.

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You’re contributing to a venture that is still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, Discovery DMPK
jobs.description:
About Parabilis Medicines

Parabilis Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to creating extraordinary medicines for patients with serious diseases by unlocking biologically important targets long considered undruggable. The company has pioneered a new class of alpha-helical peptides – Helicons™ – capable of modulating intracellular proteins that have historically been beyond the reach of conventional medicines. The company’s lead investigational medicine, zolucatetide, is the first and only direct inhibitor of the β-catenin:TCF interaction, a central node in the Wnt/β-catenin pathway that has eluded drug developers for decades. Zolucatetide is being evaluated in the clinic across multiple Wnt/β-catenin-driven diseases, including desmoid tumors, familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) and a range of other solid tumor indications. Beyond zolucatetide, Parabilis is advancing additional Helicon-based programs focused on other challenging targets where we believe our medicines could have life-altering impact. For more information, visit www.parabilismed.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

What’s the opportunity?

Parabilis Medicines’ Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) team is seeking an experienced Director-level scientist to provide strategic and scientific leadership across our portfolio of innovative peptide therapeutics. Reporting to the VP of Discovery DMPK, you will serve as a senior DMPK leader and primary representative across cross-functional discovery project teams, shaping DMPK strategy, play a key role in building an AI native organization and influencing key program decisions. You will partner closely with medicinal chemists, pharmacologists, toxicologists, and external CRO partners to integrate ADME, PK, and PK/PD insights, proactively identify and mitigate development risks, and advance novel therapeutics from early discovery through development candidate nomination.

Key responsibilities:

• Provide strategic leadership for peptide DMPK across multiple discovery programs, establishing ADME strategy and ensuring alignment with program milestones, development objectives, and broader portfolio priorities.

• Lead the design, interpretation, and integration of in vitro and in vivo ADME/PK studies to drive lead optimization, development candidate nomination, and progression into IND-enabling development.

• Serve as a DMPK subject matter expert and strategic partner to medicinal chemistry, pharmacology, toxicology, and other cross-functional functions, integrating DMPK data to influence chemical design and prioritize novel chemical matter with favorable drug-like and translational properties.

• Identify and proactively address key DMPK risks, knowledge gaps, and development challenges, establishing fit-for-purpose strategies to enable program progression.

• Provide scientific oversight of external CROs and partners, ensuring high-quality execution of DMPK studies within program timelines and budgets.

• Present DMPK strategies, integrated data assessments, human translation considerations, and risk/benefit recommendations to project teams and senior leadership to inform key investment and development decisions.

• Provide DMPK leadership for regulatory strategy and submissions, including IND/NDA, Investigator Brochures, briefing documents, and responses to regulatory authorities.

• Co-lead the development and implementation of AI-enabled DMPK workflows and digital solutions to streamline operations, accelerate data analysis and integration, and enable faster, data-driven decision-making across discovery and development programs.

• Build and advance DMPK capabilities in bioanalysis and peptide transporter sciences by strategically leveraging internal expertise, external partners, CROs, and emerging technologies to address program needs and strengthen organizational capabilities.

• Mentor and provide scientific guidance to junior scientists while contributing to the continued development of DMPK capabilities, technologies, and best practices across the organization.

What you’ll need to be successful:

• PhD (or equivalent) in DMPK, pharmacology, biology, chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related discipline with 10+ years of relevant industry experience, or MS with 13+ years of relevant experience.

• Demonstrated track record of leading DMPK strategy across multiple discovery and development programs, including experience advancing compounds through lead optimization, development candidate nomination, and IND-enabling activities.

• Deep understanding of peptide and small molecule ADME/PK principles, with the ability to apply DMPK concepts to complex or emerging modalities. Experience with biologics is a plus.

• Strong understanding of human translation, including PK/PD relationships, human PK and dose projection, transporter/DDI assessment, and exposure-response relationships. Hands-on modeling or regulated bioanalysis experience is desirable.

• Proficiency with Phoenix WinNonlin and R for PK analysis, data interpretation, and PK/PD reporting.

• Significant experience selecting and overseeing external CRO partners, including study strategy, technical oversight, troubleshooting, timelines, budgets, and data quality.

• Demonstrated ability to provide expert-level DMPK guidance for regulatory submissions, including INDs, IBs, briefing documents, and responses to regulatory authorities.

• Strong scientific leadership and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to drive decisions across medicinal chemistry, pharmacology, toxicology, clinical pharmacology, and other cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex DMPK findings into clear recommendations for project teams and senior leadership.

• Demonstrated ability to utilize AI tools in day-to-day scientific work; advanced or innovative application of AI to DMPK analysis, data interpretation, or scientific workflows is a strong plus.

• Able to work on-site and participate regularly in in-person project and leadership meetings.

Core Values

Parabilis Medicines is a team of passionate pioneers who are trailblazing the future of precision medicine with the aim of making a meaningful difference in the lives of patients. The company is committed to promoting an inspiring and flourishing working environment for all employees across the business, in all departments, and driving innovation for patient benefit.

• Growth-Minded. We’re inventing a new class of medicines—one applicable to therapeutic targets that have been dreamt about, but always considered impossible to drug. Our work requires us to be curious, humble and adaptable.

• In(ter)dependent. We are fiercely independent as a leader in defying the limitations of current therapeutic modalities, and interdependent as a team as we work collaboratively to shift drug discovery paradigms and provide patients with better treatment options.

• Patient-focused. We are deeply focused on patient outcomes, and all energy in the company is focused on science as it translates to patient impact.

• All-In. We’re All-In on solving some of the hardest scientific challenges and delivering one of the most effective new classes of drugs in history.

The base salary range for this position is $210,000-$250,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal practices. Parabilis’s total compensation package also includes an annual target bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of competitive benefits designed to support our employees’ overall well-being.

As an equal opportunity employer, Parabilis Medicines values an inclusive workplace and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

AECOM is seeking a Structural Engineering Manager (Team Lead) to be based in Denver, CO. This role is a key leadership position within AECOM’s Buildings + Places structural engineering practice, combining advanced technical leadership with people management, project delivery accountability, and practice development responsibilities.

The Structural Engineering Manager will lead and grow a team of structural engineers supporting projects across commercial, aviation, federal, industrial, technology, and adaptive reuse markets. Typical project scales range from $5M–$500M in construction value, with opportunities to contribute to larger, complex programs. This role is ideal for a senior structural engineer ready to expand their leadership impact while remaining technically engaged in complex design challenges.

Join our award‑winning Buildings + Places team and play a critical role in shaping project outcomes, developing future leaders, and advancing AECOM’s structural engineering practice in the Rocky Mountain region.

About Buildings + Places

AECOM’s Buildings + Places practice integrates architecture, interiors, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering, workplace strategy, urban planning, and landscape architecture to deliver holistic, resilient, and innovative solutions. Our teams work across the full project lifecycle—from planning and design through construction administration—delivering projects that strengthen communities, advance sustainability, and create lasting value.

Role Impact

This position serves as a trusted technical and people leader within the structural discipline. You will directly influence how structural engineering services are delivered, mentor and develop engineers at all stages of their careers, and help position AECOM as a technical leader in seismic design, retrofit, and complex building systems. The role offers significant autonomy, visibility, and opportunity to shape both projects and people.

Responsibilities

Technical & Project Leadership

• Serve as the structural discipline lead and formal Quality Control owner for assigned projects, ensuring compliance with AECOM standards and industry codes
• Lead structural design on mid-size projects and major scopes on large, complex projects
• Perform and review advanced structural calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical reports
• Provide expertise in seismic analysis and retrofit design, including ASCE 41, performance-based design, and complex lateral systems
• Oversee construction administration activities including submittal reviews, RFIs, site observations, and technical issue resolution
• Represent structural engineering in client meetings, interdisciplinary coordination, and design reviews

People & Practice Leadership

• Lead and manage structural engineering teams (typically 2–6 staff), including workload planning, delegation, technical oversight, and mentoring
• Support hiring, onboarding, professional development, and performance feedback for Engineer I–III staff
• Serve as a technical advisor and mentor, supporting engineers toward licensure and future leadership roles
• Foster a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the structural team
• Support workforce planning and coordination with department and discipline leadership

Delivery Ownership & Business Support

• Be accountable for structural discipline delivery on assigned projects, including quality, schedule, and budget performance
• Contribute to technical proposals, pursuit strategies, scope definitions, and interviews
• Support and strengthen client relationships through trusted technical leadership
• Assist discipline leadership with development of best practices, tools, and delivery approaches
• Thought Leadership & Regional Collaboration
• Contribute to technical thought leadership, including internal knowledge sharing, white papers, presentations, or technical initiatives
• Collaborate with structural teams across the West region and other AECOM offices, sharing expertise and supporting complex pursuits
• Participate in shaping regional technical standards, seismic expertise, and innovation initiatives within the Buildings + Places practice

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an accredited program
• 8+ years of progressive structural engineering experience (experience plus graduate education may be considered) or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Structural Engineering
• 12+ years of progressive experience
• Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in Colorado or ability to obtain via comity within 6 months
• Demonstrated experience with IBC, ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, TMS 402/602, NDS
• Advanced proficiency in structural analysis software (ETABS, SAP2000, RAM Structural, RISA, SAFE, or similar)
• Experience designing structures using concrete, steel, masonry, and timber
• Strong background in wind and seismic lateral systems, including retrofit of existing structures
• Proficiency with Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

By providing rigorous academic instruction and creating powerful relationships amongst our community’s members, we ignite passion, seek knowledge, and inspire the bravery needed to have a profound impact in our world.

You believe that each and every student, regardless of race, socioeconomic status, gender identity, religion, or immigration status is deserving of an excellent education and capable of achieving it.

You are HUNGRY FOR FEEDBACK. You want to grow as a person and a professional. You want to learn from your peers and your coaches, even when it challenges you to put aside your ego. 
You are NERDY. You have a deep love for your area of expertise and a genuine excitement to share it with others.

You are INTROSPECTIVE. You are committed to personal development and prioritize your own wellness. You are reflective about your impact on others and feel comfortable acknowledging your own mistakes and quirks.

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

As Head of Product Marketing, you'll build and lead the product marketing function at Donorbox, making it a key driver of growth, conversion, and retention. This role reports to our SVP of Marketing. You'll own our positioning and messaging across diverse nonprofit audiences, define our Product-Led Growth strategy, and partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to bring launches to market. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll manage one Product Marketing Manager while building the frameworks and processes the team needs to scale.

PLG & Growth Strategy: Hands-on definition and execution of Product-Led Growth (PLG) strategies to turn product usage into a direct driver of customer acquisition, monetization, and expansion. Process & Scale: Build and formalize scalable PMM frameworks, playbooks, and standardized launch tiers to create predictable impact across high-velocity feature releases.

Partner with Sales and CS leadership to identify enablement priorities that shorten deal cycles and improve retention across our target ICPs.

Continuously track and report on campaign and feature effectiveness, bringing data-driven insights and rigorous analysis to executive leadership presentations. Associate Director, Habilitation

Launch a new office. Build a lasting legacy.

BAYADA is seeking an experienced, mission-driven Associate Director to help launch and grow a brand-new Habilitation office serving the Sikeston Region of Missouri. This is an opportunity to shape the culture, operations, community presence, and future success of a new office from the ground up while helping individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities live with greater independence and dignity.

The Associate Director will initially work from the BAYADA Lebanon office while the new Rolla office is prepared. After approximately one year, the successful candidate must be willing to work from the Rolla office once it is ready to be occupied.

This is an onsite leadership role for a collaborative, resilient, and growth-minded professional who is energized by building relationships, developing teams, and creating dependable systems that support excellent client service.

Role details

• Practice: Habilitation

• Territory: Sikeston Region

• Office status: Brand-new office and expansion in Missouri

• Work model: 100% in office

• Compensation- $75,000-$80,000 depending on qualifications

What you will do

As Associate Director, you will help establish the foundation for a successful new Habilitation office while developing the skills and experience needed to lead office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Help launch the new Habilitation office and establish BAYADA as a trusted provider and employer in the Sikeston Region.

• Build relationships with clients, families, referral partners, community organizations, and prospective employees.

• Support local marketing, outreach, and business development efforts to grow awareness of Habilitation services.

• Learn and perform Client Services Manager responsibilities during the office launch and until the office is fully staffed.

• Support client and employee census growth, service coordination, staffing, and day-to-day office workflow.

• Manage the office using established workbooks, billed-hour expectations, key performance indicators, goals, and other operating metrics.

• Help create and maintain organized, reliable processes that support quality service, compliance, responsiveness, and a positive client and employee experience.

• Partner with the Division Director and other BAYADA leaders to identify priorities, address challenges, and move the office forward.

• Assist with hiring and onboarding the future Clinical Manager, Habilitation Manager, and Client Services Manager.

• Contribute to a culture grounded in compassion, reliability, and excellence.

• Remain on call initially while the office is being established and staffing is built.

Your first year

The first year will be focused on learning, building, and preparing for long-term growth. You will receive training in Client Services Manager responsibilities and will perform those duties while the office is being staffed. You will also help develop the local presence of HSK through outreach, relationship building, recruiting, and operational readiness.

This role requires comfort with evolving priorities. The Associate Director’s schedule will generally align with office hours, but the workday may vary based on client needs, team needs, community outreach, hiring activity, and the demands of launching a new office.

What we are looking for

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Experience in leadership, operations, or managing day-to-day business activity.

• Meaningful experience working with or supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

• Willingness to work onsite 100% of the time.

• Ability to work from the Lebanon office initially and transition to the Rolla office when it is ready to be occupied.

• Availability to participate in initial on-call responsibilities.

• Ability to travel for training and company events, including travel to Pennsylvania and throughout Missouri.

• Strong organizational, communication, judgment, and relationship-building skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with Habilitation or other services supporting people with I/DD.

• Experience with census management, scheduling, staffing, budgets, billed hours, or operational metrics.

• Familiarity with community outreach, referral development, recruiting, or local marketing.

The qualities that will help you thrive

You will be well suited for this role if you are:

• Mission-driven and genuinely motivated by supporting individuals with I/DD and their families.

• Comfortable creating structure where processes are still being developed.

• A confident communicator who builds trust with clients, families, employees, and community partners.

• Accountable, organized, and able to follow through on commitments.

• Adaptable when priorities change and willing to step into hands-on responsibilities.

• A thoughtful problem solver who balances urgency with sound judgment.

• A team builder who recognizes that a strong office is built through collaboration, coaching, and consistent care.

• Energized by growth and motivated to leave a positive, lasting legacy in the community.

Why this opportunity matters

This is more than an opportunity to join an established team—it is an opportunity to help create one. By helping launch HSK, you will influence how the office serves clients, supports families, develops employees, and becomes part of the Sikeston Region community.

At BAYADA, our commitment to care is reflected in the way we show up for the people and communities we serve. In this role, your leadership will help create a strong foundation for future excellence and ensure that clients and families can count on compassionate, reliable, high-quality support.

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

#LI-MS1

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

jobs.description:
The core responsibilities of this Data Analyst role involve the end-to-end data lifecycle for operational performance metrics and their financial impacts. This encompasses data acquisition, cleaning, and feature engineering of large datasets, including metered consumption data and water distribution system diagnostic telemetry. A primary function is the application of high-granularity data sourced from Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), SCADA and associated leak detection analytics to propose optimal resource allocation for field operations. PWD’s mission is to translate these analytical insights into actionable, data-driven strategies that directly inform asset management decisions to mitigate water loss and safeguard departmental revenue integrity.

Consistent reliability during normal work hours, off-hours availability including nights weekends and holidays, along with participation in an on-call rotation is required. Maintaining a professional demeanor, customer service skills, curiosity, flexibility, and the ability to work well in teams are also necessary for this position. Other duties will be assigned as needed. The successful candidate must reside in the City of Philadelphia or establish primary residence in the City of Philadelphia within six months of hire.

Essential Functions

• Leverage large volumes of data from internal and external sources to analyze, organize, and understand it to determine clear strategies and next steps for solving problems for the Water Department
• Create data models and views based on large and complex data sets to facilitate research and reporting at PWD
• Conduct research to answer industry and business questions
• Employ sophisticated analytics programs, machine learning and statistical methods to prepare data for use in predictive and prescriptive modeling
• Explore and examine data to find hidden patterns
• Automate work through the use predictive and prescriptive analytics
• Tell stories to key stakeholders based on your analysis
• Establish and maintain working relationships with teammates, other teams in and out of PWD, and departmental officials within City government
• Maintain relationships with vendors

• High School Diploma and two years of post-high school education required. A college degree is a plus but not required. One or more Data Science and/or Analytical certificates a plus.

• Attention to detail is critical
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
• Proficient in data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI
• Proficient in programming languages like Python, R, and SQL
• Exemplary organization skills
• Emphasis on customer service
• Exemplary written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Metaphore: Antibody Discovery and Molecular Biology Co-Op
jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About Metaphore Biotechnologies, Inc.

Metaphore Biotechnologies, Inc. is a privately held biotechnology company building the next generation of biological therapeutics. Inspired by nature, our mission is to transform patient lives by unlocking the power of biological therapeutics with a new mimic-discovery platform.

About Flagship Pioneering

Metaphore Biotechnologies was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Co-op to support early-stage discovery efforts within our Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD) program, a newly initiated therapeutic discovery program focused on achieving proof-of-concept (POC) by the end of the year. This position will provide hands-on experimental support for routine but mission-critical discovery and molecular biologyactivities that enable efficient advancement of the program. The role offers meaningful exposure to foundational discovery workflows within a fast-paced, research-focused environment, with opportunities to contribute across additional programs as bandwidth allows. This position is a unique joint effort between the Discovery and Molecular Biology teams, with opportunities to support cloning projects focused on antibody expression, contribute to high-throughput cloning pipelines, and gain exposure to laboratory automation.

Key Responsibilities:

The Co-op’s core responsibilities will focus on executing routine, mission-critical discovery and molecular biology experiments that support target validation, hit identification, and early characterization within the PAD program. The role will involve hands-on laboratory work using established protocols, with opportunities to contribute to:

• Molecular biology techniques supporting library preparation, cloning, and hit screening

• Antibody selection methodologies, including phage display–based biopanning on PAD-relevant targets

• ELISA-based screening and other binding and characterization assays

• Cloning projects supporting antibody expression and high-throughput cloning pipelines

• Laboratory automation workflows, as applicable

• Additional foundational assays required to advance early discovery milestones efficiently

The Co-op will work closely with Discovery and Molecular Biology scientists to generate high-quality experimental data that supports timely decision-making and progress toward POC. As a shared resource across these teams, the role may also contribute to assay execution, cloning, and general laboratory needs for additional discovery programs as capacity allows.

Required Qualifications:

• A collaborative and adaptable mindset with a positive attitude and a strong willingness to learn new skills

• Basic molecular biology and protein biochemistry skills

• Familiarity with standard wet-lab techniques

• Ability to follow established protocols accurately and reproducibly

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Willingness to work across multiple projects and teams in a dynamic environment

• Comfort contributing in a fast-paced, resource-conscious discovery setting

Preferred Qualifications:

Note: These qualifications are not required. Candidates who are eager to learn and confident in their ability to acquire these skills with proper training are encouraged to apply.

• Prior laboratory experience in an academic or industry setting

• Hands-on experience with phage display, ELISAs, or related assay formats (e.g. yeast or mammalian display)

• Experience with cloning and routine molecular biology techniques such as Gibson or Golden Gate Assembly

• Basic understanding of protein or antibody biochemistry

• Experience maintaining clear and accurate experimental records

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Candidate Experience Coordinator, Cambridge, MA
jobs.description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

Your impact

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

• Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.

• Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.

• Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.

• Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

• Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

• Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.

• Identify & Eradicate Bottlenecks: Proactively flag recurring scheduling challenges or process delays. You won’t just follow the process; you will help evolve it by suggesting improvements and piloting new workflows.

3. Enablement & Strategic Partnership

• Scaling processes: Utilising AI, you will assist in documenting core processes for TA, creating clear and consistent guides for everything from complex scheduling to offer approval workflows. Additionally, you will ensure effective training for any new coordinators and wider TA members.

• Champion Interdisciplinary Partnership: You will have opportunities for domain alignment with specific verticals, allowing you to build deeper context on the roles you support and partner closely with Hiring Managers, thereby leveraging diverse skills and perspectives across the business.

Skills and qualifications

Essential:

• Exceptional Organisation: Ability to prioritise multiple functions and tasks while maintaining the highest attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience Centric: A strong focus on providing the best possible candidate experience, with the empathy to manage relationships through the entire recruitment lifecycle.

• Tech & Data Savvy: Experience using online calendar/meeting applications (G-Suite preferred) and a data-driven approach with a strong desire to advocate for clean data.

• Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of keeping stakeholders updated and writing "human-first" correspondence.

• Global Mindset: Experience scheduling and complex coordination across multiple time zones.

• Process Mindset: The ability to learn complex systems quickly and a willingness to question "how things are done" to find better solutions.

Nice to have:

• ATS Expertise: Deep experience with Applicant Tracking Systems, specifically Greenhouse

• Project Management: Experience leading or contributing to operational projects (e.g., event logistics, data cleanup, survey rollouts).

• Agency or Search Firm Experience: Experience acting as the main point of contact for external partners.

Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.

Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

Creating an extraordinary company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

• Travel to any/all locations as directed.

Administrative:

• Must make a professional appearance at all times and within Equinox standards.

• Solicits and uses feedback for continuous improvement.
• Actively assist the team in the completion of goals and cost savings.

• Minimum of 1-2 years as a fitness equipment repair technician, within the health club/hotel/hospitality industry.
• Worked as a member of a team and in an environment consistent with meeting departmental goals.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is building the industry’s most trusted, scalable, and fan-centric sportsbook experience. Our Internal Platforms team powers the systems that enable customer operations, marketing, support, and data-driven decision making—centered around Salesforce and deeply integrated backend services.

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Engineer to develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions that support critical internal workflows and customer-facing operations. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong Salesforce development expertise, comfort working across integrations and distributed systems, and a passion for building high-quality internal platforms.

You will work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Data Engineering, and Backend Engineering teams to deliver robust Salesforce capabilities that integrate with third-party systems and internal APIs.

Responsibilities

Salesforce Engineering & Platform Development

• Build, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and declarative features.

• Participate in the end-to-end implementation of Salesforce enhancements, from requirements gathering through deployment and support.

• Apply scalable and maintainable patterns for triggers, flows, automation, and custom components.

• Write high-quality, testable code with appropriate unit test coverage and participate in code reviews.

Integrations & Distributed Systems

• Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external/internal systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and event-driven patterns.

• Partner with backend engineers to design clean integration contracts between Salesforce and Java-based services.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration and data flow issues across systems.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

• Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and cross-functional partners to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Partner with Marketing, VIP, Operations Support, Risk, and Data teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business and regulatory needs.

• Clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Management & Platform Quality

• Support data migrations, imports/exports, and ongoing data quality initiatives.

• Ensure strong data integrity, security, access control, and performance across the Salesforce ecosystem.

• Contribute to platform reliability, availability, and operational excellence.

Documentation & Best Practices

• Create and maintain technical documentation for Salesforce customizations, configurations, and integrations.

• Follow and help evolve engineering best practices related to Salesforce DX, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and deployment strategies.

• Continuously identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform scalability.

Experience and Skills

Required

• 3-5 years of hands-on Salesforce engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation.

• Strong experience with Salesforce configuration, including custom objects, flows, validation rules, and security model design.

• Experience building and maintaining API-based integrations between Salesforce and third-party or internal systems.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Ability to work independently on complex projects while collaborating effectively within a team.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Preferred

• Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification.

• Additional Salesforce certifications (Administrator, App Builder, Architect).

• Experience with:

• Data migrations and large-scale data operations

• Event-driven architectures and distributed systems

• Highly available, production-critical platforms

• Experience working closely with cross-functional teams such as Marketing, Product, Operations, and Data.

• Experience working with AI model or agent platforms, including building on or integrating agents into production workflows. Familiarity with platforms such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, CrewAI, or AutoGen is a plus.

• Familiarity using AI-powered coding assistants to design, build, and test new functionality from the ground up, with the ability to move quickly while maintaining high code quality and test coverage.

• Interest in leveraging emerging tools and workflows to improve developer productivity and platform throughput.

What We Value

• Passion for building high-quality internal platforms that directly impact business outcomes.

• Strong ownership mindset and commitment to engineering excellence.

• Collaborative approach and desire to continuously learn and improve.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$1—$1 USD

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
We're Tovala, a food-tech company reinventing home cooking through hardware, software, and fresh food delivery. We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to help raise the bar on the connected oven at the heart of every Tovala kitchen. You'll partner with our firmware lead (5+ years on the team) as a true peer and own meaningful slices of the fleet end-to-end. We run two oven fleets in parallel: a mature legacy fleet, built on the Electric Imp stack coded in Squirrel powering most of our installed base, and a new fleet built on our in-house IoT stack, utilizing ESP32, C and AWS. You'll focus on keeping the legacy fleet healthy and de-risking changes, while contributing to the new fleet as it grows.
AI-assisted development is reshaping how our team works, and we expect the same on firmware. You should have hands-on experience with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot and strong opinions on applying them well in embedded contexts where the constraints differ from typical web/backend work.
 
What You’ll Do
Design, build, test, and ship firmware for our connected ovens — starting with the Electric Imp / Squirrel fleet that serves the majority of our customers today, and contributing to our new ESP32 based platform as it scales.
Own bug fixes, feature additions, and performance/efficiency improvements end-to-end — from scoping through lab testing, staged fleet rollout, and production monitoring.
Write, monitor and maintain automated firmware test pipelines.
Design and execute test plans on the bench and on real fleet subsets. We push firmware to tens of thousands of ovens in customers’ kitchens, and we take that seriously.
Use AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work — for code generation, debugging, test scaffolding, log analysis, and documentation — while applying the judgment that embedded work demands.
Collaborate closely with our thermal, mechanical, and quality engineers, our manufacturing and ops partners, and our backend team to root-cause issues that span the full stack — firmware, hardware, cloud, and the factory floor.
Help evolve our firmware development practices: code review standards, test infrastructure, release processes, and how we incorporate AI tooling responsibly.
Document and communicate clearly so your work is durable, your tradeoffs are visible, and your teammates can build on top of what you ship.
What You’ll Bring
Required
5+ years of professional firmware or embedded software engineering experience, including shipping firmware to a fleet of internet-connected devices in production.
Strong fundamentals in C/C++ and embedded systems — RTOS, memory, timing, interrupts, real-time constraints, and the discipline that comes with code running on devices you can’t easily reach.
Experience working in Python, Bash for build tooling as well as testing automation
Comfort working with (or willingness to quickly learn) the Squirrel programming language and the Electric Imp platform.
Experience with common embedded interfaces and protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and the network stacks (BLE, Wi-Fi, TLS, MQTT/HTTPS) that connected products depend on.
Experience with CICD and automated test workflows, ideally Github automations and workflows.. 
Demonstrated, hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development. You’ve integrated AI tools into your daily workflow and can speak concretely about how they’ve changed the way you build, test, and debug firmware.
Excellent communication skills. You can explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, hardware partners, and non-technical stakeholders, and you write things down.
Strong problem-solving instincts — you dig into root causes, think about second-order effects, and find pragmatic solutions in messy real-world systems.
A degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or commensurate experience.
Nice to Have
Direct experience with Electric Imp OS and Squirrel.
Experience with ESP32 and modern embedded toolchains (ESP-IDF, FreeRTOS).
Experience with cloud IoT infrastructure — AWS IoT Core, device shadows, OTA pipelines, telemetry ingestion — even at a contributing rather than owning level.
Familiarity with web technologies both front end and back end as well as databases — Typescript, React, Flask, Go, SQL
Manufacturing and factory tooling: Experience building or supporting the systems that flash, provision, and verify firmware on the production line, and debugging them remotely with overseas manufacturing partners across time zones.
Hardware-adjacent skills: For example, ability to read schematics and PCB layouts, comfort on a bench with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, ability to spec an alternate component, basic familiarity with switch-mode power supplies.
Experience working in a connected consumer product or food-tech company.
Who You Are
Solution-Minded: You focus on outcomes, not output. You want to understand the customer problem before you start writing firmware, and you’re not precious about your approach if a better one emerges.
AI-Forward: You see AI tools as a fundamental shift in how software — firmware included — gets built. You’re already using them daily and have thoughts on how teams should adopt them in safety-conscious, hardware-adjacent contexts.
Cross-Functional Collaborator: You thrive working alongside hardware, thermal, quality, manufacturing, ops, and backend teammates. You communicate clearly and care about the end-to-end product experience.
Startup Mindset: You’re comfortable in an environment where priorities evolve and where your work has direct, visible impact on customers’ kitchens.
Curious and Adaptive: You stay current on hardware, firmware, and AI tooling, and you have a favorite microprocessor brand — maybe even a favorite oscilloscope brand.
Location
This role is hybrid with a strong preference for candidates based in or near Chicago, IL (HQ) or Urbana, IL (The Product Manufactory, our R&D and prototyping shop). For the right candidate, primarily remote work is possible, provided you have your own electronics bench and equipment.

jobs.title: Equinox Coaching Foundations Program, Los Angeles
jobs.description:
We are looking for energetic, driven, and enthusiastic fitness professionals to join our team. If you are passionate about inspiring others and eager to pursue a career in Personal Training, the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program offers a comprehensive pathway to begin your coaching career with us.

As part of our commitment to developing the next generation of Equinox Coaches, we provide the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program, a hybrid, 2 week learning experience designed to help aspiring Coaches earn their ISSA Certified Personal Trainer (ISSA CPT) credential.

In our effort to support you in this endeavor, Equinox will cover the entirety of the certification cost, Including study hours.

Program Overview

The EQX Coaching Foundations Program spans 10 working days, consisting of:

• 5 hours of live virtual workshops

• 3 discussion boards

• 2 practice assessments

• 1 accredited ISSACPT final exam

This hybrid learning model includes virtual instruction, self paced study, and multiple learning environments supported by our PT Educators.

If you do not yet have your CPR/AED certification, you will complete this during the program as well.

Curriculum Overview

ISSA Coursework Includes:

• Intro to Personal Training

• Movement Biomechanics

• Bioenergetics

• Assessment Protocols & Program Design

• Flexibility & Cardiovascular Training

• Resistance Training & Exercise Technique

• Nutrition & Supplementation

• Special Populations

• Business & Safety

Equinox Coaching Foundations Coursework Includes:

• The EQX Brand

• Service Standards

• Program Goal Categories

• Program Focuses

• The Program Portal

• Equifit Assessment

• Program Recommendation

• Complementary Services

• PT Business Management

• EQX PT Team

Program Commitment

Participants will complete the Foundations curriculum with a 2.5 hour commitment per day across 10 working days, working closely with EFTI Operators and PT Educators who oversee the program.

Upon successfully completing the Foundations Program and passing the ISSACPT final exam, you will:

• Earn your ISSA Certified Personal Trainer credential

• Complete required CPR/AED certification (if applicable)

• Participants are hired as a Provisional Coach with Equinox. Upon successful completion of the Foundations Program and passing the ISSA‑CPT exam, you will be promoted into the full‑time Coach position at Equinox.

Role Expectations

• Complete all coursework, workshops, assessments, and study requirements within the 2week program timeframe to be conducted onsite at an Equinox location.
• Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of ISSA and Equinox Coaching Foundations content
• Apply principles of exercise science, coaching communication, program design, and client assessment
• Uphold Equinox brand standards and deliver exceptional member experiences
• Continue professional development as you transition into the Coach role
• Qualifications
• Ability to complete the 2 week Foundations Program
• Commitment to pursuing a Personal Trainer/Coach career with Equinox
• Strong passion for fitness, coaching, and growth
• Ability to work in person on weekdays and weekends
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Time management, organization, and basic computer proficiency
• Energetic, friendly, punctual, and respectful

Pay Transparency: $16.78 - $19.08 /hourly depending on club location in accordance with state and locale wages

• Opportunity to be a practicing Personal Trainer upon completion of Personal Trainer Certification
• Premier facilities with functional training areas, top-of-the-line strength and cardio equipment, and more

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Warehouse
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Warehouse is responsible for the strategic and operational leadership of multiple warehouse facilities, ensuring the efficient, accurate, and timely delivery of products to Pilot Travel Centers and external customers. This role oversees warehouse operations, distribution strategy, inventory management, transportation and freight negotiations, systems implementation, financial performance, and team development across multiple locations. The position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, process improvement, and customer service while ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-effective operations.

In this role you will:

• Lead the operations of multiple warehouse facilities, ensuring accurate and timely fulfillment and delivery of products to internal and external customers.
• Develop and implement warehouse layouts, operational processes, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and service levels.
• Direct warehouse management system (WMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP), and transportation management system (TMS) implementations and process optimization efforts.
• Manage inventory, material supplies, equipment purchases, and maintenance contracts necessary to support warehouse operations.
• Oversee freight procurement and negotiations across multiple sites to ensure cost-effective transportation solutions and service reliability.
• Develop, coach, and lead managers and supervisors to build organizational capability and achieve operational objectives.
• Manage warehouse-related operating expenses, including labor, overtime, temporary staffing, and other SG&A costs.
• Establish and execute operational strategies that support business objectives and drive performance across multiple locations.

Leadership Responsibilities

• Provides leadership through subordinate managers and supervisors.
• Creates an environment focused on accountability, engagement, safety, customer service, and continuous improvement.
• Aligns resources, staffing, and operational priorities to support business goals across multiple facilities.

Scope and Impact

• Contributes to and helps shape business strategy across multiple warehouse locations.
• Impacts operational performance across Pilot Travel Centers and external customers through product delivery, inventory management, and supply chain execution.
• Exercises broad influence through internal leadership, external vendor partnerships, and transportation providers.

• Bachelor's degree preferred.
• Seven or more years of progressive warehouse, distribution, supply chain, or logistics leadership experience.
• Experience managing multi-site operations and leading leaders preferred.

The Equinox Personal Training Internship offers students a unique opportunity to learn and work alongside fitness industry experts in our cutting-edge facilities.
