jobs.title: Senior Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, Growth Marketing is the enterprise leader for performance marketing strategy across all channels — Paid Social, Programmatic Display/Video, Paid Search (SEM), YouTube, TV, Digital OOH, and emerging media (e.g., Podcasts, Streaming). You will own the growth roadmap, forecasting, and budget allocation, orchestrate our agency partners to execute with excellence, and close the loop between audiences, creative, landing experiences, and business outcomes.

This role partners closely with Marketing Analytics, CRM & Martech, Brand/Creative, Digital (Web/App), Product, and Business Intelligence teams to set ambitions, measure incrementality, and scale what works. You will lead both an external agency and lean but high-performing team of channel leaders, drive a rigorous test-and-learn culture, and steward a data-driven approach to profitable growth (CAC/ROAS/LTV/payback).

Execution model: Agencies execute day-to-day media; you set direction, pressure-test strategies, and hold partners accountable to velocity of learning and results.

Responsibilities:

• Own channel strategy & portfolio: Define the multi-channel growth strategy, OKRs, and investment mix (prospecting vs. retargeting/loyalty; brand vs. non-brand), including geo and audience prioritization.
• Budgeting, pacing & forecasting: Build bottoms-up forecasts and scenario plans; manage budgets and in-month reallocations to deliver CAC, ROAS, payback, and LTV goals in partnership with Marketing Analytics.
• Agency leadership & vendor management: Set briefs, SLAs, QA standards, and pixel tracking governance; run weekly WIPs/QBRs; manage platform/DSP relationships; pilot betas responsibly and codify learnings for scale.
• Testing agenda & innovation: Own the cross-channel test roadmap (creative systems, audience/1P data, bidding, placements/inventory, frequency & sequencing, incrementality/holdouts) with hypotheses, guardrails, and roll-out criteria.
• Measurement planning & performance storytelling: Partner with Marketing Analytics to define conversion taxonomy, consent-aware tracking (including server-side), dashboards/scorecards, and clear monthly/quarterly readouts; translate insights into decisions.
• Creative feedback loop: Turn auction and audience signals into creative briefs; monitor fatigue and creative win rates; collaborate with Brand/Creative and Digital teams on landing page/CRO alignment.
• Cross-functional leadership: Align growth plans with CRM & Lifecycle, Brand, Product, and Regional teams; ensure channel learnings inform lifecycle messaging and owned experiences.
• Data quality & governance: Ensure data fidelity across pixels/tags, server-side conversions, audience uploads, and offline conversion imports; maintain alerting and acceptance tests.
• Team leadership: Hire, coach, and develop a lean but high-performing team; establish operating rhythms, decision logs, and a culture of curiosity, rigor, and accountability.
• Compliance & brand safety: Champion privacy-safe targeting and measurement (GDPR/CCPA, ATT), and ensure brand suitability across buys and partners.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or related field
• 12+ years in performance marketing with 5+ years leading multi-channel teams and eight-figure budgets across Paid Social, Programmatic, and SEM.
• Proven agency orchestration experience (SLAs, QA, test roadmaps) and strong platform fluency (Meta, TikTok, YouTube/Google, DV360/The Trade Desk, Microsoft Ads; affiliate, CTV, and DOOH networks a plus).
• Deep analytics acumen: partnership with analytics on MMM/MTA/incrementality, comfort with GA4/Adobe and BI (Looker/Tableau/Power BI), and executive command of CAC/ROAS/LTV/payback.

jobs.title: Personal Trainer Internship, NYC
jobs.description:
Equinox Personal Trainers provide personalized attention, professional instruction, and exercise programming to maximize each member’s health, fitness, and wellness goals while providing the highest level of customer service.

Internship Program

The Equinox Personal Training Internship offers students a unique opportunity to learn and work alongside fitness industry experts in our cutting-edge facilities. This program bridges academic knowledge with real-world experience, helping students develop essential skills for a career in personal training. While the internship is hosted by Equinox, the training provides broad applicability to related businesses. Participants can also access Equinox's specialized education through our proprietary education, the Equinox Fitness Training Institute (EFTI) and connect with Coach, Coach+ and Coach X trainers. Internship duration is flexible to suit academic needs, with mandatory paperwork due before commencement.

Throughout the internship program, interns will be required to complete a variety of large and small projects that will encourage them to fully immerse themself into the business that will also mimic curriculum that a student will see in their undergraduate education. The following are examples of potential smaller projects:

• Study one injury per week, documenting causes, signs and symptoms, treatment, rehabilitation, and prevention
• Become familiar with all possible specialties and/or certifications that the intern is potentially interested in studying/receiving in the future
• Design programs based on two selected trainers who are specific in their PT goals, any notable injuries, athletic history, etc. (can be hypothetical)
• Research the following conditions: Hypertension, Diabetes, Pregnancy, CVD with points on cause, physiological implications, benefits of exercise on the conditions, exercises to help, and exercises to avoid
• Weekly connects with supervisor to review progress on weekly objectives and set up actions for the upcoming week
• Member experience & engagement activities: fitness Specialist Shifts, front desk support, member reach outs, etc.

Application Process:

• The screening process for this program prioritizes criteria that assess the applicant's potential for learning, enthusiasm for the subject matter, academic achievements, and relevant coursework.

• Students must be eligible to earn academic credit for their work
• At least 2-years completion towards an undergraduate degree: Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education, Personal Training, or other applicable majors preferred
• An outgoing and personable disposition, able to socialize with others
• A passion for fitness and helping others reach their health and wellness goals
• Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
• Customer-service oriented and an ability to understand or quickly grasp, customer priorities and terminology
• Effective oral and written communications skills
• Results oriented with an ability to organize, prioritize and manage time
• Previous Personal Training experience preferred but not required

• This role is an educational and training opportunity, not employment. Interns will not displace or perform the function of any paid employee.
• Compensation: This is an unpaid internship. Interns will not be Equinox employees for minimum wage or other purposes. Interns will not receive any wages or employee benefits for their participation in the program.
• While qualified graduates may be considered for employment, interns are not guaranteed or entitled to a paid job or offer of employment at the conclusion of the training period.
• Duration: The duration of the program is negotiable depending on the requirements of the intern’s university. Equinox will make efforts to accommodate an intern’s academic commitments.

jobs.description:
The Patient Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Patient Care Technician’s primary function is to assist and support the Professional Registered Nurse in all aspects of direct and indirect patient care activities.  The Patient Care Technician functions as a member of the unit staff under the direction and supervision of the professional Registered Nurse.

Responsibilities:

• Direct Patient Care Activities Assists with admission, transfer, and discharge process.Takes and records temperature, pulse, respirations, weight for adults and/or neonates, height, and blood pressure.Measures and records intake and output including output from drains.Applies cardiac monitor/oximetry.Obtains EKG.Adheres to the infant security protocol (accurate assessment of band placement).Performs normal newborn hearing screening.Obtains capillary blood glucose for adults and/or neonates.Performs phlebotomy.Applies Fetal Monitor equipment on pregnant patients.Discontinues heplocks and foley catheters. Administers enemas.Collects specimens (urine, stool, blood and sputum) on adults and/or neonates. Makes rounds of patients and anticipates their needs and observes newborns in the nursery.Responds to patient call lights in a timely manner, especially emergency lights.Distributes fresh drinking water and nourishments to patients. Prepares patients for meals; assists or feeds patients as necessary. Feeds normal newborns as assigned.Provides morning care, bed baths and evening care according to established Nursing Care Procedures. Provides peri-care to appropriate patients.Provides newborn care to the infant including bath, dressing, obtaining foot prints, assistance with feeding (bottle and breast), glucose checks.Makes occupied and unoccupied beds.Ambulates patients and instructs on walker, cane and crutch walking as appropriate for assigned unit. Assists with pre-and post-operative care; positions patients as ordered; applies special equipment for safety; lifts and turns patients with proper and safe body mechanics and available resources.Applies comfort and safety measures (side rails and call lights). Sets up oxygen and suction equipment and other respiratory equipment for adults and/or neonates.Applies dressings to Stage I and Stage II skin breakdown. Prepares patient room for MD or RN assessment, evaluation, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. jobs.description:
We are looking for energetic, driven, and enthusiastic fitness professionals to join our team. If you are passionate about inspiring others and eager to pursue a career in Personal Training, the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program offers a comprehensive pathway to begin your coaching career with us.

As part of our commitment to developing the next generation of Equinox Coaches, we provide the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program, a hybrid, 2 week learning experience designed to help aspiring Coaches earn their ISSA Certified Personal Trainer (ISSA CPT) credential.

In our effort to support you in this endeavor, Equinox will cover the entirety of the certification cost, Including study hours.

Program Overview

The EQX Coaching Foundations Program spans 10 working days, consisting of:

• 5 hours of live virtual workshops

• 3 discussion boards

• 2 practice assessments

• 1 accredited ISSACPT final exam

This hybrid learning model includes virtual instruction, self paced study, and multiple learning environments supported by our PT Educators.

If you do not yet have your CPR/AED certification, you will complete this during the program as well.

Curriculum Overview

ISSA Coursework Includes:

• Intro to Personal Training

• Movement Biomechanics

• Bioenergetics

• Assessment Protocols & Program Design

• Flexibility & Cardiovascular Training

• Resistance Training & Exercise Technique

• Nutrition & Supplementation

• Special Populations

• Business & Safety

Equinox Coaching Foundations Coursework Includes:

• The EQX Brand

• Service Standards

• Program Goal Categories

• Program Focuses

• The Program Portal

• Equifit Assessment

• Program Recommendation

• Complementary Services

• PT Business Management

• EQX PT Team

Program Commitment

Participants will complete the Foundations curriculum with a 2.5 hour commitment per day across 10 working days, working closely with EFTI Operators and PT Educators who oversee the program.

Upon successfully completing the Foundations Program and passing the ISSACPT final exam, you will:

• Earn your ISSA Certified Personal Trainer credential

• Complete required CPR/AED certification (if applicable)

• Participants are hired as a Provisional Coach with Equinox. Upon successful completion of the Foundations Program and passing the ISSA‑CPT exam, you will be promoted into the full‑time Coach position at Equinox.

• Role Expectations
• Complete all coursework, workshops, assessments, and study requirements within the 2week program timeframe to be conducted onsite at an Equinox location.

• Strong passion for fitness, coaching, and growth
• Ability to work in person on weekdays and weekends
• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Energetic, friendly, punctual, and respectful

jobs.title: Performance Advisor, Seaport
jobs.description:
One Membership. Limitless Potential.

Every Equinox membership unlocks access to an unparalleled ecosystem of expertise, experiences, and services designed to maximize potential and support every aspect of high-performance living. The Performance Advisor helps prospective, new, and existing members realize the full value of that ecosystem through personalized consultation, expert guidance, and meaningful relationships that evolve alongside their individual needs, wants, and goals.

Serving as a trusted expert, the Performance Advisor connects members with the experiences, services, and specialists best equipped to support their journey. Whether introducing a member to Personal Training powered by EQX OS and Equifit, Pilates for precision and longevity, Group Fitness for community and motivation, or Spa and recovery services that support regeneration and performance, this role curates a personalized path that reflects each member’s goals and evolves over time.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Member Onboarding & Consultation:

The first impression of Equinox should feel like the beginning of something significant. The Advisor creates that moment — and builds on it.

• Conduct personalized welcome consultations with new members to understand their goals, lifestyle, and experience with fitness and wellness.

• Introduce members to the full spectrum of club offerings — Personal Training, Pilates, Group Fitness, Spa, and beyond — through an educational, consultative conversation.

• Conduct high-quality Equifit Assessments that reflect Equinox standards and deliver a premium, personalized experience. Leveraging this session to understand their need, provide them with insights from the assessment, and share ways the club offerings can support their goals.

• Maintain engagement in a supportive way without putting pressure on the member. Be highly responsive to inbound consultation requests and ensure timely scheduling.

The Equinox Experience: Driving Member Value Across All Offerings

The Advisor is the member's guide to the full Equinox experience — leading with Personal Training as the foundational investment while connecting members to the complete ecosystem of services that support their goals and lifestyle.

• Utilize Equinox Sales Training techniques to present Personal Training as the foundational investment, clearly communicating the value of one-on-one coaching in the context of the member's individual goals.
• Ensure a seamless, confidence-building handoff of new clients to the best-matched coach based on:Training goals and programming needsScheduling availabilityCoaching style and personality fitProgram specialization.
• Partner with the Personal Training Manager to align on lead flow, scheduling, and strategy, and work to support conversion rates.
• Introduce members to Pilates as a complement to training — building core strength, mobility, and body awareness that enhances every other modality.
• Present Spa and recovery services as the rejuvenation pillar, helping members understand that recovery is not optional; it is part of the practice.
• Connect members to Group Fitness, specialty classes, and community programming that align with their interests and schedule.
• Serve as an informed resource on all in-club services — fitness programming, Pilates, Spa, Shop, and member perks — so every conversation adds value.
• Lead every member interaction with curiosity and active listening, making all offerings relevant and available in response to where the member is on their personal journey.

Member Engagement & Follow-Up:

Building lasting relationships is as important as the initial consultation. The Performance Advisor stays connected and continues to add value over time.

• Manage member pipelines through thoughtful, personalized engagement — including email outreach, follow-up consultations, member experience touchpoints, and fitness floor interactions.

• Re-engage members who are not currently utilizing in-club services — identifying barriers and offer tailored solutions.

• Participate in club events, sales huddles, and team meetings to support overall business performance.

Collaboration & Team Integration:

• Partner with Membership Advisors, Personal Training Managers, Coaches, and club teams to deliver a seamless, integrated member experience.

• Align member engagement strategies and referrals across departments to ensure members are connected with the right expertise at the right time.

• Provide insights learned across the multiple departments in service elevating a superior member experience.

Member Experience & Brand Standards:

• Uphold the integrity and luxury positioning of the Equinox brand through exceptional service, presentation, and every member interaction.

• Maintain assessment room and consultation of space readiness — including equipment, technology, and cleanliness — to reflect premium standards at all times.

• Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operation of the department.

• Deliver personalized consultations that reinforce Equinox's member-centric mission.

Qualifications:

• Nationally recognized personal training certification.

• Degree in Exercise Science, Sports Management, Kinesiology, or related field preferred.

• Experience in fitness assessments, consultative sales, or client onboarding.

• CPR/AED and First Aid certification.

• Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver on goals through relationship-based, consultative engagement.

Position Requirements:

• Genuine passion for fitness, human performance, and helping members achieve meaningful, lasting results.

• Credible, polished, and professional presence — the ability to inspire confidence through presentation and communication commensurate to what is expected in a luxury environment.

• Strong consultative and interpersonal communication skills; the ability to listen, connect, and educate without pressure.

• Sound judgment and the ability to read people — adapting approach to each member's personality, goals, and readiness.

• Ability to deliver a premium assessment and consultative sales experience.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a high volume of communication and follow-up.

• Collaborative mindset and desire to work closely with Personal Training Managers, Membership Advisors, and Coaches.

• Strong technical skills and comfort with CRM systems.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills.

• Enthusiastic, energetic, and passionate about the Equinox brand and mission.

Pay Transparency: Full time hourly compensation of $30/hr plus commission on sales, and bonus based on club goals

jobs.title: Equinox Coaching Foundations Program, Brooklyn
jobs.description:
We are looking for energetic, driven, and enthusiastic fitness professionals to join our team. If you are passionate about inspiring others and eager to pursue a career in Personal Training, the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program offers a comprehensive pathway to begin your coaching career with us.

As part of our commitment to developing the next generation of Equinox Coaches, we provide the Equinox Coaching Foundations Program, a hybrid, 2 week learning experience designed to help aspiring Coaches earn their ISSA Certified Personal Trainer (ISSA CPT) credential.

In our effort to support you in this endeavor, Equinox will cover the entirety of the certification cost, Including study hours.

Program Overview

The EQX Coaching Foundations Program spans 10 working days, consisting of:

• 5 hours of live virtual workshops

• 3 discussion boards

• 2 practice assessments

• 1 accredited ISSACPT final exam

This hybrid learning model includes virtual instruction, self paced study, and multiple learning environments supported by our PT Educators.

If you do not yet have your CPR/AED certification, you will complete this during the program as well.

Curriculum Overview

ISSA Coursework Includes:

• Intro to Personal Training

• Movement Biomechanics

• Bioenergetics

• Assessment Protocols & Program Design

• Flexibility & Cardiovascular Training

• Resistance Training & Exercise Technique

• Nutrition & Supplementation

• Special Populations

• Business & Safety

Equinox Coaching Foundations Coursework Includes:

• The EQX Brand

• Service Standards

• Program Goal Categories

• Program Focuses

• The Program Portal

• Equifit Assessment

• Program Recommendation

• Complementary Services

• PT Business Management

• EQX PT Team

Program Commitment

Participants will complete the Foundations curriculum with a 2.5 hour commitment per day across 10 working days, working closely with EFTI Operators and PT Educators who oversee the program.

Upon successfully completing the Foundations Program and passing the ISSACPT final exam, you will:

• Earn your ISSA Certified Personal Trainer credential

• Complete required CPR/AED certification (if applicable)

• Participants are hired as a Provisional Coach with Equinox. Upon successful completion of the Foundations Program and passing the ISSA‑CPT exam, you will be promoted into the full‑time Coach position at Equinox.

• Role Expectations
• Complete all coursework, workshops, assessments, and study requirements within the 2week program timeframe to be conducted onsite at an Equinox location.
• Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of ISSA and Equinox Coaching Foundations content
